jobs.title: AWS Senior AI Agent Engineer
jobs.description: Job Type: 12 – month contract (potential to extend or convert to full\-time) Location: Charlotte, NC. Hybrid. Job Description: An AWS Senior AI Agent Engineer is responsible for designing and implementing highly complex agentic/prompt engineering solutions. Individuals with this role are required to: * Design and implement agentic AI solutions using AWS Bedrock, including Agents, Knowledge Bases, and Guardrails * Build serverless architectures using AWS Lambda, Step Functions, and EventBridge to orchestrate AI agent workflows * Design and engineer sophisticated prompts for agentic AI systems that can plan, reason, and execute multi\-step workflows * Develop prompt architectures that enable AI agents to use tools, APIs, and external resources effectively * Create and refine chain\-of\-thought, tree\-of\-thought, and ReAct (Reasoning \+ Acting) prompting strategies * Build evaluation frameworks to measure agent performance, reliability, and safety * Collaborate with ML and software engineers to integrate prompt strategies with agent frameworks (LangChain, Bedrock AgentCore) and leveraging Bedrock agents/services/foundational models. * Optimize prompts for accuracy, efficiency, cost, and latency in production environments * Implement guardrails and safety measures to ensure responsible agent behavior * Document prompt patterns, best practices, and design principles for the broader team * Stay current with the latest research in agentic AI, prompt engineering, and LLM capabilities * Design and build highly complex software solutions (specifically 2\+ years of experience with AWS serverless development and 4\+ years of experience on a programing language such as Java or Python) * Program well\-designed, efficient code independently. * Collaborate with designers, developers, and product owners to build solutions. * Clearly communicate team wide progress and identify blocking processes/patterns that hold a team back. * Participate in paired programming and code reviews with juniors to expand the team’s collective knowledge and understanding of software engineering. * Complete independent research to refine best practices and present work to peers. * Turn complex ideas into manageable pieces of work to complete as part of a product team. * Coach and mentor prompt engineers. * Provide technical guidance to leadership so that solutions are built with innovation and sustainability in mind. * Learn the business drivers of a product and help drive the technical direction of a product to fulfill the desired vision. Qualifications * 3\+ years of experience in prompt engineering, AI/ML, or related fields * Deep understanding of large language models (e.g. Claude) and their capabilities * Proven experience designing prompts for autonomous agents and multi\-step reasoning tasks * Strong knowledge of agentic frameworks and patterns (ReAct, Plan\-and\-Execute, Reflection, etc.) * Strong experience with AWS Bedrock (Agents, Knowledge Bases, Guardrails, and foundational models) * Proficiency with AWS serverless services: Lambda, Step Functions, API Gateway, DynamoDB, S3 * Knowledge of AWS security best practices including IAM, KMS, and VPC configurations * Familiar with Terraform and HCP * Proficiency in Python and experience with AI agent frameworks (e.g LangChain) * Experience with API integration and tool\-use patterns for AI agents * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with attention to detail * Excellent written and verbal communication skills * A breadth of experience building software solutions (through a strong mix of independent research/projects and industry expertise). * 5\-9 years’ previous experience in software development. (Either 9 years of experience specifically in software development or seven years of experience in software development in combination with 2 years alternative experience in a related field). Ideally has a portfolio of work – code samples, etc. * Deep and solid understanding of APIs. Have been involved in designing/building/implementing/consuming APIs. * Familiarity with several frameworks. Resulting code is concise and easy\-to\-follow. * Experience with automation and optimization. Looks for ways to create repeatable patterns that increase the efficiency of the team. * Experience and ability to manage and optimize databases. * Understanding of functional programming and how to apply functional concepts in any language. Quick to picking up a new language or adopting a more recent version of a language. * Familiarity and able to comfortably work with multiple platforms. * Experience turning complex ideas into user stories. From that, can turn user stories into workable solutions, providing estimates to complete that work, and breaking down complex work into smaller components. * Previous experience collaborating on a cross\-functional team. * Deep understanding of development cycle. * Ability to debug and avoid future problems by building more robust solutions. * Ability to look at previous personal or team experience and use this to analyze mistakes/successes, draw conclusions, and design future solutions. Resulting solutions have few bugs and quick remediation times. * Experience building solutions with the larger team in mind. Solutions have the goal of improving software engineering at the team level. * Experience with teaching and mentoring team members at various levels. * A deep and solid understanding of cyber security principles such as authentication, authorization and encryption. * Experience working with one or more CI/CD stacks and associated best practices. Ability to setup CI/CD for new products with no guidance. Recommends and implements modifications to CI/CD processes when continuous improvement opportunities are identified. Pay: $95,977\.73 \- $115,586\.09 per year Work Location: Hybrid remote in Charlotte, NC 28216

jobs.title: Automation Maintenance & Controls Specialist (Manufacturing Systems)
jobs.description: **Are you the automation problem\-solver every factory needs?** --------------------------------------------------------------- We design and build advanced battery systems for construction equipment, aerial work platforms, material handling, robotics, marine, military, and commercial EV markets. From our Mason, Ohio facility, we’re looking for a hands\-on specialist who thrives on keeping complex automated systems running at peak performance—and making them better every day. ### **Questions to ask yourself** * Can you hunt down the root cause of a line stop across electrical, mechanical, pneumatic, hydraulic, servo, and controls domains? * Do you enjoy stepping into PLC code, HMIs, and motion control to debug, optimize, and modify? * Are you energized by commissioning new equipment and validating new production lines? * Could you architect preventive and predictive maintenance programs that cut downtime and boost reliability? * Will you lead structured problem\-solving (5\-Why, Fishbone, FMEA) and back it up with data from OEE, MTBF, MTTR, and downtime reports? * Do you keep drawings, PLC backups, spares, and maintenance records current so the team can move fast? * Are you comfortable supporting robots (industrial and cobots), assembly cells, conveyors, torque systems, machine vision, laser marking, dispensing, battery cyclers, and end\-of\-line test rigs? * Can you debug industrial networks and devices—Ethernet/IP, I/O, sensors, actuators, servo drives, and VFDs? * Do you like improving control panels and electrical systems to be safer, simpler, and more robust? * Will you partner with Manufacturing Engineering to lift cycle times, ergonomics, quality, and throughput? * Can you identify and deliver capital upgrades, automation enhancements, and cost\-down opportunities? * Are you ready to support facility utilities like compressed air, electrical distribution, and HVAC interfaces? * Will you champion OSHA, NFPA 70E, Lockout/Tagout, machine guarding, and electrical safety? * Do you collaborate smoothly with Quality, Manufacturing, Product Integration, Test Engineering, and Operations? * Can you stand up and sustain Odoo ERP, MES, and Maintenance modules for work orders, PMs, spares, and equipment history? ### **What makes you a great fit** * BS in Electrical, Controls, Mechatronics, Mechanical, Manufacturing Engineering, or related technical field. * 5\+ years supporting automated manufacturing equipment on the production floor. * Expert at troubleshooting PLC\-controlled systems. * Fluent with PLC platforms such as Allen\-Bradley, Siemens, Beckhoff, Omron, or Mitsubishi. * HMI development and protocols: Ethernet/IP, Profinet, DeviceNet, Modbus, or EtherCAT. * Experience with servo systems, VFDs, motion control, and industrial networking. * Robotics exposure: FANUC, ABB, Universal Robots, Yaskawa, Epson, or similar. * Background in automated assembly, machine vision, leak testing, dispensing, conveyors, and automated inspection. * Can read/modify schematics, wiring diagrams, ladder logic, and control panel layouts. * Preferred tools: AutoCAD Electrical, EPLAN, or similar. * Strong command of industrial electrical systems, sensors, instrumentation, and machine safety. * Plus: predictive maintenance (vibration, thermal imaging, lubrication management, condition monitoring). * Continuous improvement mindset—Lean, TPM, Six Sigma. * Industry bonus points: battery, automotive, aerospace, robotics, medical device, electronics, semiconductor, food processing. * Data\-driven, organized, and quick to prioritize when production calls. * Clear communicator and effective partner across teams. ### **What’s in it for you** * Be part of a rapidly scaling U.S. battery manufacturer. * Hands\-on with cutting\-edge automation and energy storage tech. * Lead the launch of new lines and processes. * Collaborate with experienced engineers across manufacturing and product development. * Competitive pay and comprehensive benefits. * 401(k) with company match. * Paid time off and holidays. * Professional development and technical training. * Real advancement opportunities as we grow. ### **Hands\-on proficiencies** * Electrical Schematics * Troubleshooting Skills * Machine Building/Assembling * Pneumatics Experience * Single and Three Phase Power * 120/208/240/480 Voltage Systems * Industrial Robot Programming * Troubleshooting Industrial Automation Equipment * PLC Programming Experience * SCADA Experience * Programming Machine Vision Systems * Electrical / Electronic Systems * Pneumatics Troubleshooting * Industrial Electrical Experience * Industrial Electrical Systems * Electrical Schematic Reading * Equipment Installation \& Wiring * VLC troubleshooting ### **Tech you’ll work with** * Variable Frequency Drives (VFD) * CAD Software * Programmable Logic Controller (PLC) (Allen Bradley) * Vision System * Servo Motors * Industrial Robot (Fanuc) Role location: Mason, Ohio

jobs.title: Communication Design Engineer
jobs.description: Marmon Industrial Energy and Infrastructure As a part of the global industrial organization Marmon Holdings—which is backed by Berkshire Hathaway—you’ll be doing things that matter, leading at every level, and winning a better way. We’re committed to making a positive impact on the world, providing you with diverse learning and working opportunities, and fostering a culture where everyone’s empowered to be their best. The Principal Design Engineer leads the design, qualification, and lifecycle support of high\-performance coaxial, twisted\-pair, twinaxial, fiber\-optic, Power over Ethernet (PoE), Single Pair Ethernet (SPE), Class 4 power, and hybrid cable products. This role converts customer and market requirements into reliable, manufacturable, standards\-compliant solutions while partnering closely with Product Management, Applications Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, suppliers, and customers. **Essential Responsibilities** ------------------------------ ### **Transmission Cable Design \& Product Development** * Lead new product development and sustaining engineering projects for coaxial, twisted\-pair, twinaxial, fiber\-optic, power, and hybrid cable constructions. * Apply electromagnetic and optical transmission theory to conductor geometry, dielectric systems, shielding, cabling, fiber selection, and termination design. * Develop and validate designs through calculations, modeling, prototypes, design reviews, and laboratory testing. * Document design assumptions, risks, tolerances, and acceptance criteria. * Direct product development priorities aligned with business strategy and product roadmaps. ### **Standards, Compliance \& Qualification** * Design and qualify products to applicable TIA\-568, ISO/IEC 11801, SPE, Industrial Ethernet, Telcordia, NEMA, ICEA, UL, and CSA requirements. * Support ISO 9001 and ISO 14001 systems, along with material\-compliance obligations including RoHS, REACH, Proposition 65, PFAS, TSCA, CMRT, and EMRT. * Define qualification and production test methods, equipment, fixtures, sampling plans, and acceptance criteria. * Review industry codes and standards and represent MIEI at industry and agency meetings. * Support Marmon Electrical businesses in maintaining and developing industry standards. ### **Manufacturing, Suppliers \& the 5Ms** * Serve as a subject matter expert in the transmission cable 5Ms: + Materials + Manufacturing Methods + Machines + Measurement/Certification + Manpower/Training * Partner with manufacturing facilities and suppliers to resolve material, equipment, process, testing, certification, quality, and performance issues. * Translate designs into manufacturable products, including process windows, inspection requirements, and testing criteria. * Support root\-cause analysis, corrective actions, and CAPEX planning related to product design requirements. ### **Project Execution \& Systems** * Manage projects utilizing Stage\-Gate/New Product Development processes and continuous improvement methodologies. * Maintain accurate product information within CableBuilder, Smartsheet, Axiom, QCBD, ISOVISION, and other company systems. * Ensure specifications, drawings, test plans, and engineering changes are accurate, traceable, and released on schedule. ### **Customer, Technical \& Organizational Support** * Provide technical training related to cable construction and termination principles for internal teams and customers. * Support customer troubleshooting, technical reviews, product qualifications, and field issue resolution. * Assist with R\&D planning and budget management aligned with strategic business initiatives. *The responsibilities listed above are not intended to be an exhaustive list. Additional duties may be assigned based on business needs.* **Education \& Experience** --------------------------- **Required** * Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Optical Engineering, Physics, or a related technical field. * Minimum of five years of experience in cable design, transmission\-line/RF propagation, data communications, or fiber\-optic product development. * Experience designing and qualifying cable products. * Experience interpreting specifications, engineering drawings, test data, and industry standards. * Experience supporting manufacturing operations, suppliers, engineering change control, Stage\-Gate/NPD programs, and cross\-functional teams. **Preferred** * Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Optical Engineering, Physics, or related field. **Knowledge, Skills \& Abilities** ---------------------------------- * Knowledge of electromagnetic and optical transmission theory, RF theory, signal integrity, and cable materials/construction. * Familiarity with RF, high\-speed data, and optical qualification and production testing methods. * Proficiency with engineering calculations, cable design software, laboratory tools, and modeling applications. * Ability to balance performance, compliance, manufacturability, quality, cost, reliability, schedule, and technical risk. * Strong written, verbal, project management, training, and cross\-functional leadership skills. * Continuous improvement mindset with excellent judgment and attention to detail. * Ability and willingness to travel as required. Marmon Industrial Energy \& Infrastructure is an Equal Opportunity Employer and makes employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, pregnancy, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. Following receipt of a conditional offer of employment, candidates will be required to complete additional job\-related screening processes as permitted or required by applicable law. We are an equal opportunity employer, and all applicants will be considered for employment without attention to their membership in any protected class. If you require any reasonable accommodation to complete your application or any part of the recruiting process, please email your request to careers@marmon.com, and please be sure to include the title and the location of the position for which you are applying.

jobs.title: Engineering Technician
jobs.description: ### **Description** Work with Maintenance, Operations and other support personnel in carrying out assignments of a technical nature and to achieve higher equipment availability and lower maintenance costs by utilizing predictive maintenance technology to inspect, test, analyze and report on the operations of plant equipment. Expected to align personal goals with the Mission, Vision, and values of OVEC/IKEC.### **Key Responsibilities** * Assist in performing technical and analytical assignments such as carrying out prescribed procedures in the routine testing of: boilers, turbines, pulverizers, condensers, heaters, and pumps. Clifty technicians will also be responsible for testing air preheater pressure drop. * Assist in preparing detailed reports and compiling statistics, including the comparison and research, with respect to data on specific assignments such as measuring steam lead movements, turbine control valve leak\-off, turbine stage differential pressures, boiler feed pumps, balancing drum leak\-off, and similar plant equipment. * Assist engineers in performing work such as; preparing detailed drawings, memorandum of instructions and communications to other sections or departments and taking daily instrument readings. Clifty technicians will also conduct coal pile and plant settlement surveys. * Assist in and perform, by following prescribed procedures, the routine technical work on all plant equipment. * Assist in infrared scanning, vibration analysis, ultrasound testing and lubrication analysis of equipment and evaluating the results. * Assist with the coordination and scheduling of preventative and/or predictive maintenance activities with other plant departments, as necessary, and prepare or assist with preparation of the necessary technical reports. * Support the plant in the management of PdM related projects. * Maintain accurate, up\-to\-date predictive maintenance databases using condition\-based monitoring systems and software. * Attend and successfully complete certification classes in relevant technologies. * Support the utilization of FMEA (failure modes and effects analysis), Root Cause Analysis, and FRACAS (failure reporting, analysis and corrective action systems). * Document asset conditions and assist with the issuance of corrective maintenance recommendations and priorities based on analysis of the results. * Become proficient with PdM hardware and software. * Assist in the evaluation of effectiveness of maintenance repairs from a PdM perspective as requested and/or needed. * Exhibit a willingness to participate in both internal and external training. * Assist maintenance personnel on precision maintenance activities, including but not limited to field balancing and lubrication. * Develop a working knowledge and understanding, both mechanical and electrical, of moving and rotating equipment such as pumps, motors, gearboxes, conveyors, etc., from both an operational and maintenance perspective. * Assist in the interpretation and application of information from technical manuals, drawings and other reference materials. * Demonstrate ability to troubleshoot technical issues and make recommendations. * Assist employees of equal or higher classification. * Perform similar or less skilled work. * Perform duties in accordance with all applicable federal and state safety laws and regulations, and all applicable company safety rules and operating procedures; when supervising others, assure that safe work practices are followed and conduct safety meetings; make suggestions for the improvement of the safety program and encourage others to do so. * Responsible for knowing and complying with the laws and Code of Business Conduct related to the performance of the aforementioned duties. ### **Minimum Qualifications** * A two\-year associate technical degree in electronics, engineering technology or equivalent discipline or four years of relevant job experience in an equivalent position. * Must possess a strong regard for safety. * Familiarity with engineering practices and a basic knowledge of the engineering procedures in an electric generating station. * Ability to make technical calculations, determinations and prepare reports. * Ability to use engineering handbooks and manuals in performing work of a technical nature. * Must pass a qualifying examination, if required, as determined by the Company. ### **Benefits** As a full\-time employee, the successful candidate will be eligible for full benefits, including:* Medical, Dental and Vision insurance * Health Savings Account (with Employer contribution if enrolled in a qualifying medical plan) * Life Insurance * Supplemental Pension \& Savings Plan * Paid Days Off * Holidays * Vacation * Sick Pay * Monetary incentives/Employee Incentive Plan * Paid Parental Leave * Additional Voluntary Benefits * Company will pay relocation expenses ### **About Ohio Valley Electric Corporation / Indiana \- Kentucky Electric Corporation** Ohio Valley Electric Corporation (OVEC) and its wholly owned subsidiary, Indiana\-Kentucky Electric Corporation (IKEC), were organized on October 1, 1952\. The Companies were formed by investor\-owned utilities furnishing electric service in the Ohio River Valley area and their parent holding companies for the purpose of providing the large electric power requirements projected for the uranium enrichment facilities then under construction by the Atomic Energy Commission (AEC) near Portsmouth, Ohio. OVEC, AEC and OVEC’s owners or their utility company affiliates (called Sponsoring Companies) entered into power agreements to ensure the availability of the AEC’s substantial power requirements. On October 15, 1952, OVEC and AEC executed a 25\-year agreement, which was later extended through December 31, 2005 under a Department of Energy (DOE) Power Agreement. On September 29, 2000, the DOE gave OVEC notice of cancellation of the DOE Power Agreement. On April 30, 2003, the DOE Power Agreement terminated in accordance with the notice of cancellation. OVEC and the Sponsoring Companies signed an Inter\-Company Power Agreement (ICPA) on July 10, 1953, to support the DOE Power Agreement and provide for excess energy sales to the Sponsoring Companies of power not utilized by the DOE or its predecessors. Since the termination of the DOE Power Agreement on April 30, 2003, OVEC’s entire generating capacity has been available to the Sponsoring Companies under the terms of the ICPA. The Sponsoring Companies and OVEC entered into an Amended and Restated ICPA, effective as of August 11, 2011, which extends its term to June 30, 2040\. **Why is OVEC/IKEC committed to Diversity, Equity and Inclusion (DEI)?** Our Values of Respect and Innovation are key components directly related to our DEI commitment. Diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging strengthens and enhances our culture. Treating others the way we want to be treated and valuing each person’s talents, perspectives, and experiences promotes and builds an innovative environment.

jobs.title: Full Stack Engineer
jobs.description: **Why Gravitate?** At Gravitate, we’re on a mission to put everyday supply and logistics decisions in motion, powered by innovative problem\-solving from industry experts. A lot of companies say it. We mean it: Gravitate is different. Rooted in the spirit of collaboration, we thrive on the smarts of our people and the dynamic we’ve cultivated. **Tell Me About My Job:** If you are considering this role, you are someone who has moved past needing a fully specified ticket. Hand you a feature of moderate complexity and you break it into tasks, deliver it on time, and raise the risks you spot along the way instead of surfacing them late. You’ll own features and components within your product area in Gravitate’s fuel logistics platform, and you’ll be responsible for the quality and ongoing maintenance of what you build — not just the first version that shipped. This is a genuinely full\-stack role. You’ll write Python on the service and API side, model data in MongoDB, and build the React and TypeScript interfaces on top — following a feature from the data model through the API to the screen a dispatcher actually uses. We expect you to be strong on one side of that and genuinely willing to contribute on the other. You’ll also be a reliable member of the on\-call rotation for your product area — debugging incoming bugs and incidents independently, and contributing to the monitoring, observability, and performance improvements that make your area healthier over time. This is a role with room to grow, and we’ll be explicit with you about what the next level looks like. Engineers who do well here start by delivering medium\-sized work accurately and reliably, then take on larger and more ambiguous projects, carry more weight in design discussions, and begin mentoring the engineers behind them. We’re strongly against artificial separations of responsibility and throwing work “over the wall.” As an engineer here, you’re part of the product team — in the room for the product conversation, not downstream of it. **You’re an Ideal Candidate If:** * You deliver reliably. You can take a medium or large\-sized feature with real unknowns, break it into tasks, estimate it honestly, and land it. When something threatens the date, you say so early. * You work end\-to\-end. You’re not precious about which layer a problem lives in. You’ll follow an issue from the UI through the API to the query and fix it where it actually belongs. * You write code other people can live with. Well\-tested, readable, and consistent with the codebase around it. You debug your own problems before escalating them. * You’re building your design judgment. You bring viable alternatives to design discussions rather than waiting to be told, and you can write a clear design doc for a feature in your area. * You give and take feedback well. Your code review comments are specific and constructive. You’re receptive to feedback on your own work and you act on it. * You’re curious about the business. You want to understand what fuel supply and logistics teams actually do with this software, because knowing that makes every decision you make a better one. * You want to work in an AI\-enabled workflow. You see the impact of AI on code generation and are willing and able to see how it can make you more productive. You want to help in building the harness around it so that the team can get more done. **Duties/Responsibilities:** * Independently deliver features of moderate complexity on time — breaking work into manageable tasks, estimating accurately with some unknowns, and raising risks early * Build features end\-to\-end across the stack: Python services and APIs, MongoDB data models, and React/TypeScript interfaces * Own features and components within your product area — accountable for their quality and ongoing maintenance * Contribute to design discussions with viable alternatives; produce clear technical designs for features within your area * Write well\-tested, readable code and help improve our automated testing practices and coverage * Be a reliable member of the on\-call rotation — debug and resolve small\-to\-medium bugs, incidents, and issues in your product area independently * Contribute to monitoring, observability, and performance improvements within your product area * Provide constructive, specific code review feedback; informally mentor engineers newer than you * Write clear technical documents; communicate status, risks, and blockers clearly to your team **Required Qualifications:** * 3\+ years of professional software engineering experience building and shipping production software * Proficiency in both a server\-side language (Python preferred) and TypeScript/React — or real depth in one, plus a demonstrated track record of picking up the other * Demonstrated ability to independently deliver medium\-sized features with some unknowns, on time * Able to debug and resolve small\-to\-medium issues independently, across both the frontend and the backend * Experience writing well\-tested code, plus working knowledge of CI/CD and deployment practices * Comfortable participating in an on\-call rotation for the product area you own * Clear written and verbal communication — able to produce small\-to\-medium technical documents and give constructive code review feedback * Receptive to feedback and actively acts on it * Openness to utilizing and becoming an expert in AI\-assisted development to supercharge your ability to get stuff done. **Nice to Have Experience:** * Hands\-on experience with our stack: Python, React and TypeScript, MongoDB, Kubernetes, GCP or Azure * Experience in a B2B SaaS or enterprise software environment * Background in a logistics, supply chain, or energy/fuel domain * Experience with data\-dense enterprise interfaces — large tables and grids, scheduling views, or real\-time updates * AI engineering experience – working with production agentic systems and ML / operations models. **About the Gravitate Team:** To understand who our people are, you should first understand what they’re not: replaceable. Each member of the team is chosen carefully and with intention. We believe that finding the right fit is more important than a laundry list of credentials – and that people are people first, and titles second. Because we hire the Gravitate way, our team is certainly one of a kind. We’ve brought together incredible talent that regularly collaborates to create clean, fresh solutions. That effort has led to remarkable opportunities, including work with many Fortune 500 clients. We’ve found that the winning combination of exciting achievements, trust in one another and open communication lays the groundwork for long\-lasting, successful careers. That, and the fact that we clap for each other at every opportunity. Problem solvers, go\-getters and charge\-takers — we (really) want to hear from you.

jobs.title: Full-Stack Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Title:** Full\-Stack Software Engineer **Team:** Engineering **Location:** Onsite \- Sawtelle (Between Santa Monica \& West LA) or San Francisco, CA **Employment Type:** Full\-time, Salary, Exempt **Reports To:** Engineering Lead **About Plug** -------------- Plug is an automotive fintech startup building the marketplace for electric vehicles. Consumers, dealers, and commercial partners trade in, sell, and auction used EVs through a platform built exclusively for electric, with nothing adapted from legacy automotive. Consumers can get an instant cash offer in minutes, backed by data\-driven pricing, battery state\-of\-health analysis, with pickup, payment, and title transfer handled end\-to\-end. Franchise and independent dealers across the United States bid in real time on inventory sourced directly from these consumers, dealers, and commercial partners. The result is a single platform that gives sellers a fast, fair exit and gives dealers a dedicated channel for sourcing used EV inventory. Founded in 2023 and led by former Tesla executives, Plug has facilitated $100M in EV sales since launch and is backed by a $20M Series A from Lightspeed Venture Partners. We're building the most AI\-native startup team in Los Angeles, full of operators, engineers, and ML researchers laying the transaction rails for the used EV market's exponential growth. **Why Plug** ------------ * You'll own a piece of the biggest infrastructure opportunity in automotive. * You'll work on a platform built exclusively for EVs, with nothing adapted from legacy automotive. * You'll be part of an AI\-native company. We're rethinking how work gets done at a fundamental level. * You'll work directly with operators who have scaled multi\-billion dollar businesses in automotive, EV, and marketplaces. * You'll have real ownership, high autonomy, and a direct line to company outcomes. **The Opportunity** ------------------- We are looking for a Full\-Stack Software Engineer to join our growing team! A full\-stack software engineer who will report to our engineering lead, and who will own features and components within our products \- working closely with senior software engineers (SSEs) on scope, architecture, and cross\-system tradeoffs. We're building systems like AI\-powered pricing intelligence, real\-time connectivity to vehicle manufacturer APIs, auction application, and data pipelines that aggregate EV\-specific information from dozens of sources \- all to make the wholesale EV market faster, smarter, and more transparent. As a member of the team you'll help build the technical and product foundation for our growing business, with direct mentorship from senior engineers as you grow into more ownership. We're building a culture that cares about collaboration, encourages intellectual honesty, celebrates technical excellence, and is driven by careful attention to detail and planning for the future. We believe diversity of perspective and experience are key to building great technology and a thriving team. Sounds cool? Let's work together. **What You’ll Do** ------------------ * Collaborate with colleagues and contribute your voice in product design sessions, architecture discussions, and code reviews. * Design, implement, test, debug, and document work on new and existing software features, ensuring they meet business, quality, and operational needs. * Take ownership of features, with support from SSEs on architecture or cross\-system tradeoffs, understanding the ultimate goal and evaluating effort and priority in an agile environment. * Use agentic coding tools to write clear, efficient, and maintainable code, growing your judgment on flexibility and scalability with guidance from senior engineers. * Contribute to team productivity and process improvements. * Use and integrate APIs to connect Plug with 3rd party platforms. * Contribute to code review and pairing, and reach out to SSEs to spark good technical discussions \- including how you use AI tools. * Be an integral part of a close team of developers; this is an opportunity to grow quickly with direct mentorship from senior engineers as the team scales. **What You’ll Bring** --------------------- * 3\+ years of hands\-on experience developing and delivering production applications. * Solid proficiency in TypeScript across the full stack \- backend, frontend, relational databases, and API/webhook integrations. * Experience deploying and operating cloud\-hosted applications; comfort with CI/CD pipelines and observability tooling, with interest in infrastructure\-as\-code (we use Terraform) and feature flag systems. * Comfortable working in agent\-first development workflows \- defining clear acceptance criteria and reviewing AI\-generated output with a high quality bar. * A strong engineering quality bar \- writing tests, participating in code reviews, and producing code that is readable by both humans and AI agents. * Track record of owning work end\-to\-end: scoping, shipping, and measuring impact, with growing autonomy. * Startup or fast\-paced team experience is a plus. * Authorized to work in the US for any employer. * Prior experience in automotive or EV systems is a plus. **Compensation** ---------------- Annual salary: $145,000 \- $175,000 *Salary ranges reflect independent, third\-party benchmarking against national compensation data. Where an individual's actual offer falls within that range depends on a combination of factors, including relevant experience, specialized skills, training and qualifications, current business needs, and prevailing market conditions. jobs.title: Gameplay Engineer
jobs.description: **About Us** ============ We are a Las Vegas based game studio born on the Roblox platform and built by people who genuinely love this community. As a community\-first studio, we care as much about our worlds and players as we do about the people building them. That mindset has helped us grow into one of the most innovative teams on Roblox, pushing boundaries, shaping culture, and setting new standards across the platform. With over 7B game visits, 35M monthly players, and a 16M member community, our worlds have become a core part of the Roblox ecosystem. We’re a ten time winner of the Roblox Innovation Awards and recognized as builders of the future of the platform. From Creatures of Sonaria and Dragon Adventures to World // Zero and Horse Life, we create experiences that players live in, not just visit. **What are we looking for?** ============================ We are now looking for a Roblox Gameplay Engineer who shares that passion and wants to help shape what comes next. In this role, you’ll bring our worlds to life by implementing and refining gameplay content on Roblox. You’ll work closely with designers to build mechanics, set up interactive systems, and make sure every moment feels smooth, fun, and memorable. If you want to build games that millions of players care about, this is the place to do it. **Responsibilities:** ===================== * Implement and integrate gameplay content using Roblox Studio and Lua scripting. * Partner with designers to bring features and mechanics to life. * Set up and configure in\-game assets, interactive objects, and gameplay systems. * Debug and optimize content to ensure smooth performance. * Collaborate with engineers and artists to refine existing features. * Support iteration and polish of gameplay experiences to enhance player engagement. **Requirements:** ================= * 3\-5 years Experience working in Roblox Studio and scripting with Lua. * Understanding of Roblox’s gameplay systems, physics, and UI mechanics. * Strong problem\-solving skills and the ability to troubleshoot gameplay issues. * Ability to work in a team environment and communicate effectively. * Passion for game development and creating engaging player experiences. * Familiarity with Roblox API and best practices for performance optimization. * Experience with datastores, leaderboards, or gamepasses in Roblox. * Understanding of animation and character interactions in Roblox Studio. **Bonus Skills:** ================= * Experience designing and programming a high\-quality Roblox game. * Strong understanding of the Roblox community and player engagement strategies. * Ability to work independently and in remote team environments. * Additional game development skills, such as UI/UX design, game design, graphic design, audio design, 3D modeling, or texturing, to support engineering work. **Location:** ============= * Fully remote, but if Vegas sounds exciting, we can chat about relocation options. **Compensation:** ================= * **$65,000 \- $110,000 \+ Bonus.** Most offers land within this range. If your experience sits outside it in either direction, we'd still like to have the conversation.

jobs.title: Level 1 Process Automation Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Details** **Division:** **Nucor Steel West Virginia LLC** **Location:** **Apple Grove, WV, United States** **Other Available Locations:** **N/A** **Welcome to Nucor, where our unique culture sets us apart. Joining Nucor means becoming part of North America's largest steel and steel products manufacturer, offering unmatched career opportunities and stability. We are known for our innovative sustainability practices and are the continent's largest recycler. Our vibrant culture, built on personal connections and teamwork, empowers every team member with the freedom to innovate and contribute to our collective success. Experience a workplace where safety, efficiency, and meaningful personal connections define every day, enriching both our teammates and the communities we serve.** **Nucor supports its teammates with top\-tier benefits like Medical, Dental, Vision, and Disability Insurance, 401K and Roth accounts, Profit sharing, Pay\-for\-performance bonuses, Paid parental leave, Tuition reimbursement, Stock program, Scholarships and more.** **Basic Job Functions:** ------------------------ Nucor Steel West Virginia is seeking a **Level 1 Process Automation Engineer**. The Process Automation Engineer will work alongside the maintenance and operations teams to ensure the safe and efficient operation of the plant. While working as part of the process automation team, the engineer will lead by example with respect to safety, reliability, quality, costs,process improvement,and project management. The engineer will primarily focus on the optimal performance of the process control systems of their assigned area of responsibility through continual improvement initiatives. The engineer will focus on understanding and improving the core process models as needed for continual process improvement. The engineer is expected to have deep understanding of the underlying technology (i.e. software, communications, databases, etc.) making up the level 1 and 2 systems, but the main focus should be on the sheet steel making process including the mechanical and electrical controls to aid in analyzing and solving process problems. The engineer should be able to understand how the level 1 and level 2 control systems work together to form the automated control of the process. When additional technology focused skills are required, the engineer will work with assistance from the Process Automation level 1 and level 2 engineers and the rest of the Nucor team. The engineer will provide technical leadership within their area of responsibility, promoting collaboration and effective cross\-functional communication between operations, maintenance, quality, engineering, and project teams to support safe and efficient plant performance. It should be noted that the level 1 and 2 distinction is in reference to the automation system architecture (see ISA\-95 and/or Purdue hierarchy of control) and is not indicative of seniority or degree of responsibility. The level 1 systems at Nucor Steel West Virginia will consist of different PLCs, HMIs, industrial communication networks, distributed remote I/O, drives and motor controls, hydraulic controls, etc. In addition to auxiliary controls like hydraulic pump control or product sequencing, the level 1 systems include more complex subsystems such as line tension control, line speed control, mill stand control, furnace control, etc. The level 2 systems at Nucor Steel West Virginia will consist of a wide variety of applications running on a mix of physical and virtual machines using various programming languages. These applications will store and transfer process data utilizing databases, message queue and direct message communication, generate product setups using physics\-based models, perform product setup optimizations, and other duties as assigned. This is a Monday through Friday on\-site position and may require scheduled and unscheduled overtime. Safety is the most important part of all jobs within Nucor; therefore, candidates must be able to demonstrate the ability to initiate, lead, and uphold safety policies, practices, procedures, and housekeeping standards at all times. **Minimum Qualifications:** --------------------------- * Four\-year degree in Engineering/Computer Science/Mathematics/Physics/Chemistry or related field and/or equivalent experience. * Four (4\) years of experience in industrial process control/automation within the manufacturing industry. **Preferred Qualifications:** ----------------------------- * Ability to apply kinematics, thermodynamics, metallurgical/material science concepts towards process improvement solutions * Industrial process control/automation equipment upgrade experience * Experience working in a heavy industrial environment * Experience working with level 1 automation control systems (e.g. PLCs, drives, HMIs,hydraulic controls) and/or level 2 automation control systems (e.g. system databases, setup models, C/C\+\+/C\# applications) * Experience working in a sheet steel mill * Experience working with data within SQL databases and other process data acquisition tools (i.e. IBA) ***Nucor is an Equal Opportunity Employer and a drug\-free workplace***

Cross\-Functional Leadership * Collaborate with the Research \& Development (R\&D) team to translate scientific advancements and emerging technologies into commercially viable products and solutions. * Partner with Business Development to provide technical leadership during customer evaluations, proposal development, technology reviews, and commercial negotiations. * Work closely with Operations and Implementation teams to ensure products are designed for efficient deployment, operation, and maintenance. * Serve as a key technical resource for customers, partners, and stakeholders. jobs.title: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer – Key Accounts (AI Solutions)
jobs.description: Aircall is a unicorn, AI\-powered customer communications platform used by 22,000\+ companies worldwide to drive revenue, resolve issues faster, and scale customer\-facing teams. We're redefining customer communications by bringing voice, SMS, WhatsApp, and AI together into one seamless workspace. Our momentum comes from a simple idea: help teams work smarter, not harder. Aircall's AI Voice Agent automates routine calls, AI Assist streamlines post\-call work, and AI Assist Pro delivers real\-time guidance so people can do their best work. The result is higher revenue, faster resolutions, and teams that scale with confidence. Aircall is headquartered in Paris, our European HQ, with a strong North American presence anchored in Seattle, our North American HQ, and teams across Madrid, London, Berlin, San Francisco, New York City, Sydney, and Mexico City. We've built a product customers love and a business that's scaling quickly, backed by world\-class investors and driven by rapid AI innovation across multiple product lines. At Aircall, you'll join a company in motion. We're ambitious, product\-driven, and execution\-focused, with visible impact, fast decisions, and real growth. **How we work at Aircall**: We're customer\-obsessed, data\-driven, and focused on delivering meaningful outcomes. We value ownership, continuous learning, and thoughtful speed. If you thrive in a collaborative, fast\-moving environment where trust and impact matter, you'll feel at home here. ***The embedded technical partner for a focused portfolio of Aircall's most strategic global accounts, driving agentic AI adoption use case by use case, in lockstep with Key Account Managers, from a first deployed use case to platform\-wide expansion.*** #### **About the Team** Aircall's Forward Deployed Engineering team connects our innovative AI Agents technology to real\-world customer workflows. We turn possibility into production by delivering automation that improves customer experience, boosts productivity, and unlocks new business value. Working cross\-functionally with Product, Engineering, Sales, Solutions, and Customer Success, the team ensures every deployment delivers measurable impact. Within that team, this is a senior, Key Accounts–focused role for someone who wants to go deep rather than broad — embedding with a portfolio of Aircall's most strategic global customers and growing agentic adoption inside each one over time. It sits at the intersection of technical consulting, project leadership, and AI adoption strategy. *You don't need to be a full\-time software engineer, but you should be fluent in APIs, highly confident leading complex technical engagements, and credible in the room with senior customer stakeholders.* #### **About the Role** As a Senior Forward Deployed Engineer for Key Accounts, you are the embedded technical owner for a portfolio of Aircall's highest\-value global customers. You don't run a deployment and move on — you stay with the account, building a long\-term agentic roadmap alongside the Key Account Manager (KAM). You land a first high\-impact use case, prove value fast, then systematically expand the footprint use case by use case until Aircall's AI Agents are woven through the customer's core workflows. This is a high\-autonomy role: you set the technical strategy for your accounts, you're trusted in the room with customer leadership, and you act as the connective tissue between the customer, the KAM, Product, and Engineering. *Please note, this is not a software engineering role. This is a hybrid, revenue\-driving role spanning Solutions Engineering, Consulting, Professional Services, and Product Ownership* **What you'll do** * **Own a sustained, embedded relationship** with each account in your portfolio — you are the customer's go\-to technical authority on agentic AI, not a project resource who rotates off once a deployment ships. * **Partner directly with the Key Account Manager** on a joint account plan: the KAM owns the commercial relationship and quota; Even better if you have experience with MCP Servers. + Proficiency in scripting (JavaScript and/or Python) — used to build, customise, and debug integrations, not just read them. + Hands\-on experience with low\-code orchestration tools (Zapier, Make, n8n, Workato) and CRM automation (HubSpot, Salesforce). + Practical understanding of AI workflow configuration, including prompt engineering, evaluation, and monitoring. * Proven ability to lead complex, cross\-functional programs with Engineering, Product, and Customer Success to deliver scalable outcomes. * Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, translating fluently between technical and business audiences. * A growth mindset — constantly learning new tools, frameworks, and ways to improve the customer experience and team capability. * Nice\-to\-haves + Experience in telephony, voice, or contact centre systems (SIP/WebRTC, call routing, containment, AHT). + Familiarity with BI and analytics tools (Looker, BigQuery, Snowflake). #### **What success looks like** * **Depth and expansion within each account** — a growing number of live agentic use cases, and adoption spreading into new teams and buying centres over time. * **Net revenue retention and expansion MRR** across your portfolio, driven jointly with the KAM. * **Trusted\-partner status** — reflected in access, executive relationships, and roadmap influence, not just tickets closed. * **Shortened time\-to\-first\-value** on the initial use case, then a repeatable path to use case two and beyond. * **Reusable frameworks and models** actively used by peers and partners on other Key Account engagements. * **Strong collaboration with Engineering and Product** to enhance platform capabilities. * **Sustained improvements in customer metrics** (containment, AHT, CSAT) and revenue impact (ARR, NRR) driven by your solutions. **Why join us?** Key moment to join Aircall in terms of growth and opportunities ‍️ customer challenges into clearly defined use cases, technical requirements, and measurable success criteria. * Develop the technical strategy for opportunities in partnership with the account team, data, analytics, AI, IT, security, and business stakeholders. * Communicate effectively across audiences, from hands\-on practitioners to senior executives. ### **Design and Demonstrate Solutions** * Map customer requirements to KNIME capabilities across data access, transformation, analytics, automation, AI, application delivery, governance, and deployment. * Build and deliver compelling demonstrations that reflect the customer’s environment, priorities, and business outcomes rather than relying on generic feature presentations. * Use workshops, solution design sessions, prototypes, and proofs of concept when they are the best way to advance customer confidence and decision\-making. * Define clear objectives and exit criteria for technical evaluations and keep evaluations focused on the capabilities required to make a buying decision. * Translate technical capabilities into measurable outcomes such as productivity gains, reduced operational cost, faster time to insight, improved governance, and reduced risk. ### **Guide Enterprise Architecture and Technical Validation** * Help customers determine how KNIME fits into their broader data, analytics, and AI architecture. architecture, identity and access management, data connectivity, APIs, authentication, security, governance, and deployment. * Help customers evaluate modern AI and GenAI use cases, including responsible AI adoption, model and provider integration, workflow orchestration, governance, and operationalization. * Partner with security, architecture, product, and other specialists when deeper expertise is required. ### **Grow the Customer Relationship** * Look beyond the initial use case to identify opportunities for broader adoption across teams, departments, workflows, and business processes. * Surface new use cases and technical expansion opportunities to the account and customer success teams. * Help customers envision how successful individual workflows can evolve into **Contribute to a High\-Performing Solutions Organization** * Maintain accurate technical context, solution strategy, evaluation status, and technical win criteria in Salesforce. * Bring customer, that increase the effectiveness of the broader team. * Share expertise with peers and contribute to a culture of learning, experimentation, and continuous improvement. * Stay current on developments in analytics, data engineering, AI, GenAI, cloud architecture, and the broader enterprise data ecosystem. #### **Requirements** * 5\+ years of experience in Solutions Engineering, Sales Engineering, Pre\-Sales, technical consulting, data consulting, or a comparable customer\-facing technical role in enterprise software. * Demonstrated ability to lead discovery, design solutions, deliver compelling demonstrations, and guide complex technical evaluations. * Strong understanding of modern data and analytics concepts, including data integration, transformation, ETL/ELT, analytics, automation, machine learning, and AI. * Familiarity with SQL and at least one common analytical or programming environment such as Python or R. * Working knowledge of enterprise SaaS and cloud architecture, including APIs, authentication, SSO/identity, security, governance, and integration patterns. * Growing fluency with modern AI and GenAI architectures, including LLMs, AI providers, retrieval and data access patterns, agents, governance, and responsible AI considerations. * Strong business acumen and the ability to connect technology decisions to business outcomes. * Excellent presentation, storytelling, workshop facilitation, and executive communication skills. * Ability to navigate complex, multi\-stakeholder enterprise buying processes while remaining focused on the customer’s desired outcomes. * Comfort operating with autonomy, prioritizing across multiple opportunities, and collaborating across a matrixed organization. **Preferred Experience** ------------------------ * Hands\-on experience with KNIME Analytics Platform or KNIME Business Hub. * Experience with adjacent data and analytics platforms such as Alteryx, Dataiku, Databricks, Snowflake, or similar enterprise technologies. * Experience selling or supporting enterprise SaaS, analytics, data, automation, or AI platforms. * Experience working with cloud environments such as \& development support**, including training, online learning resources, and opportunities to attend conferences * **Employee referral program** * **Regular team events** and opportunities to connect with colleagues across our international organization #### **About us** KNIME is a leading AI platform that enables organisations to make sense of their data through intuitive, scalable, and You will develop test hardware and software, execute acceptance and qualification test campaigns, and work alongside Responsible Engineers and Manufacturing Engineers to make our avionics more testable, more reliable, and faster to build. This posting covers entry\-level through staff\-level positions, and leveling will be commensurate with experience.### **What you'll do:** * Own the full lifecycle of avionics unit test systems: architecture definition, rack design (DCR, PDR, CDR, TRR), implementation, validation, and production sustainment * Design and develop automated test systems including COTS equipment selection, custom PCBA and harness design, and fixturing to verify UUT functionality and exercise failure modes * Write test automation software in Python, C/C\+\+, or similar languages to interface with units under test, test equipment, and production data platforms (MES and test data archive) * test software to verify UUT functionality, exercise failure modes, and interface with production data platforms (MES and test data archive) * Partner with Responsible Engineers and Manufacturing Engineers to provide Design for Test (DFT) feedback, improve test coverage, and increase product reliability and yield * Own flight hardware through environmental screening, including thermal, vibration, TVAC, and burn\-in, and serve as the primary contact for issues or stoppages * Root cause test anomalies and production failures, drive corrective actions to closure, and support vehicle\-level failure investigations as needed ### **What you'll bring:** **Basic Qualifications*** Bachelor's degree in a science, technology, engineering, mathematics (STEM) related field * 1\+ years of experience with avionics development, hardware test, manufacturing, or test automation, including hardware and software responsibilities * Experience with test equipment and measurement techniques, such as oscilloscopes, DMMs, DAQs, and electronic loads, to verify and validate electronic hardware requirements **Preferred Qualifications*** Programming experience in Python, C/C\+\+, or a similar language * Experience designing and validating automated test racks, including custom PCBAs, signal conditioning, instrumentation selection, and wire harness design * Experience with SMC\-S\-016, MIL\-STD\-810, or other environmental testing standards, including shock, thermal, burn\-in, TVAC, vibration, and EMI/EMC testing * Experience with avionics hardware such as power electronics, motor controllers, GNC sensors, optics, RF devices, or communication interfaces including Ethernet, RS\-422, RS\-485, and CAN * Experience with schematic capture, PCB layout, or wire harness design using Altium Designer or equivalent tools * Experience reading electrical schematics and understanding electronics manufacturing processes to analyze and improve test coverage * Experience with embedded software development, firmware integration, and nonconformance, MRB, or corrective action processes in a flight hardware production environment * For senior and staff levels: experience leading test campaigns from kickoff through test report, mentoring engineers, and setting standards for test system development and validation ### **Benefits and Perks** * Join a team of best\-in\-class engineers building the foundation of planetary surface exploration * Equity ownership in the company * Comprehensive health benefits, including medical, dental, vision, and mental health support * 401(k) plan with company match * Flexible PTO and parental leave * Weekly lunch stipend, plus complimentary snacks and beverages on\-site * Once a month social hour on\-site with food and drinks ### **About Astrolab** Having a strong, inclusive, and inspired team is essential to accomplishing our bold mission. Employees are our biggest asset, and we are deeply committed to them and our values. At Astrolab we… **Demonstrate and inspire trust.** Interactions are direct, honest, and respectful. We are fair and transparent with what we do and why. **Thrive in balance.** Balance gives us perspective and keeps us motivated and inspired. We commit to rewarding work and a fulfilling personal life. **Seek diverse perspectives.** We ask questions, engage in productive debate and offer alternatives to ensure our solutions and products are robust and a reflection of our collective best. **Move with purpose.** Quality and reliability are accomplished through efficient ideation and iteration. We act with a sense of urgency and deliver what we promise, always with the big picture in mind. **Make an impact.** We intentionally move our community and industry into the future through our work, practices, and actions.

jobs.title: Staff / Lead Full Stack Software Engineer - Mobile & Web
jobs.description: About ATI: Automated Tire (ATI) is a Series\-B startup revolutionizing automotive service with innovative robotic and software technology. Founded by experienced entrepreneurs and backed by major players in the automotive and tire sectors, ATI is building the next generation of tools that make tire shops and dealership service lanes faster, safer, and smarter. If you're passionate about building products that ship into real\-world environments, ATI is the place for you. Position Overview: We're looking for a Staff/Lead Full Stack Software Engineer to own BrakeWise — our production brake inspection application — along with the customer dashboard it feeds. BrakeWise is in the field today, shipping to iOS through the Apple App Store and to Android and Windows through Expo, and technicians rely on it during live service work. This is not a greenfield build: you'll be taking ownership of a product that already has customers, and growing it. You'll own both surfaces end to end. On mobile, that's the React Native app, its hardware integrations, and every release that reaches a device. On web, that's the React/Bun.js customer dashboard and the GCP services behind it. The person in this role sets the technical direction for both, and is accountable for what production looks like on a Tuesday afternoon in a busy shop. This is a hands\-on technical leadership role. You'll write code daily, make architectural decisions that shape the product's trajectory, and mentor a growing engineering team. Because the product is already in customers' hands, release discipline, observability, and upgrade paths matter as much as new features. Responsibilities:* Own BrakeWise end to end — architecture, feature development, release management, and production support across iOS, Android, and Windows * Own the React/Bun.js customer dashboard, from interface through to the services behind it * Run the full deployment lifecycle for both surfaces: App Store submission and review, Expo/EAS builds and OTA updates, staged rollouts, versioning, and rollback * Own the web deployment stack on GCP — Cloud Functions, Firebase, Cloud SQL, and containerized services * Design and maintain the cloud backend that ingests, processes, and stores inspection data (images, measurements, structured results) * Develop and consume RESTful APIs and integration layers between the mobile app, dashboard, cloud services, and internal systems * Integrate the app with inspection hardware, including USB\-connected cameras and sensors * Implement and manage databases, messaging systems, and data pipelines supporting real\-time and batch inspection workflows * Own testing, CI/CD, monitoring, and alerting for a live product — and establish the practices that keep releases uneventful * Triage and resolve field issues reported by technicians and customers, debugging against real devices in real shop conditions * Mentor and guide engineers, fostering their growth and raising the team's technical bar * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams including product, hardware, data science, and field operations * Proactively identify technical risks and architectural trade\-offs, and communicate them clearly to leadership **Requirements** * 8\+ years of professional software development experience, with deep React and React Native expertise * Demonstrated experience owning mobile and web deployments end to end for thousands of users — app store releases, OTA updates, and web deploys, including the failures * Production experience shipping and maintaining cross\-platform React Native applications, ideally with Expo * Strong background in cloud platform architecture, preferably GCP — Cloud Functions, Firebase, Cloud SQL, and Docker * Proven experience in system architecture, API design, and hands\-on implementation * Experience with CI/CD pipelines and automation tools (e.g., GitHub Actions, EAS Build, Jenkins) * Experience with database technologies (SQL, NoSQL) and messaging systems (queues, pub/sub) * Track record of operating and supporting a live product, not just launching one * Strong understanding of software engineering principles including SOLID, clean code, and test\-driven development * Excellent problem\-solving, debugging, and communication skills **Preferred Qualifications:** * Experience with Bun.js or other modern JavaScript runtimes in production * Experience with on\-device image processing, camera integration, or computer vision in mobile apps * Experience integrating USB or Bluetooth peripherals with mobile applications * Background in offline\-first mobile architectures and data synchronization patterns * Experience with robotics, IoT, or edge computing (ROS or similar platforms) * Familiarity with automotive service, dealership operations, or DMS ecosystems * Contributions to open\-source projects **Why Join ATI:** * Be part of a groundbreaking startup transforming automotive service technology * Work with a team of industry veterans and top\-tier robotics and software talent * Own a product that's already earning revenue — and the platform it becomes next * Our customers are our investors, so you'll develop and test in real service lane environments * Clear Total Addressable Market with strong pull from B2B partners * Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package * Prime location in Woburn, MA with on\-site parking * Collaborative, low\-ego, high\-intensity work environment

jobs.title: Staff Machine Learning Operations Engineer - Computer Vision
jobs.description: About ATI: Automated Tire (ATI) is a Series\-B startup revolutionizing automotive service with innovative robotic and software technology. Founded by experienced entrepreneurs and backed by major players in the automotive and tire sectors, ATI is building the next generation of tools that make tire shops and dealership service lanes faster, safer, and smarter. If you're passionate about building products that ship into real\-world environments, ATI is the place for you. Position Overview: BrakeWise is our production brake inspection product: a mobile application paired with a camera probe that technicians use to assess pad and rotor condition during live service work. The machine learning behind it is a multi\-stage pipeline of segmentation and classification models that turn raw imagery into a wear assessment a shop can act on and charge for. That pipeline works, and it is an MVP. It runs on Cloud Functions, and it will not carry us to the customer volume we're signing. We're looking for a Staff MLOps Engineer to own it — to take it from a working prototype to a serving architecture that holds up under real throughput, with the latency, cost, and reliability characteristics a paying customer expects. You'll own every aspect of how our models reach production and how they get better: serving infrastructure, deployment and rollback, monitoring and drift detection, the retraining loop, and the evaluation discipline that tells us whether a new model is actually an improvement. Model accuracy here has commercial consequences — a bad wear call is either a missed repair or an unnecessary one, in front of a customer. This is also the senior cloud architecture voice on the team. You'll partner closely with our Staff Full Stack Engineer, who owns the mobile app and customer dashboard, reviewing designs and setting GCP practices across the platform rather than only within the ML stack. Responsibilities:* Own the multi\-stage inference pipeline (segmentors and classifiers) end to end — serving architecture, latency, throughput, reliability, and cost per inspection * Re\-architect the pipeline off its current Cloud Functions MVP onto infrastructure that scales: containerized inference, GPU\-backed or accelerated serving where it pays for itself, queueing, batching, and autoscaling * Own model deployment: versioning, staged rollout, canary and shadow evaluation, and fast rollback when a model regresses * Build and own the improvement loop — field data collection, labeling workflows, dataset versioning, evaluation harnesses, and regression suites that catch quality loss before customers do * Monitor model quality in production: drift detection, segmented performance analysis, and triage of real\-world failures against real inspection imagery * Define the metrics that matter commercially — false\-positive and false\-negative rates on a wear call, technician override rate, unit inference cost — and report against them * Improve model performance directly: architecture selection, augmentation, hard\-example mining, and quantization or distillation where latency and cost demand it * Evaluate on\-device versus cloud inference trade\-offs for the mobile app, and own whichever path we choose * Establish MLOps foundations: reproducible training, experiment tracking, CI/CD for models, and infrastructure as code * Serve as the cloud architecture counterpart to the Staff Full Stack Engineer — reviewing designs, setting GCP best practices, and raising the platform’s infrastructure bar * Work with hardware and field operations on capture quality — lighting, focus, and probe positioning — since upstream image quality sets the ceiling on model performance * Own production support for the ML stack, including incident response and on\-call participation for inference availability * Proactively identify technical risks and architectural trade\-offs, and communicate them clearly to leadership **Requirements** * 8\+ years of professional engineering experience, including several years owning machine learning systems in production — not solely model development * Demonstrated experience taking a computer vision pipeline from prototype to production scale, serving real users at meaningful volume * Deep experience deploying and operating segmentation and classification models, including multi\-stage pipelines where one model’s output feeds the next * Strong cloud infrastructure background, preferably GCP — Vertex AI, Cloud Run, GKE, Cloud Functions, Cloud SQL, Pub/Sub, and Docker * Production\-grade Python, and fluency with PyTorch or TensorFlow * Hands\-on experience with model serving and optimization — Triton, TorchServe, ONNX, TensorRT, quantization, or equivalent * Experience owning deployment and support for a live system, including incident response, rollback, and on\-call * Experience building data and labeling pipelines with dataset versioning and reproducible evaluation * Comfort with infrastructure as code (e.g., Terraform) and CI/CD automation (e.g., GitHub Actions) * Sound judgment on the accuracy, latency, and cost trade\-offs that determine whether an ML product is viable * Excellent problem\-solving, debugging, and communication skills, including with non\-technical stakeholders **Preferred Qualifications:** * On\-device or edge inference experience (Core ML, TensorFlow Lite, ExecuTorch) and integration into mobile applications * Active learning or human\-in\-the\-loop labeling systems * Computer vision on small, long\-tail, or industrial inspection datasets rather than large public benchmarks * Experience with camera and sensor integration, or working alongside hardware teams on capture quality * Experience with robotics, IoT, or edge computing (ROS or similar platforms) * Familiarity with automotive service, dealership operations, or DMS ecosystems * Contributions to open\-source projects **Why Join ATI:** * Be part of a groundbreaking startup transforming automotive service technology * Work with a team of industry veterans and top\-tier robotics and software talent * Own the ML platform for a product that already has paying customers — your architecture decisions set the scaling ceiling * Our customers are our investors, so you'll develop and test in real service lane environments * A genuine data advantage: proprietary inspection imagery from real shops that no public dataset can replicate * Clear Total Addressable Market with strong pull from B2B partners * Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package * Prime location in Woburn, MA with on\-site parking * Collaborative, low\-ego, high\-intensity work environment

jobs.title: Healthcare Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: **We Are:** The beginning of a new Data \& AI decade that will reshape work and society has begun. Accenture is stepping boldly into this future with a clear strategy and purpose: to help clients optimize and reinvent their business with data \& AI — backed by a $3B investment and commitment to our people to do industry\-defining work. With over 45,000 professionals dedicated to Data \& AI, Accenture’s Data \& AI organization brings together our Experienced Innovation, Strategic Investment, Exceptional Talent, and Power Ecosystem. **You Are:** **Provider** An AI Native Engineer that brings deep technical and domain expertise to AI programs at provider organizations — designing solutions that work inside the realities of the electronic medical record and clinical workflows, extending to the administrative side of care where AI can ease the burden of documentation, prior authorization, coding, and revenue cycle. You'll help providers put AI to work across both the clinical and operational realities of their environment and help define the future of healthcare interoperability. **Payer** An AI Native Engineer that brings deep technical and domain expertise to AI programs at health plans — designing solutions that work inside the realities of core administrative platforms and the claims and member data that flow through them, where AI can ease the burden of adjudication, prior authorization, utilization management, and member and provider service. You'll help payers put AI to work across both the operational and clinical realities of their environment and help define the future of healthcare interoperability. **The Work:** * Embed with provider teams. Work forward\-deployed inside health systems, hospitals, and physician groups – alongside clinical informatics, physicians and nurses, and revenue\-cycle and operations leaders – redesigning processes around AI and co\-creating solutions using AI tooling to move quickly from idea to working solution. * Scope the program. Lead the technical architecture of AI programs in provider environments and articulate it clearly, on paper and in diagrams, for engineers and clinical leaders alike. * Design for trust. agentic solutions (agents, orchestration, context engineering, RAG, workflows) in production * Minimum of 3 years of experience hands\-on coding in at least one general\-purpose language (e.g., Python, Java) and the ability to pick up others as engagements demand * Minimum of 3 years of experience with hands\-on production deployment experience — CI/CD, infrastructure as code (Terraform, Helm), monitoring, and debugging — with demonstrated end\-to\-end delivery ownership in a client\-embedded environment * Minimum of1 year of experience delivering AI or technology programs inside payer organizations. * Minimum of 1 year of hands\-on experience using Claude or an equivalent frontier AI tool to do the work. * Bachelor's degree (or equivalent minimum 12 years work experience, or minimum 6 years' work experience with Associate's degree) in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field. **Professional Skills Requirements:** * Deep understanding of how core administrative and claims platforms work and how claims and member data are structured, with direct QNXT, Facets, HealthEdge, or comparable experience * Fluency with data — non\-trivial SQL, relational modeling, and reasoning about data quality and data lineage * Working knowledge of healthcare interoperability standards and EDI mechanisms: X12 transaction flows (837, 835, 270/271, Distill what works across providers into repeatable methods and accelerators, so each program starts further ahead than the last. Travel may be required for this role. The amount of travel will vary from 0 to 100% depending on business need and client requirements. **Here's what you need** * Minimum of 3 years of hands\-on engineering experience with cloud\-native systems — APIs, microservices, containerization, and serverless — including working with AI platforms (Claude, OpenAI, Vertex AI, or open\-source models) and at least 1 year designing and deploying agentic solutions (agents, orchestration, context engineering, RAG, workflows) in production * Minimum of 3 years of experience hands\-on coding in at least one general\-purpose language (e.g., Python, Java) and the ability to pick up others as engagements demand * Minimum of 3 years of experience with hands\-on production deployment experience — CI/CD, infrastructure as code (Terraform, Helm), monitoring, and debugging — with demonstrated end\-to\-end delivery ownership in a client\-embedded environment * Minimum of1 year of experience delivering AI or technology programs inside payer organizations. * Minimum of 1 year of hands\-on experience using Claude or an equivalent frontier AI tool to do the work. * Bachelor's degree (or equivalent minimum 12 years work experience, or
