jobs.title: Manager, People Systems Engineering (Remote Eligible)
jobs.description: For over 20 years, Smartsheet has empowered teams to manage work seamlessly and scale solutions smarter. Now, in our most ambitious chapter yet, we are uniting human teams with AI agents. By orchestrating the work agents do best, automating manual tasks and uncovering insights at scale, we create the space for people to focus on what truly matters: judgment, creativity, and big thinking. That is magic at work, and it's what we show up for every day. **Corporate Systems Engineering** builds and operates the software platforms, integrations, and automations that power Smartsheet's core business functions across Finance, Sales/GTM, and People \& Culture. Our team owns mission\-critical systems and workflows that enable how the company hires, sells, bills, pays, reports, and scales. We operate at the intersection of software engineering, enterprise platforms, and business\-critical data, treating internal systems with the same rigor, reliability, and product mindset as customer\-facing software. **People Systems Engineering** owns and evolves the technology platforms that power the employee lifecycle at Smartsheet. The team is responsible for Workday, Docebo, Greenhouse, and the broader People technology ecosystem, supporting capabilities across recruiting, onboarding, core HR, compensation, learning, talent, and employee data. We combine deep enterprise\-platform expertise with software engineering practices, using configuration, extensibility, APIs, integrations, automation, data, and AI to build reliable and scalable employee experiences. As **Manager, People Systems Engineering**, you will lead the engineering team responsible for Smartsheet's People technology ecosystem and define the long\-term technical strategy for how employee technology evolves. Workday is a critical foundation of this ecosystem, but this role extends beyond operating individual applications: you will shape the architecture, engineering practices, data strategy, automation, and emerging AI capabilities that connect our People platforms into a cohesive technology ecosystem. You will be expected to challenge existing approaches and identify opportunities to fundamentally improve how employee technology works \- simplifying processes, reducing manual administration, improving employee and manager experiences, strengthening data and system architecture, and determining where configuration, software engineering, automation, or AI can provide better solutions. **You Will:** * Own the technical strategy and long\-term architecture for the People technology ecosystem, establishing a clear future state across Workday, Docebo, Greenhouse, integrations, employee data, automation, AI, and emerging capabilities * Lead, coach, and develop the engineering team responsible for Smartsheet's People platforms, creating a culture of technical ownership, experimentation, engineering rigor, and continuous improvement * Serve as a technical leader for Workday, ensuring the platform remains well architected, maintainable, secure, scalable, and appropriately leveraged as a foundational system of record within the broader employee technology architecture * Partner with the Product Manager for People Systems to translate employee and business problems into product and technical strategies, jointly shaping roadmaps while maintaining clear engineering ownership of architecture and implementation * Continually evaluate the People technology landscape and challenge existing assumptions about how employee workflows should operate, identifying opportunities to simplify, consolidate, redesign, automate, or eliminate processes * Define architectural boundaries across People platforms, determining which capabilities should live within Workday or other SaaS applications and where APIs, integrations, custom applications, automation, or AI provide better solutions * Develop the technical strategy for People data, including authoritative sources, data models, system boundaries, data contracts, quality, lineage, access, lifecycle management, and reliable consumption by downstream systems * Drive the evolution of People Systems toward an API\-first and event\-driven ecosystem where appropriate, reducing unnecessary point\-to\-point dependencies, manual data movement, and fragile integrations * Define an AI and agentification strategy for employee technology, partnering with AI \& Automation Engineering to identify where agents, conversational experiences, intelligent workflows, and AI\-assisted processes can meaningfully improve employee and manager experiences * Identify opportunities to move employee interactions away from navigating individual systems and toward simpler, intelligent experiences that orchestrate capabilities across the underlying People technology stack * Establish a deliberate automation strategy across the employee lifecycle, reducing repetitive administration and manual handoffs across recruiting, onboarding, employee changes, compensation, learning, tal on engineering, software engineering, HR technology, systems architecture, or related technical disciplines * 2\+ years of experience managing or formally leading technical teams, with demonstrated ability to develop both people and technical capability * Strong hands\-on technical understanding of Workday, including its architecture, data model, security model, business processes, integrations, reporting, and extensibility capabilities * Demonstrated experience defining technical strategy or architecture, rather than solely managing application delivery, configuration, or support * Strong systems thinking and the ability to reason across applications, integrations, APIs, data, identity, automation, infrastructure, and employee experiences as a connected architecture * Experience determining appropriate boundaries between SaaS configuration, platform extensibility, integrations, automation, and custom software development * Experience designing or evolving enterprise data architecture, including systems of record, data models, interfaces, data contracts, quality, governance, and downstream consumption * Experience introducing modern software engineering practices into enterprise SaaS or business systems environments * Experience with testing strategy and automation, CI/CD, observability, release engineering, or other practices that improve the reliability and velocity of enterprise application development * Understanding of modern AI capabilities and the ability to identify practical applications of agents, LLMs, and intelligent automation within enterprise workflows * Experience partnering with Product Managers to combine product strategy, customer needs, and technical strategy into coherent roadmaps and investment decisions * Demonstrated ability to challenge legacy processes and architectures constructively and develop pragmatic modernization strategies rather than simply maintaining the existing environment * Ability to operate across both strategic architecture and detailed technical discussions, including the credibility to challenge engineers, vendors, implementation partners, and business stakeholders * Strong understanding of security, privacy, access control, auditability, and data protection considerations associated with sensitive employee data * Excellent analytical, verbal, and written communication skills, with the ability to communicate complex technical strategies and tradeoffs to technical and non\-technical audiences * Experience with adjacent People platforms such as Docebo, Greenhouse, or similar technologies is a plus * Experience with Workday Studio, Workday Extend, Workday APIs, cloud platforms, event\-driven architectures, AI/agent platforms, or modern automation frameworks is a strong plus **Get to Know Us:** At Smartsheet, your ideas are heard, your potential is supported, and your contributions have real impact. You'll have the freedom to explore, push boundaries, and grow beyond your role. We welcome diverse perspectives and nontraditional paths—because we know that impact comes from individuals who care deeply and challenge thoughtfully. When you're doing work that stretches you, excites you, and connects you to something bigger, that's magic at work. Let's build what's next, together. **Equal Opportunity Employer:** Smartsheet is an Equal Opportunity (EEO) employer committed to fostering an inclusive environment with the best employees. It is our policy to provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants in accordance with applicable laws in the US, UK, Australia, Germany, Costa Rica, Japan, Bulgaria, India, and Singapore. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veteran or disabled status, or genetic information. If there are preparations we can make to help ensure you have a comfortable and positive interview experience, please let us know. \#LI\-Remote

They are paid for from a variety of sources, including the Smithsonian endowment, revenue from our business activities, donations, grants and contracts. Trust employees are not part of the civil service, nor does trust fund employment lead to Federal status. The salary ranges for trust positions are generally the same as for federal positions and in many cases trust and federal employees work side by side. Trust employees have their own benefit program, which may include Health, Dental \& Vision Insurance, Life Insurance, Transit/Commuter Benefits, Accidental Death and Dismemberment Insurance, Annual and Sick Leave, Family Friendly Leave, 403b Retirement Plan, Discounts for Smithsonian Memberships, Museum Stores and Restaurants, Credit Union, Smithsonian Early Enrichment Center (Child Care), Flexible Spending Account (Health \& Dependent Care).**Conditions of Employment*** Pass Pre\-employment Background Check and Subsequent Background Investigation for position designated. * Complete a Probationary Period. * Maintain a Bank Account for Direct Deposit/Electronic Transfer. * The position is open to all candidates eligible to work in the United States. Proof of eligibility to work in U.S. is not required to apply. * Applicants must meet all qualification and eligibility requirements within 30 days of the closing date of this announcement. ### **OVERVIEW** The Software Developer plays a key role in advancing Smithsonian Enterprises (SE) technology initiatives by delivering secure, scalable, and reliable enterprise solutions. This position is responsible for the design, development, implementation, and support of business applications, system integrations, data platforms, and reporting and analytics solutions that enable operational efficiency, data\-driven decision\-making, and organizational growth. The role collaborates closely with business stakeholders and technical teams to drive continuous improvement and deliver innovative technology solutions that support SE's strategic objectives. ### **DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES** * Design, develop, test, implement, maintain, and support enterprise applications, integrations, reports, and technical solutions using Microsoft technologies, including Dynamics 365 Finance \& Operations, Azure services, Microsoft Fabric, Power Platform, and SQL Server. * Collaborate with business stakeholders, customers, and cross\-functional teams to gather, analyze, and document business and technical requirements. * Translate business requirements into technical designs, development tasks, and scalable solution architectures. * Design and implement secure, high\-quality, and maintainable solutions that meet functional, technical, performance, and supportability requirements. * Develop, test, deploy, and support customizations, extensions, integrations, reports, and automation solutions within the Microsoft technology ecosystem. * Design, develop, monitor, and support enterprise data integrations, ETL/ELT processes, data pipelines, and dataflows utilizing Azure Data Factory, Microsoft Fabric, Azure Integration Services, and related technologies. * Develop and support APIs, web services, event\-driven integrations, and data exchange processes between internal and external systems. * Design, develop, and maintain Power BI reports, dashboards, and analytics solutions to support business decision\-making and operational reporting. * Develop and execute unit, integration, system, regression, and user acceptance test plans to ensure solution quality and reliability. * Create and maintain technical documentation, solution designs, user guides, support procedures, and operational documentation. * Implement and support CI/CD pipelines, source control processes, and deployment activities using Azure DevOps, GitHub, and related DevOps tools. * Monitor system performance, troubleshoot incidents, perform root cause analysis, and implement corrective actions to maintain system stability and reliability. * Support software releases, environment management, upgrades, patches, data migrations, and deployment activities across development, test, and production environments. * Design, develop, maintain, and optimize databases, data models, and reporting structures to support application and analytics requirements. * Research, evaluate, and develop expertise in third\-party software products, services, and integration technologies. * Provide project estimates, technical assessments, status updates, and recommendations to project teams, management, and stakeholders. * Manage assigned work activities and project deliverables effectively, ensuring n technology best practices, standards, methodologies, and terminology. * Strong problem\-solving, critical\-thinking, analytical, and prioritization skills. * Highly resourceful team player with the ability to work independently and effectively within a collaborative environment. * Exceptional organizational skills, attention to detail, and a results\-oriented mindset. * Ability to manage multiple large and complex projects effectively while meeting deadlines and business objectives. * Excellent verbal, written, interpersonal, and customer\-facing communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively at all levels of the organization. * Demonstrated commitment to continuous learning, knowledge sharing, and mentoring team members. **Preferred Qualifications*** Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance \& Operations certifications. * Microsoft Azure, Data Factory, Fabric, Power Platform, or related Microsoft certifications. * Experience working within retail, e\-commerce, finance, nonprofit, government, museum, or similar enterprise environments. * Experience with Dynamics 365 Finance and Supply Chain Management implementations, upgrades, and environment refreshes. * Familiarity with security, compliance, and governance best practices related to Dynamics 365, Azure, and Microsoft Fabric. * Experience working in Agile, Scrum, or DevOps\-based software development environments. Education completed outside the United States must be deemed equivalent to higher education programs of U.S. Institutions by an organization that specializes in the interpretation of foreign educational credentials. This documentation is the responsibility of the applicant and should be included as part of your application package. Any false statement in your application may result in rejection of your application and may also result in termination after employment begins. Join us in "Inspiring Generations through Knowledge and Discovery." Resumes should include a description of your paid and non\-paid work experience that is related to this job; starting and ending dates of job (month and year); and average number of hours worked per week. What To Expect Next: Once the vacancy announcement closes, a review of your resume will be compared against the qualification and experience requirements related to this job. After review of applicant resumes is complete, qualified candidates will be referred to the hiring manager. Relocation expenses are not paid. The Smithsonian Institution provides reasonable accommodation to applicants with disabilities where appropriate. Applicants requiring reasonable accommodation should contact **SECareers@si.edu**. Determinations on requests for reasonable accommodation will be made on a case\-by\-case basis. To learn more, please review the Smithsonian’s Accommodation Procedures. The Smithsonian Institution is an **Equal Opportunity Employer**. To review The Smithsonian's EEO program information, please click the following: https://www.si.edu/oeo ### **About Smithsonian Enterprises** Smithsonian Enterprises (SE) was formed in 1999 by the Smithsonian Institution's Board of Regents to consolidate and bring professional management to the commercial activities of the Institution. jobs.description: **Sony Corporation of America** , located in New York, NY, is the U.S. headquarters of Sony Group Corporation, based in Tokyo, Japan. Sony's principal U.S. businesses include Sony Electronics Inc., Sony Interactive Entertainment LLC, Sony Music Entertainment, Sony Music Publishing and Sony Pictures Entertainment Inc. With some 900 million Sony devices in hands and homes worldwide today, a vast array of Sony movies, television shows and music, and the PlayStation Network, Sony creates and delivers more entertainment experiences to more people than anyone else on earth. To learn more: **www.sony.com/en** . **Department Overview** At the Sony Corporation of America US R\&D Laboratory , we transform bold ideas into extraordinary realities. Our engineers and scientists push boundaries through creativity and innovation to investigate emerging ideas, build prototypes, and advance solutions that reflect Sony’s high standards for quality, performance, and design . Through this work we strive to evoke Kando—the profound sense of excitement and satisfaction that comes from encountering something truly exceptiona l. **Position Summary** Sony Corporation of America currently has an opening for a Senior Research Engineer in our U.S. R\&D Laboratory located in San Jose, CA , Culver City, CA, or as a remote employee . This position is responsible for researching and developing novel AI / ML \-based image processing , computational photography , and computer vision algorithms for Sony ’s next \- generation imaging products . In this role, you will apply advanced engineering and mathematical principles to develop core technologies that power Sony's digital imaging products . jobs.description: Job ID: 42689 Location: Miramar, FL, US, 33027 Miramar, FL, US, 33027 **What You Need To Know** ------------------------- Shape a remarkable future with us. Build a career working for an industry leader that truly invests in their people – and equips them with leading technology, continuous learning, and the ability to bring their best selves to work. As North America's largest total beverage distributor, Southern Glazer’s isn't just one of Forbes’ Top Private Companies; it's a family\-owned business with deep roots dating back to 1933\. Southern Glazer’s is proud of its well\-earned positive reputation, continually achieving accolades for our outstanding workplace culture. We take pride in creating a culture where our people are valued, supported, and provided opportunities for growth and belonging. As a full\-time employee, you can choose from a wide\-ranging menu of our Top Shelf Benefits, including comprehensive medical and prescription drug coverage, dental and vision plans, tax\-saving Flexible Spending Accounts, disability coverage, life insurance plans, and a 401(k) plan. We also offer tuition assistance, a wellness program, parental leave, vacation accrual, paid sick leave, and more. By joining Southern Glazer’s, you would be part of a team that values excellence, innovation, and community. This is more than just a job – it's an opportunity to build the future of beverage distribution and grow with a company that truly cares about its people. **Overview** ------------ Experienced UiPath Automation Engineer is responsible for designing, developing, testing, deploying, and supporting Robotic Process Automation (RPA) solutions using the UiPath Automation Platform. Collaborates with business stakeholders, process owners, analysts, and technology teams to identify automation opportunities, gather requirements, and translate manual business processes into scalable, reliable, and maintainable automated workflows. Develops automation solutions using UiPath Studio and manages deployment, monitoring, and production support through UiPath Orchestrator. Designs reusable automation components, implements robust exception handling and logging, integrates automations with enterprise applications and systems, and ensures solutions comply with security, quality, performance, and governance standards. Participates across the full automation lifecycle, including process assessment, solution design, development, testing, deployment, monitoring, troubleshooting, and continuous optimization. Contributes to establishing and promoting RPA development standards, best practices, reusable frameworks, and governance processes to drive automation consistency and operational excellence across the organization. **Primary Responsibilities** ---------------------------- * Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain enterprise RPA solutions using UiPath Studio and the UiPath Automation Platform. * Translate business requirements and process documentation into scalable, reliable, and maintainable UiPath workflows. * Collaborate with business stakeholders and process owners to understand existing processes, identify automation opportunities, and determine appropriate automation approaches. * Develop workflows using UiPath best practices, including appropriate use of variables, arguments, activities, workflows, reusable components, selectors, data manipulation, and exception handling. * Develop automations that interact with a variety of business applications, including web applications, desktop applications, ERP systems, Microsoft Office applications, databases, APIs, files, and other enterprise systems. * Utilize UiPath Orchestrator to deploy, configure, schedule, monitor, and manage automation processes, including Robots, Jobs, Assets, Queues, and Processes. * Implement robust logging, exception handling, retry mechanisms, and business\-rule validation to improve automation reliability and maintainability. * Develop automations using appropriate UiPath frameworks and design patterns, including the Robotic Enterprise Framework (REFramework) when applicable. * Create and maintain reusable components, libraries, templates, and development standards to improve consistency and accelerate automation delivery. * Integrate UiPath solutions with APIs, databases, and other enterprise technologies when appropriate to deliver efficient and resilient automation solutions. * Conduct unit testing, integration testing, user acceptance testing support, and production validation of automation solutions. * Troubleshoot and resolve automation failures, application changes, selector issues, data exceptions, and other production incidents. * Monitor production automations and proactively identify opportunities to improve performance, reliability, scalability, and business value. * Maintain technical documentation, including solution designs, process definitions, workflow documentation, deployment procedures, support documentation, and exception\-handlin ing production\-grade UiPath automations. * Strong understanding of UiPath development concepts, including workflows, activities, variables, arguments, selectors, exception handling, logging, debugging, and reusable components. * Experience working with UiPath Orchestrator, including Robots, Jobs, Processes, Assets, Queues, and scheduling. * Experience integrating automation solutions with web and desktop applications, Microsoft Office, databases, APIs, file systems, and other enterprise applications. * Experience with structured development methodologies, source control, testing practices, and software development lifecycle processes. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to translate business processes and requirements into technical automation solutions. * Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * Native\-level proficiency/fluent in English. * Experience working in Agile and/or DevOps environments preferred. * UiPath certification(s), such as UiPath Certified Professional Developer, preferred. * Experience with SQL, APIs, .NET, C\#, VB.NET, JavaScript, PowerShell, or other programming/scripting technologies preferred. * Experience with cloud technologies and/or cloud\-based automation environments preferred. * Experience with process discovery, process analysis, or RPA governance preferred. **Preferred Technical Skills** ------------------------------ * UiPath Studio * UiPath Orchestrator * UiPath Robots * UiPath Queues and Assets * REFramework * UiPath Integration Service * UiPath Document Understanding and/or AI Center * REST APIs and web services * SQL and relational databases * Microsoft Excel, Outlook, Word, and other Microsoft 365 applications * JSON, XML, and data transformation * .NET / C\# / VB.NET * Git or other source\-control platforms * Agile development methodologies * CI/CD and DevOps practices **Physical Demands** -------------------- * Physical demands include a considerable amount of time sitting and typing/keyboarding, using a computer (e.g., keyboard, mouse, and monitor), or adding machine * Physical demands with activity or condition may include walking, bending, reaching, standing, squatting, and stooping * May require occasional lifting/lowering, pushing, carrying, or pulling up to 20lbs **EEO Statement** ----------------- Southern Glazer's Wine and Spirits, an Affirmative Action/EEO employer, prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type and provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training. SGWS complies with all federal, state and local laws concerning consideration of a qualified applicant's arrest and/or criminal conviction records. Southern Glazer's Wine and Spirits provides competitive compensation based on estimated performance level consistent with the past relevant experience, knowledge, skills, abilities and education of employees. Unless otherwise expressly stated, any pay ranges posted here are estimates from outside of Southern Glazer's Wine and Spirits and do not reflect Southern Glazer's pay bands or ranges. *If you have any questions or concerns about whether this posting complies/adheres with local pay transparency requirements, please contact the SGWS talent acquisition team at NationalTA@sgws.com* **Nearest Major Market:** Fort Lauderdale **Nearest Secondary Market:** Miami **Job Segment:** Testing, .NET, Cloud, Systems Engineer, Recruiting, Technology, Engineering, Human Resources

jobs.description: Collectivus Holdings is a dynamic business group encompassing brands many of the most prestigious brands in the Collecting, Trading Card Game, and Hobby industries. With a century's worth of collective experience in driving product and service innovation, high\-end quality standards, and elevated customer experience, Collectivus brands are among the most recognized and loved throughout the world by the communities they serve. **Website:** https://www.collectivusholdings.com **Locations:** Nashville – Garland – Aarhus – Lisbon – Worldwide **Job Title:** IT Systems Engineer I **Location:** Garland, Texas (Hybrid) Collectivus Holdings is seeking an IT Systems Engineer I to join our IT Operations team, supporting core enterprise systems across our family of business units. This role serves as a Level II escalation resource, working beyond frontline troubleshooting to administer Microsoft 365, Entra ID, endpoint management, and identity/access systems that keep the business running. The ideal candidate combines strong technical depth with the initiative to automate recurring work, strengthen documentation, and build the capability of the broader support team. This role partners closely with IT leadership and business stakeholders across the organization to keep core systems secure, available, and performing to standard. **Responsibilities** * Contribute to Level I support and serve as an escalation resource for issues beyond frontline troubleshooting, resolving complex hardware, software, network, and systems problems. * Administer and maintain core enterprise systems, including Microsoft 365 (Exchange Online, SharePoint, Teams, OneDrive), Entra ID, and Single Sign\-On/identity federation, ensuring availability, security, and performance across all business units. * Support identity and access management for assigned systems, assisting with SSO, MFA, and Conditional Access configuration, and handling user/group provisioning across core systems. * Support endpoint management and device lifecycle through MDM tooling (e.g., JAMF), ensuring consistent configuration, security posture, and compliance across company devices. * Contribute to infrastructure project execution, including system migrations, platform upgrades, and new technology integrations, partnering with IT leadership to scope and deliver on time. * Monitor system health and performance proactively, using available tooling to catch and remediate issues before they escalate into outages or tickets. * Develop automation (PowerShell, Power Automate, scripting) to streamline provisioning, system administration, and recurring operational work. * Partner with Security to apply patching, respond to vulnerability findings, and support endpoint security tooling (e.g., Huntress, Rapid7\) across the environment. * Support disaster recovery execution for assigned systems, assisting with backup testing, validating recovery procedures, and maintaining runbooks. * Build and maintain system\-level documentation, including configuration standards, architecture notes, and technical runbooks, to support consistency and reduce single\-person dependencies. * Provide technical guidance to the Support Specialist team on advanced troubleshooting, helping build team capability and reduce recurring escalation volume over time. * Recommend system enhancements in collaboration with IT and business stakeholders, tying technical decisions back to reliability and user experience. * Provide occasional on\-site support and coverage during company events or after\-hours as needed, including occasional travel to Collectivus Holdings locations. **Key KPIs / Metrics** * Escalation Resolution Time: Average time to resolve issues escalated from Level I support. * Escalation Closure Rate: Percentage of escalated issues resolved without further escalation to senior engineering, vendor, or outside support. * Core System Uptime/Availability: Uptime percentage for owned systems (Microsoft 365, Entra ID/SSO, endpoint management). * Access \& Provisioning Turnaround Time: Average time to complete SSO, MFA, Conditional Access, and system\-level user/group provisioning requests. * Provisioning Accuracy Rate: Percentage of access/identity changes completed without error or rework. * Device Compliance Rate: Percentage of MDM\-managed devices meeting configuration and security standards. * Patch \& Vulnerability Remediation Time: Average time to remediate flagged vulnerabilities or apply required patches within SLA. * Project Task Completion Rate: Percentage of assigned infrastructure project tasks/milestones completed on schedule. * Recurring Issue Rate: Frequency of repeat incidents tied to owned systems, indicating opportunities for permanent fixes. * Automation Impact: Number of automation workflows/scripts delivered and estimated hours saved. * Backup \& DR Validation Completion Rate: Percentage of scheduled backup tests/DR exercises completed successfully for assigned systems. * Documentation Currency: Percentage of owned systems with up\-to\-date runbooks, configuration standards, and technical documentation. * After\-Hours/On\-Call Response Compliance: Adherence to on\-call rotation and responsiveness during off\-hours incidents. **Skills \& Requirements** * Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or related field, or equivalent work experience. * 3\+ years of experience in systems administration, IT support, or infrastructure engineering, with direct experience administering Microsoft 365 and Entra ID. * Hands\-on experience with identity and access management, including SSO, MFA, and Conditional Access. * Experience with MDM/endpoint management tooling (e.g., JAMF) across a mixed device environment. * Working knowledge of PowerShell and Power Automate, or comparable scripting/automation tools. * Familiarity with endpoint security and vulnerability management tooling (e.g., Huntress, Rapid7\). * Experience supporting disaster recovery activities, including backup testing and runbook maintenance. * Strong written communication skills, with the ability to produce clear technical documentation. * Ability to mentor junior support staff and communicate technical concepts to non\-technical stakeholders. * Ability to participate in an on\-call rotation and respond to incidents after hours. * Willingness to travel occasionally to Collectivus Holdings locations as needed. \#LI\-Hybrid

jobs.title: Supervisor, Production Coordination (Logistics) - Memphis
jobs.description: SpaceXAI's mission is to create AI systems that can accurately understand the universe and aid humanity in its pursuit of knowledge. Our team is small, highly motivated, and focused on engineering excellence. This organization is for individuals who appreciate challenging themselves and thrive on curiosity. We operate with a flat organizational structure. All employees are expected to be hands\-on and to contribute directly to the company's mission. Leadership is given to those who show initiative and consistently deliver excellence. Work ethic and strong prioritization skills are important. All employees are expected to have strong communication skills. They should be able to concisely and accurately share knowledge with their teammates. ### **ABOUT THE ROLE:** This role supervises hourly Production Coordinators and adjacent logistics teammates supporting data center construction, commissioning, and ongoing campus operations at Memphis / Southaven. You will lead shift execution of work\-order driven material flow — inventory requests, shortage management, kit / de\-kit, BOM reconciliation, and on\-time delivery of high\-value servers, networking gear, power and cooling components, and infrastructure materials to Site Operations and construction. You will set the standard for inventory integrity, safety, and customer service while driving continuous improvement across receiving, inventory, kitting, and material flow. ### **RESPONSIBILITIES:** * Manage an hourly workforce by assessing employee performance, providing positive and constructive feedback, facilitating conflict resolution, and addressing repeat issues through corrective actions, performance improvement plans, or disciplinary means * Lead by setting an example, taking feedback from all levels of the organization, and motivating the team to achieve the highest level of results * Monitor and improve operations, ensuring a safe work environment with the goal of zero OSHA recordables annually * Own shift\-level production coordination: inventory requests from work orders, kits, and replacement parts; planning and shortage management; and on\-time material delivery for data center build and operations * Ensure parts and equipment are handled and protected to SpaceXAI specifications, including high\-value servers, networking gear, power and cooling components, and infrastructure materials * Interface with engineers, technicians, Site Operations, and construction on work\-order and material\-request priorities; communicate part status and estimated completion dates to leadership * Ensure work\-order bill of material quantities are reconciled and that material released to production matches paperwork (damage, part numbers, quantity, revisions) * Maintain high integrity in company computer systems; drive resolution of incorrect system data that creates bad demand, schedules, or operational failure * Supervise kit build, de\-kit, return\-to\-stock, staging, and workflow improvements across receiving, inventory, and material flow * Ensure cycle counting, FIFO / stock rotation, and environmental controls are followed for materials under the team's care * Lead cost\-saving and continuous\-improvement projects across production coordination and logistics * Actively develop the workforce and monitor and approve employee timekeeping ### **BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:** * Bachelor's degree and 2\+ years of professional experience in materials management, supply chain, or production/manufacturing; or 4\+ years of professional experience in materials management, supply chain, or production/manufacturing in lieu of a degree * 1\+ years of experience leading or supervising hourly warehouse, inventory, production coordination, or manufacturing teams ### **PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:** * 5\+ years of experience working with ERP / inventory management software (SAP, Oracle, or similar) * Experience with MRP systems and work\-order / BOM\-driven material flow * 3\+ years of leadership experience within materials management or production coordination * Experience in data center, aerospace, automotive, semiconductor, or electronic manufacturing environments * APICS certification (CPIM or CSCP) * Lean / Six Sigma experience; Green or Black Belt preferred * Ability to operate forklift equipment * Excellent communication and team\-building skills; organized, self\-driven, and effective in a fast\-paced cross\-functional environment ### **ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:** * Must be willing and able to work one or more of the following shifts; preference for candidates flexible across all four shifts, including nights, weekends, and overtime as site needs require: + **Shift A:** 6:00 AM – 6:30 PM, Sunday–Wednesday + **Shift B:** 6:00 AM – 6:30 PM, Wednesday–Saturday + **Shift C:** 6:00 PM – 6:30 AM, Sunday–Wednesday + **Shift D:** 6:00 PM – 6:30 AM, Wednesday–Saturday * Valid driver's license * Ability to lift up to 50 lbs. unassisted * Ability to work at elevated heights * Ability to work in extreme outdoor environments — heat, cold, rain, etc. * Ability to work in an environment requiring exposure to fumes, odors, and noise * Willingness to operate machinery such as forklifts and loaders when needed * Able to and available for travel (up to 20% of time) * Ability to work onsite in the Memphis, TN / Southaven, MS area *SpaceXAI is an equal opportunity employer. For details on data processing, view our* *Recruitment Privacy Notice**.*

jobs.title: Applied AI Research Engineer
jobs.description: **About Starburst** ------------------- Starburst delivers enterprise intelligence at scale by giving organizations secure, governed access to all their data, wherever it lives. Built for distributed data environments, Starburst helps enterprises power AI and analytics without the cost and complexity of traditional data consolidation. With open standards including Trino and Apache Iceberg, Starburst enables trusted access to complete enterprise context while helping organizations avoid vendor lock\-in. Leading global enterprises trust Starburst to fuel AI, analytics, and enterprise intelligence. Learn more at starburst.ai. #### **About the Team** We build the AI layer for Starburst's products, including AIDA. We design agents that let users ask questions in natural language and get accurate, grounded answers backed by their actual data. We operate with startup speed inside an enterprise company, shipping weekly and measuring results. This is the first dedicated research engineering hire on the team. #### **Role Summary** You will own the intelligence layer that makes AIDA's agents correct, trustworthy, and measurably better over time. The work spans information retrieval, knowledge representation, and evaluation science. You will turn ambiguous notions of "agent quality" into clear metrics, build the grounding systems that connect agent reasoning to verified data, and create the evaluation infrastructure that makes quality a first\-class engineering discipline. You will operate at the research/systems boundary: running experiments with academic rigor and shipping results with production engineering discipline. Research and engineering are not separate tracks here. You will own experiments end to end, from hypothesis through production deployment. #### **As an Applied AI Research Engineer at Starburst, you will:** * Design and build grounding systems that connect agent reasoning to verified enterprise data sources * Build and optimize retrieval pipelines (RAG, hybrid search, structured query generation) for accuracy and latency * Define data representation strategies that preserve semantic fidelity across heterogeneous enterprise data (catalogs, schemas, lineage) * Create evaluation frameworks: automated benchmarks, regression suites, human evaluation protocols * Convert validated research findings into production systems that ship to users * Establish quality metrics and dashboards that track agent correctness week over week * Build feedback loops where user interaction data flows back into evaluation datasets and informs grounding improvements #### **Some of the things we look for:** * 3\+ years of experience in information retrieval, NLP, knowledge representation, or applied ML research * Production experience building RAG, grounding, or retrieval systems (not prototypes or demos) * Strong evaluation methodology: benchmark design, statistical analysis, reproducible experiments * Comfort operating at the research/systems boundary: you read papers and you ship code * Python fluency; experience with vector databases, embedding models, LLM APIs * Track record of converting research insights into shipped production systems #### **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with enterprise data systems (SQL engines, data catalogs, schema metadata) * Familiarity with text\-to\-SQL or structured query generation * Published research or open\-source contributions in IR, NLP, or evaluation methodology * Experience designing evaluation pipelines that run in CI/CD * Familiarity with JVM\-based systems * **Ability to Travel**: This role will require 25% in\-person travel for purposes including but not limited to new hire onboarding, team and department offsites, customer engagements, and other company events. Actual travel expectations may vary by role and business needs. **Build your career at Starburst** ---------------------------------- All\-Stars have the opportunity and freedom to realize their true potential. By building alongside top talent, we're empowered to take ownership of our careers and drive meaningful change. Anchored in industry\-proven technology and unprecedented success, All\-Stars are taking on the challenge everyday to disrupt our industry – and the future. Our global workforce is supported by a competitive Total Rewards program that reflects our commitment to a rewarding and supportive work environment. This includes a variety of benefits like competitive pay, attractive stock grants, flexible paid time off, and more. We are committed to fostering an intentional, inclusive, and diverse culture that drives deep engagement, authentic belonging, and an exceptional All\-Star experience. We believe that diversity of thought, perspective, background and experience will enable us to own what we do, drive our success and empower our All\-Stars to show up authentically. Starburst provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

jobs.title: Lead Software Engineer/Software Engineer (Full Stack) – Enterprise Knowledge & AI
jobs.description: Overview: Being good neighbors – helping people, investing in our communities, and making the world a better place – is who we are at State Farm. It is at the core of how we operate and the reason for our success. We're moving with urgency to become a Next Gen Good Neighbor, with technology that strengthens human connections and enhances the customer experience. As an employee, you'll spend less time navigating systems and more time applying judgment, empathy, and expertise in the moments that matter most. **HYBRID:** Qualified candidates (in or near hub locations listed below) should plan to spend time working from home and some time working in the office as part of our hybrid work environment. Hybrid work arrangement for Enterprise Technology is defined as residing with a 180\-mile radius of the Hubs and Corporate. **HUB LOCATIONS:** Dunwoody, GA or Bloomington, IL **SPONSORSHIP: Applicants are required to be eligible to lawfully work in the U.S. immediately; employer will not sponsor applicants for U.S. work authorization (e.g., H\-1B visa) for this opportunity.** Grow Your Skills, Grow Your Potential: Responsibilities: The Lead Software/Software Engineer (Full Stack) will design, build, and enhance modern full\-stack applications that support State Farm's Enterprise Knowledge Management platform. This role spans front\-end experiences, backend services, cloud\-native development, and AI\-enabled capabilities. You'll work across Salesforce, AWS, and modern web technologies to deliver solutions that improve knowledge authoring, search, discovery, and Generative AI experiences. **What You'll Do** * Design, build, and support full\-stack applications using modern engineering practices. * Develop user\-facing experiences in Salesforce and modern web frameworks such as Angular. Build and maintain REST APIs, event\-driven services, and cloud\-native integrations on AWS. * Develop scalable integrations using services such as Amazon S3, Lambda, EventBridge, API Gateway, SQS/SNS, and related AWS technologies. * Build capabilities that operationalize enterprise knowledge authored in Salesforce Knowledge for consumption across State Farm applications. * Develop AI\-enabled solutions that support knowledge authoring, semantic search, summarization, citation, and other Generative AI use cases. * Partner with architects and engineers to integrate Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG), vector search, and other emerging AI capabilities into the knowledge platform. * Improve application performance, reliability, observability, and operational excellence through automation and monitoring. * Collaborate closely with product owners, business partners, UX designers, and fellow engineers to deliver high\-value solutions. * Participate in the full software development lifecycle, from solution design through implementation, deployment, and ongoing support. Qualifications: **Desired Technical Capabilities** * Full\-stack software development experience. * Experience developing modern web applications using Angular, React, or similar frameworks. * Experience with Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, Apex, or other object\-oriented programming languages. * Experience building and consuming RESTful APIs and event\-driven architectures. * Experience developing cloud\-native applications on AWS. * Familiarity with services such as Lambda, API Gateway, S3, EventBridge, SQS, SNS, Amazon RDS, CloudWatch, and IAM. * Experience with CI/CD pipelines, Git, automated testing, and DevSecOps practices. * Knowledge of Salesforce Platform development or Salesforce integrations is a plus. * Interest or experience in Generative AI, LLMs, prompt engineering, RAG, semantic search, vector databases, or AI\-assisted application development is highly desirable. * Strong problem\-solving, collaboration, and communication skills with a passion for learning emerging technologies. **Why Join Our Team?** You'll have the opportunity to help build one of State Farm's most strategic technology platforms—the trusted knowledge foundation that powers enterprise search, digital experiences, and the next generation of Generative AI capabilities. If you're excited about cloud engineering, AI, modern application development, and solving meaningful business problems at enterprise scale, we'd love to have you join our team. Our Benefits: Because work\-life balance is a priority at State Farm, compensation is based on our standard 38:45\-hour work week!* Potential starting salary range: $97,000 \- $130,000 * + Starting salary will be based on skills, background, and experience + High end of the range limited to applicants with significant relevant experience * Potential yearly incentive pay up to 15% of base salary **At State Farm, we offer more than just a paycheck. Check out our suite of benefits designed to give you the flexibility you need to take care of you and your family!*** **Get Paid!** On top of our competitive pay, you are eligible for an annual raise and bonus. * **Stay Well!** Focus on you and your family’s health with our robust health and wellbeing programs. State Farm pays most of your healthcare premium, and we offer multiple healthcare plan options, including a high deductible plan. All medical plans provide 100% coverage for in\-network preventative care, AND you and your family have access to vision, dental, telemedicine, 24/7 mental health professionals, and much more! * **Develop and Grow!** Take advantage of educational benefits like industry leading training programs, top\-notch tuition assistance programs, employee resource groups, and mentoring. * **Plan Ahead!** Plan for those big moments in life with benefits like fertility/IVF/adoption assistance, college coaching, national discount programs, interactive monthly financial workshops, free financial coaching, and more. You can also start a savings account or consider financing through our State Farm Federal Credit Union! * **Take a Little “You” Time!** You will have access to our generous time off policies designed so you can plan around holidays, family events, volunteering, or just to take a relaxing day off. With the opportunity to initially earn up to 20 days annually plus parental leave, paid holidays, celebration day, life leave (40 hours/year), bereavement leave, and community service/education support days, there will be plenty of time for you! * **Give Back!** We offer several ways to give back through our Matching Gift Program, Good Neighbor Grant Program, and the Employee Assistance Fund. * **Finish Strong!** Plan for retirement using free financial advisors and a 401(k) plan with company contributions of up to 7% of your salary. **Visit our** **State Farm Careers** **page for more information on our** **benefits****,** **locations****, and the** **hiring process** **of joining the State Farm team!**

jobs.description: **PURPOSE OF POSITION:** The primary responsibility is to support the Alaska Railroad's Advanced Train Control Systems department and its safety systems to ensure safe, stable and efficient operations. The State of Alaska DMV Driving Records are available online: https://online.dmv.alaska.gov/onlinedrivingrecords **Contact Information** ----------------------- **Alaska Railroad Human Resources Department** E\-Mail: arjobinfo@akrr.com Mailing Address: P.O. Box 107500, Anchorage, AK 99510\-7500 Street Address: 327 West Ship Creek, Anchorage, AK Fax Number: (907\) 265\-2542 **Alaska Railroad Corporation Benefits** The following briefly describes the main benefits available to regular employees of the Alaska Railroad Corporation. jobs.title: Surveyor – Utility-Scale Solar
jobs.description: **Position Summary** -------------------- SunEnergy1 is seeking an experienced **Surveyor** to support utility\-scale solar, BESS, substation, and renewable energy construction projects. This position will provide field surveying and layout support throughout project development and construction, working closely with Project Management, Engineering, and Construction teams. The ideal candidate has experience with large\-scale civil construction and is comfortable working in active construction environments, performing construction layout, collecting field data, verifying elevations and grades, and supporting project teams with accurate survey information. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ * Perform construction surveying and layout for utility\-scale solar, BESS, substation, and civil construction projects. * Establish and maintain project control points, benchmarks, and site coordinates. * Perform construction staking for foundations, piles, roads, drainage, equipment, fencing, underground utilities, and other site improvements. * Verify locations, elevations, grades, slopes, and dimensions against approved plans and specifications. * Perform topographic and as\-built surveys. * Collect field data using GPS/GNSS, robotic total stations, levels, and other surveying equipment. * Provide accurate field measurements and documentation to Project Management, Engineering, and Construction teams. * Review engineering drawings and translate plans into field layout. * Assist with quantity verification, earthwork measurements, stockpile calculations, and site grading verification. * Support civil, electrical, and structural construction activities with field survey information. * Perform quality\-control checks on installed work and identify discrepancies between plans and field conditions. * Prepare and maintain field notes, survey records, reports, and electronic data. * Coordinate with third\-party surveyors, engineers, subcontractors, and project management as required. * Support drone/UAS mapping and other technology\-based surveying activities when applicable. * Maintain surveying equipment and ensure proper calibration and operation. * Travel to project sites and work outdoors in varying weather and terrain conditions. **Required Qualifications** --------------------------- * 3\+ years of professional surveying experience, preferably in construction. * Experience with construction layout and field surveying. * Proficiency with GPS/GNSS surveying equipment and robotic total stations. * Ability to read and interpret civil, structural, electrical, and site plans. * Strong understanding of elevations, grades, coordinates, benchmarks, and construction tolerances. * Ability to work independently in active construction environments. * Valid driver's license and ability to travel to project sites. * Strong attention to detail and accuracy. * Strong communication and organizational skills. **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- * Experience with **utility\-scale solar, BESS, substations, transmission, or other renewable energy projects**. * Experience with solar pile layout and tracker installation. * Experience with civil sitework, grading, drainage, roads, and underground utilities. * Experience with **Trimble, Topcon, Leica, or similar** surveying equipment. * Experience with Trimble Business Center, AutoCAD Civil 3D, Carlson, or similar software. * Experience with drone/UAS mapping and photogrammetry. * Familiarity with GIS and GPS data processing. * Surveyor\-in\-Training (SIT) or Professional Land Surveyor (PLS) certification preferred but not required. **Education** ------------- * Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Surveying, Geomatics, Civil Engineering, or a related field preferred. * Equivalent field experience will be considered.

jobs.title: Applications Engineering, Sr Staff Engineer
jobs.description: **We Are** Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI\-powered products. We deliver industry\-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R\&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow. **You Are** You have spent years moving between RTL, FPGAs, and real hardware, and you know that the gap between a design that compiles and one that actually boots is where most projects stall. You understand partitioning tradeoffs, clock domain crossings, and why a PCIe link trains in simulation but fails on the board. You have debugged DDR timing issues at 2 a.m., explained why a billion\-gate SoC will not fit without rearchitecture, and walked a customer through a critical bring\-up when everything seemed broken. You do not just run tools. You understand what ProtoCompiler is doing under the hood, why timing closed on FPGA A but not FPGA B, and how to instrument a design for visibility without destroying performance. When a customer escalation lands, you are the person who can reproduce it, explain it to R\&D, and propose a workaround that actually works in production. You have worked with hyperscalers, automotive teams, AI chip startups, or aerospace groups building systems too complex to simulate. You speak their language. You know the difference between emulation and prototyping, and you can articulate when each makes sense without sounding like a sales pitch. At Synopsys, you will work on the hardest prototyping problems in the industry with customers who are building the next generation of AI, automotive, and datacenter silicon. **What You'll Be Doing** * Lead technical deployments of HAPS\-200 and ProtoCompiler for strategic customers building billion\-gate SoCs across AI/ML, automotive, hyperscaler, and aerospace segments * Drive the full ASIC\-to\-FPGA flow including partitioning, clock conversion, synthesis, place\-and\-route, timing closure, bitstream generation, and hardware bring\-up on multi\-FPGA systems * Debug complex interface IP subsystems including DDR4/DDR5, LPDDR5/6/7, HBM, PCIe Gen3\-6, CXL, UCIe, Ethernet, USB, AXI, and high\-speed SerDes architectures * Reproduce, analyze, and resolve critical customer escalations involving RTL issues, partitioning failures, timing violations, protocol mismatches, and hardware bring\-up failures * Collaborate directly with ProtoCompiler R\&D and Product Management to validate new features, influence roadmap priorities, and represent customer requirements in product planning * Develop and document reusable methodologies for partitioning strategies, clock architecture, debug instrumentation, verification environment adaptation, and hardware/software co\-validation * Mentor applications engineers globally, lead technical workshops and architecture reviews, and represent Synopsys at customer sites, conferences, and industry forums **The Impact You Will Have** * Enable customers to prototype and validate complex SoCs months earlier by solving partitioning, timing, and bring\-up challenges that would otherwise block hardware availability * Influence the ProtoCompiler roadmap and feature set based on direct engagement with the most demanding semiconductor and systems customers in the world * Reduce critical customer escalations by building repeatable debug methodologies and training global teams on advanced troubleshooting techniques * Accelerate adoption of HAPS prototyping platforms across AI accelerator, automotive SoC, and hyperscaler chip development programs * Shape how Synopsys supports multi\-die, chiplet, and UCIe\-based architectures as the industry moves beyond monolithic SoCs * Build long\-term technical relationships with engineering leaders at strategic accounts, becoming the trusted advisor they call when deployments get hard * Drive competitive wins by demonstrating technical depth in FPGA prototyping, emulation tradeoffs, and verification methodology that competitors cannot match **What You'll Need** * Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent hands\-on experience * 10\+ years working in FPGA implementation, ASIC design, ASIC verification, hardware\-assisted verification, FPGA prototyping, or emulation * Deep expertise in FPGA synthesis, place\-and\-route, multi\-FPGA partitioning, timing closure, and constraint development using Xilinx Vivado, Intel Quartus, or equivalent tools * Strong working knowledge of SystemVerilog, UVM, assertions, functional coverage, and verification testbench architecture * Hands\-on experience with interface IP including PCIe, DDR4/DDR5, LPDDR, Ethernet, USB, AXI, CXL, or high\-speed SerDes protocols * Proficiency in Tcl, Python, or shell scripting for automation and flow development * Direct experience with Synopsys HAPS and ProtoCompiler is a strong plus, as is experience with ZeBu, Palladium, Protium, or Veloce emulation platforms **Who You Are** * You can walk into a room with a customer's architecture team, understand their SoC in an hour, and identify the three partitioning decisions that will make or break their prototype schedule * When a PCIe link will not train or a DDR interface fails calibration, you know where to look first and how to instrument the design to prove your hypothesis * You are comfortable presenting technical tradeoffs to VPs and engineering directors without oversimplifying the problem or losing the nuance that matters * You do not wait for perfect information or complete documentation. You dig into logs, RTL, netlists, and hardware captures to figure out what is actually happening * You have debugged designs using Verdi, runtime instrumentation, protocol analyzers, or assertion\-based techniques and can teach others how to do the same * You can explain why emulation and prototyping solve different problems, and you have the technical depth to back up that explanation with real architectural tradeoffs **The Team You'll Be Part Of** You will join the Hardware\-Assisted Verification (HAV) organization, working closely with Applications Engineers, R\&D, Product Management, Sales, and Customer Success teams globally. This is a highly visible role supporting strategic semiconductor, hyperscaler, AI/ML, automotive, and aerospace customers deploying HAPS\-200, ProtoCompiler, and the broader Synopsys verification ecosystem. You will collaborate across organizations to drive customer success, influence product direction, and lead technical initiatives that shape how the industry approaches FPGA\-based prototyping. **Rewards and Benefits** We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non\-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

jobs.title: Applications Engineering, Staff Engineer
jobs.description: **We Are** Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI\-powered products. We deliver industry\-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R\&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow. **You Are** You have spent years working with FPGAs and ASIC designs, and you know that getting a prototype to boot is rarely about the tool, it is about understanding what the design is actually doing. You have debugged partitioning failures, chased down clock domain issues, and figured out why a DDR interface works in simulation but fails on hardware. You do not just follow runbooks. You understand the flow well enough to know when something does not look right and how to dig deeper. You are comfortable talking to customer engineering teams about their designs, asking the right questions to understand what they are building, and translating that into a working ProtoCompiler flow. When something breaks, you can work through logs, timing reports, and RTL to figure out what went wrong and explain it in a way that makes sense. You have worked with interface IP like PCIe, DDR, Ethernet, or AXI, and you understand how these subsystems behave in a prototype versus simulation. At Synopsys, you will support customers deploying HAPS and ProtoCompiler on real SoC designs. The problems are technical, the customers are smart, and the work you do directly impacts whether their hardware brings up on schedule or slips by months. **What You'll Be Doing** * Support customer deployments of HAPS and ProtoCompiler, working through the ASIC\-to\-FPGA flow including partitioning, synthesis, place\-and\-route, timing closure, and hardware bring\-up * Debug customer designs involving interface IP such as DDR4/DDR5, LPDDR, PCIe, Ethernet, USB, AXI, and other standard protocols * Reproduce and analyze technical issues reported by customers, working with R\&D to identify root causes and deliver solutions or workarounds * Develop and document methodologies for partitioning strategies, clock architecture, debug instrumentation, and bring\-up procedures * Collaborate with Sales and Customer Success teams to support technical evaluations, proof\-of\-concept engagements, and deployment planning * Use Verdi, ProtoCompiler runtime debug tools, and protocol analyzers to troubleshoot RTL, netlist, timing, and hardware issues **The Impact You Will Have** * Help customers get their prototypes running so they can start software development and system validation weeks or months earlier * Solve technical problems that unblock critical customer milestones and keep their chip schedules on track * Provide feedback to R\&D that improves ProtoCompiler features, usability, and robustness based on real customer use cases * Build reusable methodologies and documentation that help other applications engineers and customers deploy faster * Support competitive evaluations where your technical depth and problem\-solving ability directly influence customer decisions * Contribute to the success of SoC programs across AI, automotive, networking, and mobile markets by enabling faster hardware availability **What You'll Need** * Bachelor's or Master's in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience * 5\-8 years in FPGA implementation, ASIC design, ASIC verification, FPGA prototyping, or applications engineering * Solid experience with FPGA synthesis, place\-and\-route, and timing closure using Xilinx Vivado, Intel Quartus, or similar tools * Working knowledge of SystemVerilog, RTL design, and verification concepts * Hands\-on experience with at least one interface IP family such as PCIe, DDR, Ethernet, USB, or AXI * Scripting ability in Tcl, Python, or shell for automation and flow customization * Experience with Synopsys HAPS, ProtoCompiler, or other FPGA\-based prototyping platforms is a strong plus **Who You Are** * You can look at a customer's partitioning result and spot the issues that will cause problems downstream before they waste days on place\-and\-route * When a customer says their design does not work, you ask specific questions to narrow down whether it is an RTL issue, a tool issue, a constraint issue, or a hardware issue * You are comfortable working with incomplete information and figuring out what you need to know to move forward * You can explain a technical problem to a customer engineer in a way that helps them understand what happened and what to do next * You do not panic when something breaks. You work through it methodically using logs, waveforms, timing reports, and whatever else is available * You learn quickly and are not afraid to dig into unfamiliar parts of a design or toolflow to understand what is going on **The Team You'll Be Part Of** You will join the Hardware\-Assisted Verification (HAV) Applications Engineering team, working with customers deploying HAPS and ProtoCompiler for FPGA\-based prototyping. You will collaborate with other applications engineers, R\&D, Product Management, and Sales teams to support customer success across semiconductor, AI, automotive, and systems companies. **Rewards and Benefits** We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non\-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

jobs.title: AI Engineer and Solutions Architect
jobs.description: **Who are we?** T12 Technologies LLC is a technology services company based in Maryland that provides cloud, AI and automation, cybersecurity, contact center, and back\-office modernization services to clients at the federal, state, healthcare, and commercial levels. The current engagement involves developing an accounts payable automation system over a six\-month period for a commercial client, integrating Oracle NetSuite with Anthropic's Claude. **The problem** The client's accounts payable team handles about ten thousand invoice emails each month by hand; some arrive as clean PDFs, while others are photographs taken on a mobile phone. The intake process is managed by NetSuite Bill Capture, with Claude carrying out the extraction, classification and GL coding based on that. All automated decisions must be defensible to an auditor, since the client has already been let down by three previous vendors; nothing ships unless you can demonstrate it. **What you would own** * Get the extraction process to work on actual documents, not just on a clean set of samples. It should be tested on scans, on duplicates, and on invoices lacking the fields that are most needed. * Determine what the system does in cases of uncertainty, including where it continues, where it stops, and what a human observes when it stops. * Verify the accuracy by comparing the client's historical invoices in a manner that a controller will accept and an auditor can follow. * Run a live pilot by carrying it out in parallel with manual processing for a period of thirty days while making adjustments based on what the real world provides. * Give it to him so that it may survive you; the client doesn't have any AI facilities of their own and isn't going to hire one. **What we need** * The work involving the LLM that was actually deployed and that you then provided support for. It wasn't a proof of concept that had only reached the demo stage. * Integrating Python with a REST API to work with systems that were not built by you. * Extracting documents at production quality—such as invoices, forms, claims, and contracts—no matter how semi\-structured and imperfect they may be. * A method that can be used to check if the output is correct, together with the criterion for determining when an improvement is genuine. * The necessary legal permission to work in the United States in an independent contractor capacity. **Helpful, not required** * Specifically Anthropic Claude, or Claude via Bedrock. * Either NetSuite or any other ERP system that you needed to integrate with rather than one that you could control. * The processing of documents relating to finance or accounting by AP. * OCR and document\-capture pipelines, especially when working with low\-quality scans. **Travel** * The kickoff week is mandatory and not optional. * You can expect another 3 to 5 days during the period, with these days being grouped around the pilot and go\-live. * It is essential that you can travel at short notice, no matter where you live—that is a firm requirement. **How we screen** We check the information that the candidates give us. Their references are contacted, their credentials are verified with the issuing body, and the final screening involves using actual, complicated documents rather than having an interview about your resume. We prefer that you show us one thing that you actually built rather than providing a list of all the things you have worked on. If the best work you have done is covered by an NDA, then say so and we will adjust the scope of the exercise to include it. **To apply** Forward the following; applications not including the first two will not be considered. * **A link to something that you have built, such as a** repository, an evaluation report, a design document, or a write\-up, with any sensitive information redacted if necessary. * **Answer the question above with a few sentences**. * A resume or a profile together with two references from completed work. * The total amount you are paid on an hourly basis and whether you take on the contract as a 1099 or through your own entity. * **The location of your base and proof that you will be present** in Houston for the dates listed above. * Your availability over the following six months. Flexible work from home options available.

The role shapes technology solutions that meet regulatory obligations, strengthen supervisory controls, and manage conduct and trade\-related risks. Working across Compliance, Supervision, Global Markets, Product, Architecture, Engineering, Data, Quality Assurance, Operations, and Risk, the software engineer will be responsible for leading the design, development, delivery, and operational support of technology solutions that enable regulatory compliance, surveillance, supervision, and control oversight functions. This role combines technology innovation and delivery accountability across strategic regulatory and business initiatives. This engineer will develop solutions within a modern cloud\-native architecture, big data platforms, artificial intelligence (AI), machine learning (ML), and automation capabilities to improve operational efficiency and regulatory outcomes. The role partners closely with Compliance, Risk, Data, and Business stakeholders to deliver scalable, secure, resilient, and regulator\-ready solutions. **Responsibilities** **:** **Technology Delivery** * Work within a team on end\-to\-end delivery of strategic Compliance technology initiatives. * Manage delivery roadmaps, capacity planning, dependencies, risks, and stakeholder communications. * Coordinate across product, architecture, infrastructure, security, and vendor teams. * Ensure solutions meet business objectives while adhering to enterprise architecture standards. * Drive Agile delivery practices and continuous delivery methodologies. **Architecture \& Solution Design** * Provide technical oversight for enterprise\-scale distributed systems. * Support API\-driven, event\-driven, microservices, and cloud\-native architectures. * Ensure integration between vendor platforms, proprietary systems, and enterprise data services. * Participate in the development of solution designs for scalability, resiliency, maintainability, and security. * Promote framework reuse and common platform capabilities across workstreams. **Regulatory \& Control Alignment** * Ensure technology solutions support regulatory obligations, supervisory requirements, and compliance controls. * Embed auditability, traceability, entitlement controls, evidencing
