jobs.title: Senior iOS Developer
jobs.description: ### **About TEGNA** TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news. **Senior iOS Developer** Hybrid – Knoxville, TN Are you ready to shape the mobile experiences of tens of millions of Americans every month? Join TEGNA's Development team, where we build cutting\-edge websites, mobile apps, OTT apps, and custom editorial tools. Despite being part of a large, publicly traded company, our team operates with the agility and excitement of a startup. We're a fun\-loving group of professionals who thrive on innovation and getting things done. We are seeking a Senior iOS Developer to help lead the evolution of our native iOS news platform, which powers branded apps for 50\+ TEGNA stations from a single shared codebase. In this role, you'll build new features, mentor teammates, tackle our toughest performance and architecture challenges, and help set the technical direction for the app. If you love modern iOS development and working in a collaborative environment, this is the perfect opportunity for you. This is a hybrid role based in Knoxville, TN, with a mix of in\-office and remote work. **Responsibilities:** --------------------- * Design, build, and ship features for our native iOS app using Swift and SwiftUI, aligned with the product roadmap and our engineering standards. * Own significant areas of the codebase and serve as a key resource for investigating and resolving complex product issues. * Write efficient, reusable, and reliable code within our MVVM \+ Coordinator architecture and modular, config\-driven content system. * Identify performance bottlenecks—especially around video playback, memory usage, and view rendering—and drive solutions. * Mentor other developers through code review, pairing, and technical guidance. * Collaborate with developers, designers, and product/business managers to translate requirements into well\-architected solutions. * Help maintain and improve CI/CD pipelines and release processes across our multi\-station builds. * Rapidly learn new technologies and adapt to changing business and customer needs. **Requirements:** ----------------- * 5\+ years of professional software development experience, including 3\+ years building native iOS applications with Swift. * Hands\-on experience with SwiftUI and modern iOS UI development. * Solid understanding of app architecture patterns (MVVM, Coordinators) and separation of concerns. * Experience with Swift concurrency (async/await) and Combine for asynchronous and reactive programming. * Experience with dependency management using Swift Package Manager. * Experience consuming RESTful APIs and working with JSON (Codable). * Experience with local persistence (Core Data, UserDefaults, or similar). * Proficient with Git and code versioning workflows. * Understanding of design principles behind scalable, maintainable applications. * Strong problem\-solving skills and a collaborative, team\-first attitude. **Nice to Have** ---------------- * Experience with AVFoundation/AVPlayer or other media/video playback and streaming. * Experience with multi\-target/multi\-scheme builds and per\-configuration assets. * Familiarity with feature flagging (e.g., LaunchDarkly) and A/B testing. * Experience integrating analytics, attribution, and push notification SDKs. * Experience with rich push notifications via a Notification Service Extension. * Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices (Azure DevOps a plus). * Experience with automated testing (XCTest, unit and UI) and static analysis tools like SwiftLint. * OTT/TV or news/media app experience. Apply today and help us create amazing digital experiences! ### **Benefits:** TEGNA offers comprehensive benefits designed to safeguard the physical, mental and financial health of our employees and their families. If you are in need of an accommodation in order to submit your application, please email askhr@tegna.com **Recruiting Fraud Alert:** To all candidates: your personal information and online safety are important to us. jobs.title: Manager, Machine Learning Engineering
jobs.description: **About Tala** Tala is AI\-native credit infrastructure for the global majority, combining proprietary risk intelligence with an expanding network of capital and distribution partners to power credit access at scale. Backed by more than $500 million in funding, Tala has distributed more than $7 billion in capital to more than 13 million customers across Africa, Latin America, and Asia—building one of the most robust datasets on thin\-file borrowers anywhere in the world. Our mission is simple yet bold: to unleash the economic power of the global majority. We are looking for daring, data\-driven leaders passionate about building the trust and credit infrastructure for the global majority. Our pioneering work and proven impact have earned us consistent recognition, including being named to: CNBC’s Disruptor 50 for five years. CNBC’s World's Top Fintech Companies for two consecutive years. Forbes’ Fintech 50 list for nine consecutive years. Visionary investors, persuaded by the economic power of the global majority, have committed half a billion dollars in equity and debt to Tala's success. Given the global nature of our team, we operate on a remote\-first approach with office hubs in Santa Monica, CA (HQ); Nairobi, Kenya; Mexico City, Mexico; Manila, the Philippines; and Bangalore, India. Most Talazens join us because they connect with our mission. If you are energized by the impact you can make at Tala, we’d love to hear from you! #### **The Role** We’re looking for a Manager, Machine Learning Engineering to lead Tala’s ML Platform team. This person will manage a team of Machine Learning Engineers responsible for building the platforms, frameworks, and infrastructure that enable our Data Science teams to securely train, deploy, monitor, and operate machine learning models at scale. This is a player\-coach management role. You’ll be responsible for developing and growing the team while also providing enough technical leadership to guide architecture, engineering practices, reliability, and production systems. The role has a particular focus on real\-time machine learning inference and streaming data systems, as well as the platforms that support batch model development and deployment. ### **What You'll Do** **Lead \& Grow the Team** * Manage and develop a team of 4–6 Machine Learning Engineers across mid\-to\-senior levels. * Hire, source, interview, and close strong MLE talent. * Establish clear expectations, provide regular feedback, and create development plans for direct reports. * Coach engineers toward growth and promotion while addressing performance gaps directly and thoughtfully. * Create opportunities for engineers to take on challenging projects and grow their technical leadership. **Own Engineering Delivery** * Set quarterly goals and ensure the team consistently delivers against them. * Own prioritization across product roadmap work, run\-the\-business activities, and operational excellence. * Balance team capacity across new development, maintenance, technical debt, and production support. * Improve team productivity by reducing context switching and delegating effectively. * Partner with engineers and technical leads to estimate and scope complex work. **Provide Technical Leadership** * Guide the development of platforms and frameworks that allow Data Scientists and Analysts to explore data, develop features, and train, test, deploy, and monitor ML models. * Provide technical leadership across model infrastructure, real\-time inference, streaming feature extraction, batch processing, and production ML systems. * Drive strong engineering practices around testing, automation, observability, fault tolerance, infrastructure\-as\-code, and deployment. * Own and improve SLOs, on\-call health, capacity planning, reliability, and incident response. * Review technical designs and help drive architectural standards and technical debt reduction. **Partner Across the Organization** * Work closely with Data Science, Data Engineering, Data Platform, Product, Credit, and Business Development teams. * Translate business and technical needs into scalable ML platform solutions. * Coordinate dependencies and delivery across multiple engineering and data teams. * Help create structure and clarity in an environment where priorities and requirements can evolve. ### **What You'll Need** **Management Experience** * 2\+ years of directly managing engineers, including hiring, performance management, coaching, and career development. * Experience managing a team through at least one full performance cycle. * Demonstrated ability to coach engineers toward promotion and address underperformance effectively. * Experience owning team goals, prioritization, estimation, and delivery. * Experience with production on\-call, incident response, and capacity planning. * Willingness to be actively involved in sourcing, interviewing, and closing engineering talent. **Technical Experience** * 6\+ years of backend software engineering experience in consumer\-scale applications. * At least 3 years of hands\-on Python experience. * Experience building and operating machine learning or causal inference systems in production. * Earlier\-career experience personally building and deploying ML models or ML infrastructure. * Ability to participate in technical architecture and system\-design discussions and provide technical direction without needing to be the primary coder. * Strong understanding of software quality, security, reliability, testing, and production operations. **Technical Skills** We’re particularly interested in candidates with experience across: * Languages: Python, SQL * Machine Learning: Jupyter, Pandas, Scikit\-Learn, XGBoost, TensorFlow, PyTorch, Hugging Face * Cloud \& Infrastructure: AWS, GCP, Azure, Kubernetes, Docker * Streaming: Kafka, Kinesis, Beam, Flink, Spark Streaming * Batch Processing: Airflow, Metaflow * Databases: MySQL, PostgreSQL, Cassandra, Snowflake, Druid, and/or similar technologies * APIs: REST, GraphQL, gRPC, Protocol Buffers * Production Engineering: DevOps, SLOs, monitoring/observability, on\-call, capacity planning, root\-cause analysis * ML/Analytics: Machine learning, causal inference, scalable algorithms Our vision is to build a new financial ecosystem where everyone can participate on equal footing and access the tools they need to be financially healthy. We strongly believe that inclusion fosters innovation and we’re proud to have a diverse global team that represents a multitude of backgrounds, cultures, and experience. We hire talented people regardless of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Lead Studio Engineer
jobs.description: Are you a tech\-savvy problem solver who thrives in the fast\-paced world of broadcast television? We're looking for a Lead Studio Engineer to join our team in Atlanta, GA. In this critical role, you'll be the technical backbone of our operations, ensuring our broadcasting systems run flawlessly while leveraging your expertise in IP networks, studio operations, and cutting\-edge broadcast technology. If you're passionate about keeping live television on the air and love diving deep into complex technical challenges, this is your opportunity to make a real impact. **WHAT YOU'LL DO:** ------------------- * Installs, maintains, and repairs critical broadcasting components to ensure all systems are functioning at peak efficiency. * Troubleshoot and repair a variety of issues with broadcast and IT equipment. * Relies on extensive knowledge and professional discretion to perform efficiently and successfully. * Collaborates with technology suppliers on setup, upgrades, enhancements, troubleshooting, and issue resolution. * Programs/customizes equipment software functionality. * Tracks and assists users with equipment issues. * When resolving open issues, seek multiple perspectives, gather more information when necessary, close or escalate issues, and monitor resolution. * Works with the Network Ops leadership team to address operational issues and facilitate decision\-making regarding technical matters. * Provides input and recommendations to assist in disaster recovery and system planning. * Other duties as assigned. * Makes recommendations for products and service enhancements. **WHAT YOU'LL NEED:** --------------------- * Associate's degree or equivalent work experience * 1\-3 years of previous IT and/or broadcast engineering experience preferred **WHAT YOU'LL BRING:** ---------------------- * Experience with vendor support relations is highly desirable. * Previous television engineering experience preferred * Experience with live television production. * Must have thorough knowledge of Digital audio/video workflows and distribution. * C/Ku band satellite uplink and downlink systems. **WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK, AND PLAY** ------------------------------------- Atlanta, Georgia, is a vibrant, dynamic city that perfectly blends Southern charm with big\-city energy. As the capital of Georgia and a major hub for business, culture, and entertainment, Atlanta offers endless opportunities for professional growth and personal enjoyment. From world\-class dining and thriving arts scenes to professional sports teams and beautiful outdoor spaces like Piedmont Park and the Atlanta BeltLine, there's always something to explore. The city's rich history, diverse neighborhoods, and welcoming community make it an exciting place to build your career and your life. \#LI\-SM2 \#LI\-Onsite **If you are a current Scripps employee, please do not apply on this site. Please access our internal career site at Worklife \> My Info \> View Open Positions at Scripps.** ============================================================================================================================================================================= **SCRIPPS’ COMMITMENT TO A CULTURE THAT CREATES CONNECTION:** At Scripps, we are committed to a culture that reflects the audiences and communities we serve. We are intentional about creating an environment where employees, our audiences and other stakeholders feel valued and inspired to reach their full potential and create connections. To successfully deliver on this commitment, we must understand and reflect the values and perspectives those around us embody. That process begins by looking inward to build and celebrate a respectful workplace where everyone feels a sense of belonging and connection. By continuing to cultivate an environment where all employees have a fair chance to succeed, are included, valued, and seen, we will strengthen the connections that drive positive business impact and align with our core purpose. **ABOUT SCRIPPS:** The E.W. Scripps Company (NASDAQ: SSP) is a diversified media company focused on creating connection. As one of the nation’s largest local TV broadcasters, Scripps serves communities with quality, objective local journalism and operates a portfolio of more than 60 stations in 40\+ markets. Scripps reaches households across the U.S. with national news outlet Scripps News and popular entertainment brands ION, ION Plus, ION Mystery, Bounce, Grit and Laff. Scripps is the nation’s largest holder of broadcast spectrum. Scripps Sports serves professional and college sports leagues, conferences and teams with local market depth and national broadcast reach of up to 100% of TV households. Founded in 1878, Scripps is the steward of the Scripps National Spelling Bee and its longtime motto is: “Give light and the people will find their own way.” As an equal employment opportunity employer, The E.W. Scripps Company and its affiliates do not discriminate in its employment decisions on the basis of race, sex, sexual orientation, transgender status, gender, color, religion, age, genetic information, medical condition, disability, marital status, citizenship or national origin, and military membership or veteran status, or on any other basis which would be in violation of any applicable federal, state or local law. Furthermore, the company will make reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with known disabilities unless doing so would result in an undue hardship for the company.

jobs.title: Junior IT Configuration Technician (Entry-Level)
jobs.description: **Junior IT Configuration Technician (Entry\-Level)** **Location:** Westchester and Danbury, CT **Job Type:** Full\-Time **Salary:** Competitive and based on experience **Ready to Boot Up Your IT Career?** Are you the person who enjoys taking technology apart just to understand how it works? Do you find yourself troubleshooting friends' computers, setting up devices for family members, or constantly looking for the latest tech trends? If you're passionate about technology and eager to build a career in IT, we want to meet you. Ergonomic Group is looking for an enthusiastic, motivated, and tech\-minded Junior IT Configuration Technician to join our growing team. This is a career\-launching opportunity for someone eager to gain hands\-on experience with hardware, software, networking, customer deployments, and enterprise technology solutions while learning directly from experienced engineers. You will go onsite 5 days per week to our customer locations within the Westchester, NY and Danbury, CT area. Whether you're a recent graduate, technical school student, career changer, military veteran, or simply someone who loves technology, we'll provide the mentorship, training, and real\-world experience needed to help you succeed. **No Experience? No Problem.** We value curiosity, work ethic, reliability, and a willingness to learn just as much as formal education or previous IT experience. In this role, you'll gain exposure to enterprise networking, cloud technologies, cybersecurity solutions, end\-user support, and modern IT infrastructure while working alongside some of the most experienced technology professionals in the Northeast. **What You'll Be Tackling** **Build It. Configure It. Deploy It.** * Configure, install, and test desktops, laptops, mobile devices, and peripherals. * Perform system imaging, provisioning, and deployment of end\-user devices. * Ensure equipment is configured according to security and quality standards. * Troubleshoot hardware and software issues before deployment. * Help prepare customer systems for successful rollouts and installations. **Hit the Road \& Make Technology Happen** * Travel to customer locations throughout the Northeast to assist with technology deployments and installations. * Participate in rack\-and\-stack projects, equipment moves, workstation installations, and hardware upgrades. * Assist with structured cabling, equipment mounting, and technology setup activities. * Work alongside experienced engineers on customer projects and technology rollouts. * Experience firsthand how technology solutions are deployed in real business environments. **Connect the Dots (and the Network)** * Support the installation and configuration of operating systems, software applications, and technology solutions. * Assist with networking equipment including switches, routers, wireless access points, and related infrastructure. * Verify connectivity and functionality of deployed systems. * Help maintain accurate documentation and inventory records. * Gain exposure to enterprise networking and modern infrastructure technologies. **Learn, Grow \& Level Up** * Learn directly from senior engineers and technical specialists. * Participate in team projects and process improvement initiatives. * Continuously develop your technical skills through hands\-on experience and training. * Build a strong technical foundation for future advancement. * Explore different areas of technology to discover where your passions and strengths align. **The Kind of Person We're Looking For** * Passion for technology and a desire to build a long\-term career in IT. * Basic understanding of computer hardware, software, and networking concepts. * Familiarity with Windows, macOS, or Linux operating systems. * Strong troubleshooting and problem\-solving abilities. * Excellent communication skills and a positive, team\-oriented attitude. * Ability to follow instructions, stay organized, and pay attention to detail. * Willingness to travel throughout the Northeast as needed. * Eagerness to learn, grow, and take on new challenges. * **Tech Skills That Help You Stand Out** Don't worry if you don't check every box. These are simply skills that may give you a head start: * Experience in a help desk, desktop support, technical support, internship, or entry\-level IT role. * Exposure to system imaging or device provisioning tools such as Autopilot, Intune, Ghost, or Acronis. * Familiarity with networking concepts including TCP/IP, DNS, and DHCP. * Basic knowledge of Active Directory and Microsoft environments. * CompTIA A\+, Network\+, Microsoft, or similar certifications. * Experience using hand tools and performing basic equipment installations. **❤️ Why You'll Love It Here** At Ergonomic Group, we don't just offer jobs—we help launch careers. For nearly 40 years, we've built a culture centered around teamwork, mentorship, innovation, and long\-term employee success. Many of our employees have built rewarding careers here because they were given opportunities to learn, grow, and advance. **Training Wheels? We've Got You Covered.** * Direct mentorship from experienced engineers and technical leaders. * Hands\-on training with enterprise\-level technologies. * Ongoing technical training and professional development opportunities. * Certification reimbursement and support for approved industry certifications. * Exposure to networking, cloud computing, cybersecurity, infrastructure, and managed services technologies. * Opportunities to continually expand your technical skillset. **Where Could This Role Take You?** This position is designed to be the first step in a long\-term technology career. As your skills grow, potential career paths may include: * Systems Engineer * Network Engineer * Cloud Engineer * Cybersecurity Specialist * Professional Services Engineer * Solutions Architect * Technical Project Coordinator **Perks Beyond the Paycheck** * Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits package. * Collaborative, supportive, and team\-oriented culture. * Access to the latest technologies and IT tools. * Opportunity to learn from some of the region's most experienced engineers. * A company that invests in your growth and development. * A workplace where curiosity, learning, and innovation are encouraged. **About Ergonomic Group** Ergonomic Group (EGI) is a privately held, woman\-owned technology solutions provider with over 40 years of experience helping organizations achieve greater performance, scalability, and efficiency. Our innovative technology solutions, professional services, and customer\-first approach have made us a trusted technology partner throughout the Northeast. We believe in investing in people, creating opportunities for growth, and building careers—not just filling positions. **Ready to Plug Into Something Bigger?** If you're excited about technology, eager to learn, and ready to launch your IT career, we'd love to hear from you. **Apply today and start building your future with Ergonomic Group.**

jobs.title: Senior Business Systems Specialist
jobs.description: **Who We Are** -------------- The Farmer's Dog was born from a mission to change the landscape of pet health, providing dogs and their humans with honest, smart, and simple care. We're starting by radically improving the $90 billion pet food industry, replacing bags of highly\-processed pellets with a personalized subscription service that sends complete and balanced, freshly\-made dog food directly to customers' doors. Our ultimate goal is to create innovative, delightful and personalized experiences across all aspects of pet care, and we believe our direct\-to\-consumer business model, holistic approach to growth, and dynamic culture uniquely position us to shepherd this backwards industry into the future. To date, The Farmer's Dog has delivered over 1 billion meals nationwide and raised over $150M in funding to help us build a company as healthy as the dogs who are eating those meals. Join us as we continue to develop ways of bringing peace of mind to customers, health to their companions, and much\-needed change to the way people feed and care for their pets. \#LongLiveDogs **What We Stand For and Where You'll Come In** ---------------------------------------------- The Senior Business Systems Specialist is responsible for the technical implementation, configuration, and integration of our core business systems including NetSuite, Coupa, and various retail partners across the organization. You will build and maintain integrations between NetSuite and marketplace/vendor platforms with Retail partners and procurement systems (Coupa), configure workflows to meet business requirements, troubleshoot data and integration issues, and ensure data integrity across connected systems. You'll partner with engineering, accounting and operations to manage technical project timelines, document system architecture, and drive adoption through hands\-on technical enablement, delivering projects on time, within scope, and aligned to stakeholder requirements. **One Team:** We don't think of ourselves as "Acquisition Marketers", "Engineers", "Data Analysts", or "Product Managers". Beyond denoting skill sets and areas of expertise, we don't think departments matter. We'd rather align ourselves to the goals we're working to achieve and make sure we have necessary subject matter expertise to drive meaningful impact. We strive to orient ourselves around customer problems TOGETHER – getting the right people, with the right context, in the right rooms/Zooms to solve problems holistically. **We are skeptical about everything and precious about nothing:** Ideas can and should come from anywhere, and we aren't tied to our own. We proactively source input. We talk to our customers and leads regularly and are quick to change course if we know there's a better or more impactful way to solve problems. **We consider the customer journey in all of our decisions:** We know that no interaction exists in a silo and therefore understand how important every single one is. We ensure our strategy sets prospective and new customers up for success and drives long\-term retention. We answer questions and address problems early and proactively. We understand the value of different channels, initiatives, and messages and know how to articulate impact and advocate for prioritization holistically. **We Execute For Impact:** We don't subscribe to "best practices" or "industry KPIs". We're uninterested in how we compare to "benchmarks"; instead we orient ourselves around being the best we can possibly be. Similarly, we don't subscribe to rigid or classical expectations of roles – i.e. acquisition is hyper\-focused on improving customer retention and experience. **We Are Focused and Work Without Assumption**: We are not beholden to ideas. We have goals and believe everything beyond that is a series of hypotheses to validate. To that end, we seek to work in sequence and not in parallel. We constantly ask ourselves, "what's the most important hypothesis I should be working on right now? How do I confirm or reject that hypothesis as fast as possible?". We rarely have timelines/deadlines and are constantly taking in new information and adjusting our priorities accordingly. We don't expect to be perfect the first time. **How You'll Make An Impact** ----------------------------- * Serve as the NetSuite functional and technical SME, providing guidance on system architecture, data integrity, and best practices for financial systems. * Architect and maintain advanced dashboards, saved searches, and custom reports in NetSuite and dedicated BI tooling (Looker, Sigma, etc) to support real\-time financial and inventory visibility across the organization. * Gather requirements and lead a group of cross\-functional stakeholders to architect, implement and support scalable technical solutions, including full system implementations. * Collaborate with TFD's engineering function on custom solutions inside and adjacent to our financial systems. * Own the order\-to\-cash sys ence with version control (e.g., Git) and basic scripting (JavaScript, Python) for automation and integration support. * You're a skilled communicator and have the ability to absorb and distill complexity into simple terms to drive decision making. * You are an owner, have expert\-level problem\-solving skills, and can prioritize tasks effectively, with a strong attention to detail and a focus on efficiency. * You love dogs! **Office Guidelines** --------------------- We are an in\-office culture, made of in\-office people who thrive on the collaboration and magnetism of working in a shared space. We are seeking individuals who excel in this type of environment, where being present fosters deeper connections and engagement. We ask all team members to be in office 4 \- 5 days a week to build a collaborative and invested environment to foster our unique in\-person culture we are proud to have. This office policy is subject to change at company discretion. **Our Belonging Philosophy:** ----------------------------- At TFD, we believe Belonging is a shared commitment to creating a workplace where every person feels respected, valued, and empowered to be themselves. When people feel a true sense of belonging, they do their best work, take smart risks, and bring forward diverse perspectives — leading to stronger decisions and deeper relationships. We anchor this belief in a simple phrase: "Everyone's welcome at the dog park." No matter your background, identity, or role, there's space for you here. There's no one way to show up at the dog park— just shared space, mutual respect, and the freedom to be yourself. Being included is just the beginning, it's about contributing your voice, growing through challenges, and building trust through shared goals. This philosophy guides how we lead, how we hire, how we communicate, and how we grow. We continuously evaluate to ensure we are creating a consistent experience that cultivates belonging for all employees, from hiring and performance reviews to talent development. We also believe Belonging happens in everyday moments of connection; lunch with a new teammate, a shared laugh, or a quick story about your weekend. Our structure includes biannual employee surveys, manager training, TFD camps, and support from Humans to ensure we're listening and learning from our Team. Together, these efforts reflect what Belonging means at TFD: a culture where everyone can thrive. **A Few of Our Best Benefits** ------------------------------ * Dog\-friendly office in SoHo * Market\-competitive compensation and equity packages * Comprehensive Healthcare, Dental, and Vision * Company supported mental health benefits * 12 week paid parental leave * Competitive 401k plan with company match * Flexible PTO * Discounted fresh food for your pup * Your pet interrupting video calls (and in\-person meetings) is now a feature, not a bug **Equal Employment Opportunity Statement** ------------------------------------------ The Farmer's Dog, Inc. is an equal employment opportunity employer and does not discriminate in hiring on the basis of sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, creed, national origin, physical or mental disability, protected veteran status or any other legally protected characteristic or status. For more information, please visit Know Your Rights. **Reasonable Accommodations** ----------------------------- TFD complies with applicable federal, state, and local disability laws and makes reasonable accommodations for applicants and employees with disabilities. If a reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and/or to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please contact humansops@thefarmersdog.com. **We're Here to Help** ---------------------- We're happy to answer any questions you may have about the position or our hiring process \- please reach out at careers@thefarmersdog.com.

jobs.title: Group Leader, Engineering - Tampa/St. Pete
jobs.description: **Bring your civil/transportation engineering experience and business development expertise to be a part of The Kleingers Group growth in our Tampa/St. Pete office! We’re looking for individuals with an entrepreneurial spirit to help us build our team and business from the ground up. Intrigued? Connect with us today to learn more!** The Group Leader will provide leadership to project teams who will be working on planning, evaluation, design and implementation of civil engineering projects. The successful candidate will lead the study\-phase and/or design\-phase of projects related to the civil, environmental, construction and industrial fields plan, direct and coordinate the development of new civil engineering designs. jobs.title: Software Engineer III
jobs.description: This position is on site in Des Moines, Iowa. About WG Connect: WG Connect, a Wittern Portfolio Company, is at the forefront of revolutionizing controlled and semi\-controlled distribution through innovative edge devices and cloud\-based solutions. We are developing cutting\-edge vending machine technologies that operate independently or seamlessly integrate with our IQ Tech Portal, our cloud\-based inventory management system. Our team is passionate about pushing the boundaries of technology to deliver exceptional customer experience. Role Requirements: Software Development \& Architecture * Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain high\-quality software solutions across cloud, edge, and embedded platforms. * Lead the implementation of complex features and technical initiatives. * Contribute to architectural decisions that improve scalability, maintainability, performance, and security. * Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues across multiple systems and technology stacks. * Ensure software solutions align with established engineering standards and architectural principles. Technical Leadership * Provide mentorship and technical guidance to Software Engineers I and II. * Lead code reviews and promote engineering best practices throughout the organization. * Participate in technical design reviews and architectural discussions. * Influence engineering standards, coding practices, and development processes. * Help identify and reduce technical debt through ongoing platform improvements. * Mentor engineers and cross\-functional partners on practical, responsible use of AI LLM tools to support software design, code generation, test planning, documentation, troubleshooting, and knowledge sharing. Agile Delivery * Actively participate in daily standups, sprint planning, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, and sprint retrospectives. * Collaborate with Product Owners and stakeholders to clarify requirements and define acceptance criteria. * Assist teams in estimating work, identifying risks, and delivering predictable outcomes. * Support continuous improvement efforts across engineering and product delivery processes. Quality \& Testing * Champion Test Driven Development (TDD) and automated testing practices. * Ensure appropriate unit, integration, and end\-to\-end test coverage. * Maintain high standards for code quality, reliability, and performance. * Support root cause analysis and remediation of production issues. DevOps \& Operational Excellence * Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) initiatives. * Support observability, monitoring, logging, and operational readiness efforts. * Participate in production support and incident resolution activities as required. * Promote deployment automation and release quality improvements. Security \& Compliance * Apply secure software development practices throughout the software lifecycle. * Ensure solutions comply with applicable business, security, regulatory, and licensing requirements. * Participate in security reviews and vulnerability remediation activities. Innovation \& Continuous Learning * Stay current with emerging technologies, industry trends, cloud platforms, AI\-assisted development practices, and embedded systems advancements. * Recommend technologies and solutions that improve operational efficiency, product quality, customer value, or business outcomes. * Contribute to technical knowledge sharing and engineering capability development. * Evaluate and apply AI\-assisted development practices, including prompt engineering, model\-assisted design reviews, automated documentation support, and AI\-informed testing strategies, while maintaining sound engineering judgment and accountability for final deliverables. Required Qualifications Education * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Physics or a related technical field. * Equivalent professional experience may be considered in lieu of a degree. Experience * 5\+ years of professional software development experience. * Demonstrated experience delivering production\-quality software solutions. * Experience operating within Agile software development environments. Technical Skills Candidates will possess significant experience in one or more of the following areas: Cloud Software Development * AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform * Modern application architectures and microservices * REST APIs and event\-driven systems * Relational and NoSQL databases * Containerization and orchestration technologies Embedded/Firmware Development * Embedded Linux or Real\-Time Operating Systems (RTOS) * Device communications and networking * Hardware integration and diagnostics * Protocols such as I2C, SPI, UART, CAN, MQTT, and TCP/IP Software Delivery * Source control systems (Git) * CI/CD pipelines * Automated testing frameworks * Debugging and performance analysis tools * AI\-assisted software delivery using large language models for solution design, development support, test case generation, documentation, code review preparation, and engineering workflow acceleration. Professional Competencies The successful candidate consistently demonstrates: * Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities. * Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills. * Ability to work effectively across technical and non\-technical teams. * Ownership mentality and accountability for results. * Sound technical judgment and decision\-making. * Ability to influence without direct authority. * Commitment to quality, continuous improvement, and customer success. * Desire to learn, mentor others, and contribute to a high\-performing engineering culture. Career Level Expectations Software Engineer III is distinguished from lower career levels through demonstrated ability to: * Lead complex technical initiatives with limited supervision. * Influence architectural and technical decisions. * Mentor and develop other engineers. * Drive engineering best practices across teams. * Serve as an orchestrator of AI\-assisted engineering workflows, helping teams use LLMs effectively across design, development, testing, documentation, and delivery coordination. * Balance technical excellence with business priorities. * Independently deliver solutions to ambiguous and complex problems. Software Engineer III is a senior\-level individual contributor responsible for designing, developing, and delivering complex software solutions that power WG Connect's cloud and edge technology platforms. This role serves as a technical leader within the engineering organization by driving solution design, mentoring engineers, improving development practices, and collaborating closely with Product Management, Quality Assurance, DevOps, and Hardware Engineering teams. The role also acts as an AI\-enabled software delivery orchestrator, coordinating design, development, testing, and documentation activities through the effective use of AI large language models (LLMs) to accelerate delivery, improve quality, and strengthen engineering collaboration. Software Engineers III are expected to work independently, influence technical direction, and contribute to both tactical delivery and long\-term platform evolution.

jobs.title: Cloud Systems Engineer - Site Reliability
jobs.description: **About Us** TherapyNotes is the go\-to superhero for behavioral health Practice Management and EHR software! Our top\-notch SaaS solution handles scheduling, billing, documenting, telehealth, and more so clinicians can focus on awesome patient care. We're a dynamic team of pros who love to innovate and push the envelope, keeping our software cutting\-edge. Join us, and let's revolutionize behavioral health software together while making a real difference! **About The Position** We are seeking a **Site Reliability Engineer** to improve the reliability and operability of the production services and shared platforms supporting our growing **24×7 SaaS environment**. In this role, you will apply software and systems engineering practices to improve **availability, performance, scalability, resilience, observability, incident response, and operational automation**. You will partner with software development, infrastructure, database, security, and other technology teams to establish measurable reliability goals, reduce operational toil, and ensure services are supportable throughout their lifecycle. If you are passionate about building reliable systems, solving complex production problems, and driving continuous improvement, we want to hear from you. **Requirements** * BS degree in Information Systems, Engineering, or equivalent experience. * 5\+ years of engineering experience in Systems Engineering, Cloud or Platform Engineering, DevOps, Software Engineering, and/or SRE. * Experience designing and operating production systems using cloud\-based compute, storage, networking, and containerization technologies; **Azure and Kubernetes preferred**. * Strong Linux systems and networking fundamentals, with experience troubleshooting complex distributed systems in production. * Expertise with an observability platform; **Datadog experience strongly preferred**. Experience with Prometheus, Grafana, New Relic, or equivalent platforms is also valuable. * Experience with scripting and operational automation using tools such as Bash, PowerShell, or Python, along with infrastructure\-as\-code and configuration\-management practices. * Experience participating in production on\-call rotations, incident response, root cause analysis, and post\-incident improvement. * Experience working in Agile/DevOps environments and operating production services using ITSM practices where applicable. * Prior software development experience—or experience investigating application behavior through code, logs, and distributed traces—is a plus Responsibilities* Own and continuously improve how we use **Datadog** to make reliability visible and actionable across metrics, logs, traces, dashboards, monitors, alerts, and service\-level views. * Design, implement, and maintain **high\-availability, high\-throughput, data\- and compute\-intensive critical systems** supporting a growing 24×7 SaaS platform. * Partner with service owners to define and improve reliability through meaningful **SLIs, SLOs, error budgets**, actionable alerting, and operational\-readiness practices. * Participate in and help drive **incident management** for production events, serving as an incident commander or technical responder as needed. Coordinate triage, service restoration, escalation, communication, incident documentation, root cause analysis, and completion of corrective actions. * Partner with development teams to investigate issues across the infrastructure and application layers using metrics, logs, distributed traces, and code\-level context. * Improve deployment safety and service resilience through automated validation, recovery and rollback capabilities, reliability testing, and analysis of system failure modes. * Partner with other technical leaders to ensure all newly introduced systems are supportable and maintainable by both development and operations. * Provide escalated technical guidance and support to other technology teams throughout the organization. * Provide on\-call coverage for production support and other duties as required. * Ensure supported systems and operational activities comply with organizational security, HIPAA, and operating policies. * Identify and eliminate repetitive operational toil using **Bash, PowerShell, Python, or Ansible**. Manage infrastructure as code using **Terraform/OpenTofu** and configuration automation using **Ansible**. **Benefits** * Competitive salary \- $110,000\-$150,000 * Employer sponsored health, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance * Retirement plan with company contribution * Annual company profit sharing * Personal development/training budget * Open, collaborative work environment * Extensive 2\-week onboarding plan * Comprehensive mentorship program **Equal Opportunity Employer Statement \& Applicant Rights** TherapyNotes LLC is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, or any other protected status under federal, state, or local law. We are committed to providing a workplace free of discrimination and harassment.For more information about your rights under federal employment laws, please review the following: * Know Your Rights: Workplace Discrimination is Illegal * Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA): Employee Rights Under FMLA If you require a reasonable accommodation during the application process, please contact humanresources@therapynotes.com. 9/17/2026

jobs.title: Scientist III – Mass Spectrometry / Proteomics
jobs.description: **Work Schedule** Standard (Mon\-Fri)**Environmental Conditions** Able to lift 40 lbs. without assistance, Cold Room/Freezers \-22degreesF/\-6degrees C, Laboratory Setting, Some degree of PPE (Personal Protective Equipment) required (safety glasses, gowning, gloves, lab coat, ear plugs etc.), Will work with hazardous/toxic materials**Job Description** About Thermo Fisher Scientific As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner, and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping take science a step beyond by developing solutions to some of the world’s toughest challenges. DESCRIPTION We are seeking a highly motivated Scientist III – Mass Spectrometry / Proteomics to join our R\&D team. This role will focus on developing innovative sample preparation methods and automated workflows for mass spectrometry\-based proteomics. The successful candidate will apply expertise in protein biochemistry, proteomics, MS sample preparation, and LC\-MS analysis to develop and evaluate new workflows and technologies. A key focus will be the development and automation of robust, reproducible sample preparation methods, including workflows for limited and challenging biological samples. You will design and execute experiments, optimize sample preparation and automated workflows, analyze MS data, and troubleshoot technical challenges. Working in a cross\-functional environment, you will collaborate with scientists, engineers, automation teams, Product Management, Manufacturing, and other functions to translate scientific concepts into practical and scalable workflows. **Key Responsibilities** * Design and execute experiments supporting MS sample preparation and workflow development for proteomics. * Develop and optimize MS sample preparation methods for LC\-MS analysis. * Develop, optimize, and evaluate automated and high\-throughput sample preparation workflows. * Translate manual sample preparation methods into robust, reproducible automated workflows. * Evaluate workflow performance using LC\-MS and quantitative proteomics approaches. * Process, analyze, and interpret MS data to assess workflow performance. * Apply basic bioinformatics, statistical, or programming approaches to support data analysis and visualization. * Troubleshoot technical challenges and improve workflow sensitivity, robustness, reproducibility, and throughput. * Contribute to new product and technology development activities, including feasibility studies, method development, testing, validation, and technology transfer. * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to achieve technical milestones and project objectives. * Prepare technical documentation, experimental reports, protocols, and presentations. * Communicate scientific results and recommendations to project teams and stakeholders. **Qualifications** * Recent Ph.D. graduates, M.S. with 3**\+ years**, or B.S. with **5\+ years** of relevant experience in Biochemistry, Analytical Chemistry, Chemistry, Proteomics, Mass Spectrometry, Bioinformatics, or a related scientific discipline. * Hands\-on experience with proteomics and MS sample preparation workflows. * Experience with protein biochemistry and sample preparation techniques such as protein extraction, reduction/alkylation, digestion, labeling, cleanup, or enrichment. * Experience with LC\-MS\-based proteomics data acquisition and/or analysis. * Basic experience with Python, R, or other programming/scripting tools for scientific data analysis, visualization, or workflow support. * Familiarity with bioinformatics and statistical analysis of proteomics data. * Strong experimental design, analytical, troubleshooting, and scientific problem\-solving skills. * Ability to independently plan, execute, document, and interpret scientific experiments. * Strong written and verbal communication skills and ability to work effectively in a multidisciplinary team environment. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience developing or implementing automated or high\-throughput sample preparation workflows, including liquid\-handling platforms. * Experience translating manual laboratory workflows into automated methods. * Experience with low\-input, limited, or challenging biological samples, including single\-cell or low\-cell\-number proteomics and FFPE tissue samples. * Experience developing sample preparation methods optimized for post\-translational modifications (PTMs) analysis. * Experience with Thermo Scientific LC\-MS systems and associated software. * Experience with quantitative proteomics workflows and analysis of complex MS datasets. * Experience with product development, method validation, design transfer, or technology transfer. * Scientific publications, conference presentations, patents, or other demonstrated research contributions. **Compensation and Benefits** The salary range estimated for this position based in Illinois is $83,300\.00–$138,900\.00\. This position may also be eligible to receive a variable annual bonus based on company, team, and/or individual performance results in accordance with company policy. We offer a comprehensive Total Rewards package that our U.S. colleagues and their families can count on, which includes: * A choice of national medical and dental plans, and a national vision plan, including health incentive programs * Employee assistance and family support programs, including commuter benefits and tuition reimbursement * At least 120 hours paid time off (PTO), 10 paid holidays annually, paid parental leave (3 weeks for bonding and 8 weeks for caregiver leave), accident and life insurance, and short\- and long\-term disability in accordance with company policy * Retirement and savings programs, such as our competitive 401(k) U.S. retirement savings plan * Employees’ Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) offers eligible colleagues the opportunity to purchase company stock at a discount For more information on our benefits, please visit: https://jobs.thermofisher.com/global/en/total\-rewards

jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer
jobs.description: Thompson Holdings Inc. \- Mobile, AL Full\-Time * Reports to CEO **ABOUT THOMPSON HOLDINGS** Thompson Holdings Inc. is a 100% employee\-owned (ESOP) holding company headquartered in Mobile, Alabama. Thompson Holdings is the parent company of four subsidiaries: **Thompson Engineering** Engineering Multi\-disciplined civil/structural/environmental engineering firm established in 1953 **Watermark Design Group** Architectural and interior design firm serving the Gulf Coast and Southeast **Thompson Consulting Services** Full\-service emergency response, disaster planning/recovery, and grant management **Sourcetoad** Tampa\-based software development, AI, automation, and technology consulting firm (acquired Jan 2026\) **THE OPPORTUNITY** This is a newly created enterprise\-wide role. The CTO will serve as an executive\-level technology leader for Thompson Holdings, working alongside the executive leadership team to set and advance technology strategy across the holding company and all subsidiaries. This position will include evaluating third\- party technology solutions, developing enterprise digital solutions, and creating a data strategy and practical governance model across the organization. While the CTO may leverage Sourcetoad's software, AI, automation, and technology consulting capabilities, this is one component of a broader enterprise technology strategy in an enterprise wide capacity The CTO will build a cohesive technology strategy and position Thompson as a differentiated, technology\-enabled competitor in the AEC, disaster recovery, and professional services markets. The CTO will also be tasked with innovating and streamlining process\-based tasks for Corporate services including HR, Safety, Legal, IT, Finance, and Communication as Thompson continues to scale. The CTO will have a keen understanding of digital innovation, enterprise data governance, digital solutions delivery, and corporate governance and will serve in a strategic, cross\-functional position that requires equal parts vision, credibility, and hands\-on execution of technology\-enabled solutions. **WHAT YOU'LL DRIVE** * **Enterprise\-Wide Technology Strategy Across the Portfolio** + Work with all companies to develop and own a unified technology roadmap + Evaluate and prioritize technology capabilities across the enterprise, including Sourcetoad's custom software, AI, automation, and systems modernization expertise can create the highest ROI across all companies + Establish technology governance: standards, platforms, and decision frameworks that allow subsidiaries to remain operationally autonomous while benefiting from shared infrastructure + Partner with enterprise IT leadership to develop technology roadmaps that balance innovation with operational reliability and risk management + Create and lead the enterprise data strategy, including development of a scalable data fabric that connects business, operational, financial, project, client, and other data sources across the enterprise while respecting each company's operational needs. + Establish enterprise data governance practices, including data ownership, stewardship, quality, access, security, integration standards, and decision rights needed to support reporting, automation, AI, and digital solutions * **Enterprise Innovation, Digital Solutions \& Sourcetoad Capability Integration** + Serve as the executive\-level technology bridge across Thompson Holdings and all subsidiaries + Drive enterprise adoption of technology\-enabled tools and solutions, including Sourcetoad\-built products where appropriate, from automated debris management systems for disaster recovery to digital project delivery tools for engineering and shared corporate services + Lead the design, prioritization, and delivery of enterprise digital solutions that improve project delivery, field operations, disaster recovery workflows, corporate services, client experience, and management visibility * **AI \& Emerging Technology Leadership** + Define how AI and machine learning are applied responsibly across the enterprise \- prioritizing genuine business impact, operational improvement, and scalable adoption over experimentation + Partner with subsidiaries to build, evaluate, and scale AI\-enabled solutions + Keep Thompson ahead of the technology curve in industries (AEC, disaster recovery) that are mid\-transformation + Lead and Manage technology driven projects from inception to implementation + Align emerging technologies, AI solutions, software development efforts, digital transformation projects, and data fabric initiatives with corporate cybersecurity, compliance, data governance, and infrastructure standards across the enterprise * **Market Differentiation \& Client Value** + Help package and position Thompson's combined engineering \+ software \+ AI capabilities and technology tools as a competitive differentiator in the market + Partner with subsidiary leaders and business development teams to identify and pursue technology\-enabled service opportunities + Represent Thompson's technology vision by partnering with subsidiaries to support clients, partners, and industry associations * **Change Management \& Technology Adoption** + Lead technology adoption across a workforce that ranges from software engineers to field\-based disaster recovery professionals + Work within a heterogeneous technology environment: Windows\-based enterprise infrastructure across three subsidiaries, Apple/Linux environments at Sourcetoad + Build trust with subsidiary leaders and employee\-owners so technology is viewed as an enterprise\-wide enabler, not an imposition * **Technology M\&A Support** + Advise on future acquisitions from a technology perspective: assess tech maturity, identify integration risks, and evaluate strategic fit + Lead technology integration for new subsidiaries post\-acquisition **WHO YOU ARE** **Experience** * 15\+ years of progressive technology leadership, including 5\+ years in a senior technology executive role (CTO, VP Technology, or equivalent) * Background in professional services, AEC, engineering, construction, consulting, or government services \- or demonstrated experience leading technology transformation in these industries * Experience managing or closely partnering with software development organizations; sufficient technical depth to earn the respect of engineers * Proven track record managing technological solutions across multiple business units or entities * Experience with technology\-driven M\&A: integration planning, due diligence, or post\-acquisition rationalization * Familiarity with ESOP, employee\-owned, or mission\-driven organizational cultures is a meaningful plus * Experience with Management of employees and hands on technology driven solution implementation. **Capabilities** * Strategic thinker who can translate technology vision into tangible business outcomes * Credible with two very different audiences: enterprise\-minded operational leaders and software\-native engineering teams * Strong change management skills; comfortable engaging busy professionals in environments of various technological maturity * Working knowledge of AI/ML applications, modern software development practices, and cloud infrastructure \- not necessarily a practitioner, but informed enough to lead * Demonstrated ability to shape enterprise data strategy, data governance, and digital solutions roadmaps that turn fragmented systems and data sources into scalable business capabilities * Practical, ROI\-focused mindset consistent with an employee\-owned, growth\-oriented business **What We're Not Looking For** * A pure enterprise IT / infrastructure leader (that is a CIO function, not this role) * A startup or Silicon Valley background without services\-industry grounding or exposure * A visionary without execution muscle \- Thompson Holdings is a builder culture and is looking for a hands on technology leader who can manage and stay on task with project implementation. * Someone who wants to standardize everything on day one; subsidiaries retain meaningful operational autonomy **STRUCTURE \& REPORTING** **Reports to:** CEO, Thompson Holdings Inc. **Peer relationships:** Subsidiary Leaders (Thompson Engineering, Watermark, Thompson Consulting, Sourcetoad) **Key working relationships:** Enterprise wide \- including subsidiary leaders, corporate services, enterprise IT, and Sourcetoad leadership as a strategic technology partner. **Location:** Flexible / Remote\-friendly; Mobile, AL headquarters; Tampa, FL (Sourcetoad HQ) and Southeast travel expected **Employee ownership:** Participation in the Thompson Holdings ESOP \- every employee earns shares as the company grows

jobs.title: Engineering Associate
jobs.description: **Position Summary****Thompson Engineering is seeking a motivated Engineering Associate to join our growing engineering team in one of our Gulf Coast offices.** This position is ideal for early\-career engineers who are eager to develop their technical expertise while working alongside experienced professionals on a diverse portfolio of infrastructure projects. The Engineering Associate will support the planning, design, and delivery of projects across a variety of disciplines, including site civil, transportation, water resources, hydrology and hydraulics (H\&H), coastal engineering, federal, municipal, land development projects, or other civil engineering disciplines. This role provides excellent opportunities for mentorship, professional growth, and progression toward professional licensure. **Key Responsibilities*** Assist with engineering analysis, calculations, design, and preparation of construction plans and specifications. * Support project teams in the design and development of transportation, site development, water resources, coastal, federal, and municipal infrastructure projects. * Prepare engineering reports, cost estimates, quantity calculations, and technical documentation. * Coordinate with multidisciplinary teams including survey, environmental, geotechnical, structural, and construction personnel. * Participate in field visits, site investigations, and construction observations as needed. * Utilize engineering software to develop design documents and project deliverables. * Support project managers in maintaining project schedules, budgets, and client expectations. * Continue professional development while working toward Professional Engineer (PE) licensure. **Qualifications*** Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering or a related engineering discipline. * 0–4 years of engineering experience. * Fundamentals of Engineering (FE) certification preferred. * Experience or coursework in one or more of the following disciplines is preferred: * Site Civil * Transportation * Water Resources * Hydrology \& Hydraulics (H\&H) * Coastal Engineering * Federal Infrastructure * Municipal Engineering * Land Development * Experience with AutoCAD Civil 3D, OpenRoads Designer, MicroStation, or similar engineering software is preferred. * Strong communication, organizational, and analytical skills. * Ability to collaborate effectively within multidisciplinary project teams. **About Thompson Engineering** Founded in 1953, Thompson Engineering provides quality assurance and professional services for construction projects supporting industrial, infrastructure, and community development. Our services include drilling, materials testing, construction inspection, chemistry laboratory services, engineering design, environmental assessments, surveying, geotechnical studies, and construction management. Today, Thompson Engineering is recognized for leadership on projects that define skylines, coastlines, and transportation networks across the Southeast. From project planning and design through construction and completion, we deliver innovative solutions to complex infrastructure and building challenges for industrial, commercial, transportation, federal, and municipal clients. **Equal Employment Opportunity Employer** We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

jobs.title: Sr. Unity Developer
jobs.description: Topgolf is looking for a Senior Unity Developer to join our Games team and help lead the next generation of interactive experiences played by millions of Guests across our venues. This role sits at the intersection of game development, real\-world sports, connected venues, and large\-scale entertainment technology. You will lead the design and architecture of Unity\-based games and experiences that run in Topgolf bays, using ball\-tracking data, venue systems, real\-time scoring, and engaging game mechanics to create fun, social, competitive gameplay. You will lead a small group of engineer’s day to day, partner closely with game designers, artists, UX/UI designers, QA, product owners, and platform engineers, and act as the primary technical voice for the Games team, from roadmap through national rollout. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * Architect, develop, and optimize Unity games and interactive experiences for Topgolf venues, making key technical decisions for the systems you own. * Design gameplay systems, UI, animation, scoring, camera behavior, effects, and game\-state logic that other engineers can build on. * Lead integration of Unity games with internal Topgolf services, APIs, tracking systems, configuration tools, and venue hardware. * Partner with designers and product owners to translate ambiguous game concepts into playable prototypes and production\-ready experiences, shaping technical feasibility early. * Collaborate with artists and technical artists on asset pipelines, shaders, VFX, animations, and performance\-conscious visuals, and set technical standards for quality. * Drive down defect rates by improving testability, diagnosing hard\-to\-reproduce issues, and coaching others on debugging complex venue and platform issues. * Write clean, maintainable, well\-structured C\# code and set the bar in code reviews. * Own and improve build, deployment, and development workflows across the Games team. * Drive performance optimization strategy for venue hardware and ensure games run reliably in a live entertainment environment at scale. * Lead technical planning, estimation, and sprint ceremonies; help break down ambiguous initiatives into shippable work. * Mentor mid\-level and junior engineers, and help maintain existing game titles while driving architecture for new product initiatives. **Required Skills and Experience** ---------------------------------- * 6\+ years of professional experience developing games or interactive applications in Unity, including experience owning systems and technical direction end to end. * Strong, demonstrated C\# programming skills and a track record of shipping production\-quality code. * Deep experience building gameplay systems, UI flows, game\-state machines, and real\-time interactive features. * Strong understanding of Unity performance optimization, profiling, memory management, and build configuration, including diagnosing subtle performance regressions at scale. * Experience leading or informally leading engineers: assigning work, reviewing code, and being accountable for a team's technical output. * Proven ability to set technical direction and make architecture decisions that other engineers build on. * Extensive experience with version control systems such as Git, including branching strategy and release management for a team. * Excellent communication skills and the ability to represent technical tradeoffs to designers, artists, QA, product, and leadership stakeholders. * A practical, delivery\-focused mindset with strong ownership of quality, stability, and maintainability across the codebase. **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- * Experience shipping commercial games, location\-based entertainment, arcade games, sports games, or multiplayer/social games at scale. * Experience architecting integrations between Unity applications and REST APIs, backend services, or external hardware systems. * Experience with Linux\-based Unity builds in production. * Experience designing or owning automated build pipelines, CI/CD, or build tooling for a team. * Deep familiarity with game telemetry, analytics, live\-ops, or configuration\-driven content. * Experience with physics\-driven gameplay, ball tracking, projectile systems, or sports simulation. * Experience supporting and operating games in production environments, including incident response and on\-call leadership. * Advanced knowledge of Unity addressables, asset bundles, localization, input systems, or custom editor tooling. * Prior experience as a lead, tech lead, or staff\-level engineer on a games or interactive entertainment team. **What Success Looks Like** --------------------------- * Your team ships reliable, polished Unity features and systems that are fun for Guests and easy to maintain and extend. * You lead collaboration with design, art, QA, and product to move games from ambiguous concept to confident release. * You raise technical quality across the portfolio by setting standards and multiplying your impact through mentorship and delegation. * You understand that Topgolf games run in real venues, so stability, clarity, and operational reliability matter as much as gameplay, and you hold the team to that discipline. * You bring clarity to ambiguous problems, make sound technical calls under pressure, and help the team ship better games faster. BENEFITS Free Play \& 1/2 price food! Health, dental, vision, 401(k) team member match, free mental well\-being platform – and that’s just for starters for those who qualify. jobs.title: Sr. R&D Software Engineer
jobs.description: Join the team that's shaping the future of autonomous robotics and material handling. As an R\&D Software Engineer at Toyota Automated Logistics, you'll develop the brains behind intelligent robotic systems, from low\-level hardware control to high\-level autonomy and perception. You'll work on real robots. You'll ship real code. You'll help launch entirely new automation products into warehouses and factories across the world. We don't just build software; we build the future of logistics. **About Us** Toyota Automated Logistics R\&D is the **New Product Development (NPD)** division of the company. Our mission is to develop original products that expand Toyota Automated Logistics' automation capabilities — enabling our commissioning and systems teams to deliver integrated solutions that give our customers a competitive edge. Our \~70\-person team is distributed between our **Boise, Dallas, and Indianapolis** offices, and includes experts in mechanical, electrical, software, and AI disciplines, all with a strong foundation in robotics technology. Beyond our Toyota Automated Logistics offices, we collaborate heavily with our other Toyota partners to innovate and share our technology globally. Software engineers on our team are true full\-stack robotics developers, with opportunities to work across the entire software stack — from high\-level autonomy, AI, and perception to low\-level motor control, hardware interfaces, and everything in\-between. We take products from concept to production\-ready designs, and we execute our software on real robot hardware in live customer environments. Above all else, we know that our strength lies in our people. Through strong mentorship, thoughtful planning, and a supportive team culture, we create space for engineers to grow while maintaining a healthy work\-life balance. **Your Mission** The primary mission of the R\&D Senior Software Engineer is to act as a technical expert and leader who drives the team towards success. You will develop the architectures and designs that enable our software systems to reliably scale to customer deployments. You will put a major focus on refining the processes and SOPs that drive our team to be effective. You will work to mentor and inspire your peers to become stronger engineers. At Toyota Automated Logistics, we value our team culture extremely highly. You will operate as a force multiplier to make the team the strongest they can be! As the R\&D Senior Software Engineer, you are an expert in Linux development using both C\+\+ and Python. You have experience designing production ready software and understand the patterns and architectures used to create reliable and maintainable codebases. You have experience with common robotics software tools and concepts such as ROS, motor control, localization, navigation, and sensor hardware technology such as LiDAR, Cameras, Motors, Encoders, etc. Most importantly, you have experience leading teams, driving processes, inspiring software engineers, and creating strong team cultures with open communication. In this role, you won't just build software. You'll help shape how our systems behave in the real world, and you will build and support a team that values both innovation and thoughtful execution. **Job** **Functions** * Contribute directly to acting as a key stakeholder in review approvals. * Mentor and guide junior team members – engage in peer programming. * Engage in scoping, planning, and scheduling your work in an Agile workflow. * Engage in, and help create and drive, best practices and SOPs for software development. * Create test plans and engage in hands\-on testing and verification on live Robots \& Hardware. * Uphold our safety standards when interacting with live equipment. * Participate in field trials and customer on\-site Beta deployments as we release new products. * Work with other Toyota Automated Logistics and TICO business units throughout the release process of R\&D products (Manufacturing, Commissioning, Development, etc). **Travel Requirements:** * 5% overnight travel (Travel expenses paid by Toyota Automated Logistics) **Preferred** **Skills \&****Qualifications** * Bachelors Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or similar field * Minimum 8\+ years of relevant experience * Experience designing and implementing production software systems. * Experience with Agile development environment and a strong drive for SOPs. * Expert in Linux environment and developing for Linux systems. * Expertise in C/C\+\+ and Python, Experience with other software technologies (Web Development, SQL, etc.). * Experience with CI/CD and testing methodologies and implementation. * Experience with Containerization and Deployment Strategies. * Experience with version control systems, GIT preferred. * Experience with ROS (Robot Operating System). * Must be eligible to work in the USA long term without sponsorship. * Employees must follow all information security policies, protect confidential data, complete required training, and report any suspected security incidents to support our By honoring this commitment, we have maintained our reputation as one of the best property casualty insurers in the industry for over 170 years. Join us to discover a culture that is rooted in innovation and thrives on collaboration. value and use and recommend data to include in analytical processes. * Incorporate core data management competencies including data governance, data security and data quality. * Act as a data and technology subject matter expert within lines of business to support delivery and educate end users on data products/analytic environment. * Perform data and system analysis, assessment and resolution
