other duties as assigned. **What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?** * Bachelor’s Degree in STEM related field or equivalent. * Ten years of related experience. * **Data Pipeline \& Processing:** Experience with data pipelining, data processing, and data warehousing, with a strong foundation in data engineering principles and practices. * **Modern Data Platform Expertise:** Hands\-on experience with modern data platforms and transformation tools such as Databricks, Snowflake, and DBT. * **ETL \& Integration Tools:** Proficiency with ETL tools such as AbInitio or Informatica, and experience working with cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure. * **Technical Leadership:** Demonstrated technical leadership and/or supervisory experience, ideally gained within a large enterprise or corporate environment. * **AI \& Workflow Innovation:** Experience leveraging AI tools and technologies to drive workflow efficiency and optimize engineering processes. * **Technical Expertise \& Delivery:** Advanced knowledge of cloud platforms, programming languages, and modern software engineering practices, with strong delivery skills including design strategy, automated testing, quality assurance, and system health monitoring to ensure production readiness. * **Problem Solving \& Domain Knowledge:** Strong problem solver who leverages data and proofs of concept to find creative solutions, measures impact, and optimizes outcomes, backed by a demonstrated track record of domain expertise, staying current with industry trends, and sharing knowledge with coworkers. * **Communication \& Leadership:** Excellent communicator who can translate complex technology concepts for business audiences, document initiatives clearly, and build strong business partnerships, while also demonstrating the ability to lead and inspire others, influence priorities, and drive action even in ambiguous situations. **What is a Must Have?** * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, related STEM field, or its equivalent in education and/or work experience. * 6 additional years of data engineering experience. **What Is in It for You?** * **Health Insurance**: Employees and their eligible family members – including spouses, domestic partners, and children – are eligible for coverage from the first day of employment. * **Retirement:** Travelers matches your 401(k) contributions dollar\-for\-dollar up to your first 5% of eligible pay, subject to an annual maximum. If you have student loan debt, you can enroll in the Paying it Forward Savings Program. When you make a payment toward your student loan, Travelers will make an annual contribution into your 401(k) account. You are also eligible for a Pension Plan that is 100% funded by Travelers. * **Paid Time Off:** Start your career at Travelers with a minimum of 20 days Paid Time Off annually, plus nine paid company Holidays. * **Wellness Program:** The Travelers wellness program is comprised of tools, discounts and resources that empower you to achieve your wellness goals and caregiving needs. To learn more about our comprehensive benefit programs please visit http://careers.travelers.com/life\-at\-travelers/benefits/.

jobs.title: Applications Development Manager
jobs.description: **Role Summary** Reporting to the Vice President, Insurance Platform Delivery, the Applications Development Manager leads the development, maintenance, support, and ongoing improvement of Trusted Fraternal Life’s software applications. This role provides functional and technical leadership to the Applications Development team while establishing the standards, processes, and governance needed to deliver reliable, scalable, and sustainable technology solutions. The Applications Development Manager oversees the software development lifecycle, development and deployment pipelines, database development, and data migration activities. Working closely with Quality Assurance, Product Management, business partners, and other technology teams, this leader ensures applications and solutions support business priorities, project milestones, and the organization’s evolving technology needs. **Responsibilities** * Lead the day\-to\-day activities of the Applications Development team, providing direction, coaching, development opportunities, and accountability. * Establish and oversee software development standards, governance practices, and the software development lifecycle, including source control, documentation, testing, deployment, release management, and quality assurance. * Lead software design reviews, code reviews, and technical decision\-making to ensure solutions align with business requirements, technical standards, security expectations, and long\-term technology goals. * Establish and manage disciplined configurations practices for the policy administration system, including version control, documentation, unit testing, promotion across environments, release coordination, and auditability of changes. * Develop and manage CI/CD pipelines and development processes that support the reliable, efficient movement of code from development through production. * Provide leadership and oversight for application development, database development, database management, data integration, and data migration activities. * Partner with business leaders and technology teams to establish priorities, evaluate requirements, identify solution options, and deliver technology solutions that support organizational objectives. * Develop and maintain processes to effectively prioritize, assign, track, and deliver project work, production support, policy administration conversion activities, and strategic initiatives. * Establish and monitor meaningful operational and delivery metrics to drive productivity, quality, capacity planning, accountability, and continuous improvement. * Develop resourcing strategies, manage budget responsibilities, and ensure the team has the tools, technology, and support needed for effective and cost\-efficient delivery. * Hire, develop, mentor, and evaluate team members while fostering a collaborative, accountable, and high\-performing culture and successfully leading the team through change. **Qualifications \& Skills** * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information technology, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience. * Minimum of 10 years of progressive software development and technology leadership experience. * Significant hands\-on experience in software and database development, with the technical expertise to conduct code reviews, design reviews, and mentor development teams. * Strong experience with the Microsoft technology stack, including C\#, .NET, Visual Studio, Azure DevOps, Microsoft Azure, web technologies, and SQL Server. * Experience establishing and managing software development frameworks, governance practices, source control standards, documentation standards, and CI/CD pipelines. * Experience working across the full software development lifecycle, from solution design through implementation, support, and continuous improvement. * Experience managing the configuration of a life insurance and annuity policy administration system, including product setup, business rules, workflows, calculations, forms, and controlled promotion of changes across environments. * Demonstrated success leading technical teams, establishing new processes and standards, and driving organizational, process, or technology change. * Strong analytical, critical\-thinking, and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to translate business needs into effective technology solutions and strategic plans. * Demonstrated ability to influence stakeholders, build strong cross\-functional partnerships, manage competing priorities, and deliver results in a fast\-paced environment. * Experience within the life insurance, annuity, or other highly regulated industry environment preferred. Agile development experience also preferred. **Position Specific Competencies** * Technical Leadership: Demonstrates strong software development expertise and technical credibility. Provides guidance on application architecture, software design, development practices, databases, policy administration system configuration, and modern software delivery approaches while effectively communicating technical concepts to diverse audiences. * Operational Excellence: Establishes and continuously improves standards, governance, development processes, documentation practices, metrics, and delivery discipline to support scalable, high\-quality technology solutions. * People Leadership: Builds, develops, and coaches high\-performing teams by creating accountability, fostering collaboration, supporting professional growth, and leading others effectively through change. * Strategic Thinking \& Partnership: Applies critical thinking and sound judgment to solve complex problems, sees the broader business impact of technology decisions, and builds strong partnerships across business and technology teams to deliver meaningful results.

Support technology implementations across multiple manufacturing facilities and assist in establishing standardized support practices. Troubleshoot and resolve issues affecting production, logistics, inventory management, mobile devices, printers, scanners, and shop\-floor technology. Support handheld scanners, tablets, kiosks, label printers, mobile carts, and warehouse technology systems. Maintain updated documentation of assigned requests within ticket management system. Support development of knowledge\-based articles based on ticket resolutions as applicable. jobs.description: Job Title: Benchling Developer Job Function: Developer Location: Thousand Oaks, CA **About USDM** USDM Life Sciences is a premier consulting company with 20\+ years of experience assisting heavily regulated biotech, medical device, and pharmaceutical companies with their GxP technologies to accelerate growth. Our deep domain knowledge and technology expertise in life sciences business processes are what set us apart. From strategy to implementation and adoption, we have delivered thousands of GxP projects globally. As part of the USDM team, you have the opportunity to work with cutting\-edge technologies through our many partnerships with companies like Microsoft, Google, Oracle, DocuSign, Box, and many more. From molecule to market, you will help connect technology, people, and data in new ways to generate real\-time insights to improve business outcomes for USDM’s clients. Are you ready to make an impact and drive real digital transformation in life sciences? jobs.title: Software Engineer II - Engineer
jobs.description: **About the Role** We are hiring a Software Engineer II for the Login Services Platform Engineering team within Core Security Engineering. Our mission is to build the foundational identity platform that Uber's security and infrastructure organization runs on \- spanning how we govern non\-human identities, how we model identity and access as queryable knowledge, and how we authenticate and authorize both people and autonomous agents at scale. You'll work across three interconnected platform programs: Non\-Human Identity (NHI) Governance, the Security Knowledge Graph, and uSSO / Agentic R\&D. Each is foundational infrastructure that other security and engineering teams build on top of \- which means the systems you write need to be correct, observable, and safe to depend on. **What You'll Do** **Non\-Human Identity Governance** \- Build the tooling and detection logic that governs the sprawling web of permissions between personnel, workloads, agents, service accounts, and infrastructure. Develop inventory and risk\-identification pipelines that surface dangerous patterns \- runaway group membership, over\-privileged service accounts \- before they become incidents. Contribute to eliminating personnel misuse of non\-human identities by migrating credentials to secretless patterns and onboarding privileged access management (PAM) enforcement. **Security Knowledge Graph** \- Help build a single, queryable knowledge graph of identity, assets, ownership, and access controls that is becoming foundational to Uber's security infrastructure strategy. Design and ship the ingestion framework, CI/CD pipeline, and self\-service tooling (schema browsing, query benchmarking, scaffolding) that let any security or infra team onboard their own data sources without bespoke integration work. Build toward near\-real\-time ingestion for high\-value signals like access and group\-membership changes, and extend the graph to support both human consumers (dashboards, investigation tools) and AI agents querying it directly. **uSSO / Agentic R\&D** \- Help evolve uSSO into an identity platform that works natively for both humans and autonomous agents, strengthening authentication as more of Uber's workload shifts to agentic systems acting on behalf of people and services. This means building the underlying platform to be robust and agent\-compatible, and defining how Uber issues, verifies, and scopes identity for agents \- establishing clear on\-behalf\-of relationships and policy standards for how agents can safely access production systems and SaaS. Diagnose and resolve complex distributed\-systems problems across these platforms under continuous, high\-volume, security\-critical traffic \- with a focus on correctness, latency, and operational resilience. **Basic Qualifications** 4\+ years of professional experience as a Software Engineer, with experience designing, building, and operating distributed systems in a production environment. Ability to take ownership of a well\-scoped technical problem, break it into concrete steps, and drive it to completion with appropriate urgency. Working knowledge of backend infrastructure fundamentals: service architecture, data stores, caching, and asynchronous/event\-driven messaging. **Preferred Qualifications** Experience with graph data models and query languages (e.g., Cypher), or with streaming/near\-real\-time data pipelines (e.g., Kafka, Flink). Experience with identity and access management concepts: service accounts, privileged access management, non\-human identity, OAuth, or SSO. Interest or experience in emerging problems around AI agent identity and authorization \- how autonomous systems should be authenticated, scoped, and audited. Familiarity with Golang and with modernizing legacy backend systems. For San Francisco, CA\-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $171,000 per year \- USD $190,000 per year. You will be eligible to participate in Uber's bonus program, and may be offered an equity award \& other types of comp. All full\-time employees are eligible to participate in a 401(k) plan. You will also be eligible for various benefits. **Ready to Ride?** This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook \- it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves \- we'd love to hear from you. You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits. Offices remain key to collaboration and Uber's culture. Unless approved for full remote work, employees must spend at least 50% of their time in\-office. Some roles, like those at greenlight hubs, require full\-time in\-office presence. Ask your Recruiter for details about this role's requirements. Uber is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law. jobs.title: Senior Core Engineer
jobs.description: **The Opportunity** PolySpatial is the core technology behind Unity's support for visionOS, streaming Unity games into Fortnite, and iteration tools like Play to Device, Scene Recording, and AI data capture and analysis. Underneath all of it is a single model for connecting devices, users, applications, and even different game engines, and we're constantly finding new places to put it to work. We're looking for engineers eager to help us invent how different real\-time 3D runtimes communicate and render under real\-world constraints. You’ll work at the intersection of core engine tech, high\-performance networking, distributed systems, and graphics. This is your opportunity to build the fundamental infrastructure for the next generation of interconnected game and 3D ecosystems. You’ll own critical tech that enables Unity to run as a guest within other processes, engines, and distributed systems. This is deep engine work requiring a holistic understanding of execution models, serialization, asset lifecycles, and runtime performance—all operating reliably in host environments we don’t control. You'll design systems that allow Unity to load, run, and synchronize assets when we don't own the main loop, design clean, extensible architecture, then drop into assembly to shave off milliseconds. **What you’ll be doing:** * Own and evolve critical subsystems across the engine stack, from low\-level C\+\+ to high\-level C\# APIs across editor, build, and runtime code. * Design and implement high\-performance, extensible APIs intended for embedded, cross\-process, and networked configurations. * Develop schemes to manage execution timing and resource contention within or between processes and over the network with minimal overhead * Orchestrate loading, change tracking, serializing, and synchronizing components and assets in bandwidth and latency\-constrained environments. **What we’re looking for:** * Core Engine Expertise: Experience building or fundamentally extending game engine cores, middleware, or foundational systems (e.g., serialization, build pipelines, memory subsystems). * Architectural Vision \+ Practical Implementation: Design modular, testable systems, then implement and debug them yourself end\-to\-end * High\-Performance Coding: Strong C\+\+ and C\# skills, with practical understanding of CPU caches, branch behavior, memory layout, and profiling. * Engine\-Wide Breadth: Hands\-on experience across multiple engine domains (e.g., physics, animation, input, assets) and how they interact. **You might also have:** * Familiarity with compression, streaming, replication, authority models, RPCs, state diffing, delta encoding, or network protocols for real\-time interactive systems. * Experience with determinism, replay systems and simulation consistency. * Deep knowledge of multithreading, job systems, lock\-free techniques, and/or Unity DOTS. * Experience with MCP\-style tool interfaces, training data generation, machine learning, or agentic workflows. **Additional information** * Relocation support is not available for this position * Work jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description: **The opportunity** ------------------- At Unity, we’re shaping the future of real\-time 3D development by enabling creators to harness intelligent, autonomous systems. Our next\-generation agentic AI \- goal\-directed, adaptive, and capable of reasoning and planning in dynamic environments \- is transforming how games and simulations come to life. We’re looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to lead the development of these foundational AI systems within the Unity engine, empowering creators to build smarter, more responsive in\-game agents and simulations. jobs.description: **Research Software Engineer \- iBioFoundry, Carl R. Woese Institute for Genomic Biology** ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ ### **Carl R. Woese Institute for Genomic Biology** The NSF iBioFoundry operates a cloud\-based biofoundry that automates basic and applied biological research using artificial intelligence and robotics. We are seeking an experienced, self\-motivated Research Software Engineer to lead software development toward a fully autonomous laboratory capable of planning and executing experiments with minimal human intervention. You will help build the next generation of biofoundries: fully automated, self\-driving, and remotely accessible to enable the broader scientific community to advance synthetic biology and related fields. We are looking for someone with hands\-on experience in software architecture, AI\-driven systems, and IT operations who thrives in a focused, high\-ownership environment. #### **Job Summary** The Research Software Engineer develops, maintains, and supports the software infrastructure that enables automated and autonomous laboratory operations within the NSF iBioFoundry. The position is responsible for designing and implementing reliable software systems that integrate artificial intelligence, robotics, laboratory automation, and distributed computing to support the planning and execution of biological research experiments. This position provides technical expertise and full management of critical software infrastructure, with an emphasis on system reliability, fault tolerance, observability, and safe operation. #### **Duties \& Responsibilities** * Implement, operate, and continuously improve a multi\-agent AI system that plans biological research and translates high\-level research objectives into executable experimental workflows. Integrate AI\-generated workflows with robotic systems and a central scheduler controlling laboratory instruments, including liquid handlers, thermocyclers, incubators, plate readers, and mass spectrometers. * Maintain and implement critical components of the software backbone supporting autonomous laboratory operations. Write, test, document, and maintain failure\-sensitive software with a strong emphasis on reliability, observability, fault tolerance, and safe operation. Develop deep system\-level expertise and take ownership of the technical integrity of core infrastructure. * Develop and maintain an open\-source scheduler for experiment planning, instrument coordination, and laboratory automation in close collaboration with researchers and engineers. Design scheduling infrastructure that can reliably coordinate complex, concurrent workflows across heterogeneous laboratory equipment. * Design software architecture and operational practices that enable rapid troubleshooting, clear failure diagnosis, and long\-term system evolution. Establish and promote engineering best practices for testing, monitoring, deployment, documentation, version control, and incident response in a complex research environment. * Build robust data pipelines, services, and APIs connecting AI agents, laboratory instruments, experiment\-management systems, and scientific databases. Ensure that experimental data and system state are reliably captured, accessible, traceable, and usable by both humans and AI systems. * As the program grows, you will have increasing responsibility for coordinating a team of graduate students and postdoctoral researchers. Assign and prioritize technical work, review code and architectural decisions, establish software engineering best practices, and mentor team members through successful project delivery. #### **Minimum Qualifications** Bachelor's degree in computer science, Artificial Intelligence, bioinformatics, computational biology, software engineering, or a related field. 2\+ years of professional full\-stack software development experience in relevant areas such as biology, chemistry, engineering, or similar. Hands on experience with agent AI and/or physical AI systems. Experience with laboratory hardware automation, e.g., Tecan, Beckman Coulter, Thermo Fisher. Prior contributions to scientific open source software or AI for science projects. #### **Knowledge, Skills and Abilities** * Research\-oriented mindset, comfortable with ambiguity and iterative experimentation. * Strong sense of ownership: identifies problems and drives solutions proactively. * Excellent communication skills and ability to work closely with biologists and engineers. * Enjoyment of mentoring students through code review and project guidance. * Solid software engineering fundamentals: version control, testing, modular design, and CI/CD. #### **Appointment Information** This is a 100% full\-time Academic Professional position, appointed on a 12\-month basis. The expected start date is as soon as possible after 11/1/2026\. The budgeted salary range for this position is $75,000 \- $100,000 per year. jobs.title: Project Engineer
jobs.description: 15000 Valmont Plaza Omaha Nebraska 68154 ***Why Valmont*** **We’re Here to Move the World Forward.** Valmont impacts millions of people around the world every day, yet they might not realize the many ways. Our technology is helping feed the growing population, supplying the world with more reliable energy and access to renewables, enhancing connectivity in remote and urban locations to create a sustainable future and so much more. Simply put, Valmont is advancing agricultural productivity and reimagining vital infrastructure to make life better. Join a *Fortune* 1000 company that respects hard work, honors diversity and invests in our employees as we focus on creating the world of tomorrow, today . *We are the modern workforce* . Are you ready to move the world forward? Apply now. **A Brief Summary of This Position:** The Project Engineer – Telecom Macro Structures is an individual contributor responsible for the structural analysis, design, review, and approval of Macro telecom structures, including self\-supporting towers, guyed towers, monopoles, foundations, and related engineered products. The position primarily supports Macro products and is responsible for developing safe, manufacturable, and cost\-effective engineering solutions that meet customer requirements, applicable codes, and Valmont standards. The Project Engineer independently executes standard structural engineering assignments from quotation through order execution and provides PE\-level review and approval within established responsibilities. The role also supports customer and field needs, NPD execution, engineering standardization, automation, process improvement, and development of less\-experienced technical resources. **Essential Functions:** * Perform structural analysis and design of self\-supporting towers, guyed towers, monopoles, foundations, existing structures, and related Macro products using applicable engineering methods and analysis software. * Independently process and review engineering designs for quotations and orders, ensuring compliance with customer requirements, applicable codes, Valmont standards, manufacturing requirements, and project commitments. * Prepare, review, approve, and stamp engineering calculations and designs within the incumbent's professional competence and assigned technical responsibilities, including primarily their own work and limited review of work prepared by others. * Interpret customer specifications, loading criteria, geotechnical information, project requirements, and applicable codes to develop safe, manufacturable, and economical engineering solutions. * Provide continuity from quotation through order execution, coordinating with Drafting to ensure approved engineering requirements are accurately translated into drawings, Bills of Materials, and manufacturing documentation. * Provide direct technical support to customers, Sales Application Engineering, PLM, Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain, and other stakeholders as required. * Take technical ownership of typical field and product\-performance issues, including investigation, root\-cause evaluation, and corrective recommendations, while supporting senior technical resources on complex or high\-risk issues. * Serve as technical lead for selected NPD projects and support product development, standardization, and other strategic business initiatives as assigned. * Support development and validation of engineering automation and calculation tools by defining engineering requirements, reviewing design logic, establishing acceptance criteria, and participating in technical testing and validation. * Lead smaller engineering process\-improvement and standardization initiatives and participate in larger initiatives that improve quality, productivity, cycle time, manufacturability, and reuse of proven engineering solutions. * Share technical knowledge and provide guidance and mentoring to less\-experienced engineers and other technical resources as appropriate. * Maintain knowledge of applicable structural codes, customer requirements, industry practices, and technology changes and participate in relevant customer, technical, or industry activities as appropriate **Other Important Details about the Role:** The incumbent must demonstrate strong technical competence in Telecom structural engineering, including structural loading, steel design, foundation design, fabrication/manufacturing considerations, and application of relevant design codes. Prior Telecom industry structural engineering experience is required, with experience supporting tower and/or monopole products strongly aligned with the immediate needs of the position. The Project Engineer is expected to independently execute standard work while recognizing technical risk and escalating unusual, novel, or high\-risk applications to senior technical resources or the Engineering Manager – Macro/Structures. The position will primarily support Valmont’s tower products but may support other Telecom products as business needs require. Success in this role requires strong ownership of assigned work, direct customer engagement, cross\-functional collaboration, and continuous development of technical capability. Within approximately the first year, the incumbent is expected to be capable of independently processing quote designs, reviewing quote designs, processing order designs, and reviewing order designs for applicable Macro products. **Required Qualifications of Every Candidate (Education, Experience, Knowledge, Skills and Abilities):** * Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering, Structural Engineering, or a closely related engineering discipline with 5\+ years of relevant structural engineering experience. * Current Professional Engineer (PE) license, with the ability to obtain additional state registrations as required. * Demonstrated Telecom industry structural engineering experience, including design and/or analysis of telecom towers, monopoles, foundations, existing structures, or comparable telecommunications support structures. * Strong working knowledge of structural design codes and engineering methods applicable to Telecom structures, including TIA\-222, IBC, AISC, ACI, and related standards, with experience using structural\-analysis software such as TNX Tower, RISA\-3D, or comparable tools. * Demonstrated ability to independently manage engineering projects and priorities, exercise sound professional judgment, solve technical problems, and communicate effectively with customers and cross\-functional stakeholders. **Highly Qualified Candidates Will Also Possess These Qualifications:** * Master's degree in Civil or Structural Engineering. * Experience across multiple Macro structure types, including self\-supporting towers, guyed towers, monopoles, foundations, and structural reanalysis/modifications. * Experience leading NPD engineering execution, engineering standardization, automation/tool validation, or process\-improvement initiatives. * Working knowledge of steel fabrication, welding, manufacturing processes, quality requirements, and investigation/resolution of field issues. Pay: $76,800 to $120,000\. **Benefits** Valmont offers employees and their families a comprehensive Total Wellbeing benefit package to ensure their individual and family’s overall wellness needs are met. Some offerings are dependent upon the role, work schedule, or location and can include the following: * Healthcare (medical, prescription drugs, dental and vision) * 401k retirement plan with company match * Paid time off * Employer paid life insurance * Employer paid short\-term and long\-term disability including maternity leave * Work Life Support * Tuition Reimbursement up to $5,250 per year * Voluntary programs like tobacco cessation, Type 2 diabetes reversal, one\-on\-one health coaching, mortgage services and more Valmont does not discriminate against any employee or applicant in employment opportunities or practices on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, genetic information, veteran status, disability or any other characteristic protected by law. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. If you have a disability and require any assistance in filling out the application for employment email EEOCompliance@Valmont.com.

jobs.title: Research Engineer, Institute for Software Integrated Systems
jobs.description: The Research Engineer is part of the Institute for Software Integrated Systems at Vanderbilt University and is a key individual contributor responsible for assisting with the development, integration, and maintenance of discipline\-specific software systems, web\-based applications, and engineering tools to support project and research goals. This position involves engineering and software design, web application development, cloud integration, maintenance, and experimentation as directed by the Principal Investigator. Reporting directly to the Principal Investigator, the Research Engineer regularly collaborates with a multidisciplinary team including Research Engineers, Research Scientists, Graduate Students, and stakeholders to accomplish project\-specific goals. **About the Work Unit:** The Institute for Software Integrated Systems conducts basic and applied research in the area of systems and information science and engineering. Applications of its technology span a wide range of software intensive systems from small embedded devices, through real\-time distributed systems, to globally deployed complex systems. Software is increasingly essential to the functions of these systems, and it is also the primary means of adapting them to their environments and users. Our research interests lie in the theoretical foundations, modeling, design, engineering, and educational aspects of these systems. **Key Functions and Expected Performance:** Development: 40% * Assist with modeling and analysis of discipline\-specific engineering problems. * Design, develop, and maintain web\-based applications, APIs, and interfaces supporting research and project goals. * Assist with cloud development, deployment, and integration of AI\-driven and data intensive applications. * Contribute to the development and maintenance of discipline\-specific software systems and engineering tools. * Perform engineering and software design, implementation, testing, analysis, maintenance, or experimentation as directed. Project Management: 30% * Prepare high\-quality technical documentation for project deliverables, including software, web systems, and APIs. * Maintain expertise in emerging technologies and modern web frameworks relevant to project goals. * Collaborate effectively with team members using version control systems and collaborative development platforms (e.g., GitHub). * Recommend, implement, and adhere to technical standards and best practices, including secure coding and responsive web design principles. Collaboration and Communication: 30% * Provide technical input for evaluating project direction and progress. * Create and deliver progress reports and presentations to project staff and stakeholders. * Share research findings, development processes, and technical knowledge with the Principal Investigator and research team. **Supervisory Relationships:** This position does not have supervisory responsibility; this position reports administratively and functionally to the Principal Investigator. **Education and Certifications:** A Bachelor’s degree in computer science or a related engineering discipline is necessary. **Experience and Skills:** The following skills are necessary: * Practical knowledge of programming languages such as Python, Julia, MATLAB, or similar languages. * Experience with cloud computing platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP). * Experience with Docker. * Proficiency in software system development, modeling, and systems engineering. * Ability to design, implement, test, document, and maintain both backend and frontend software (React, FastAPI, Flask, Node.js). * Familiarity with deploying and interacting with databases (MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Redis). * Experience with modern software development environments (e.g., VS Code), version control (Git), and CI/CD pipelines. * Ability to adapt quickly in high\-paced research environments with evolving goals. * Experience working in teams of varying sizes (small to large research or development projects). The following skills are preferred: * Experience with research activities aligned with the Institute’s focus areas. * Experience with AI (machine learning and planning) technologies. * Experience with optimization theory and methods * Knowledge of model\-based engineering principles and software architecture design. * Strong communication skills for working with researchers, graduate students, and stakeholders. * Ability to produce high\-quality technical documentation for web\-based and software deliverables.

jobs.title: Software Engineer (Front End)
jobs.description: **Company Description** System High is a wholly owned subsidiary of Veilant, delivering advanced protection and secrecy solutions that secure and strengthen critical missions, programs, and intelligence activities. We support some of the nation’s most sensitive efforts, and our team plays a direct role in protecting what matters most. As part of Veilant, System High combines deep mission expertise with the resources and capabilities of a broader organization focused on protecting and advancing critical national security missions. **Job Description** **Want to build instead of inherit?** System High is looking for a Software Engineer specializing in frontend development to take ownership of the user\-facing application layer of a new software product being built from the ground up. This is a true greenfield opportunity. You won’t be inheriting years of legacy frontend code or simply working through an established backlog. You’ll have the opportunity to help establish the frontend architecture, component patterns, development workflows, and technical standards that shape the application as it grows. We’re looking for an engineer who combines strong frontend development skills with broader software engineering fundamentals. You should be comfortable building modern web applications, integrating with APIs, working within GitHub and CI/CD workflows, and collaborating closely with backend engineers and other technical specialists. React is our preferred direction, but because the application is still being built, we value strong engineering fundamentals and experience with modern frontend frameworks over expertise in one narrowly defined stack. We also want someone who knows how to use modern AI\-assisted development tools effectively. AI should make you faster at tasks like documentation, testing, scaffolding, debugging, and repetitive development but it shouldn't replace your ability to understand the code, challenge the output, and make sound engineering decisions. If you're energized by a blank canvas, enjoy solving problems without having every step prescribed, and want to see your technical decisions directly influence a new product, this is an opportunity to make a meaningful impact. **What You’ll Do** * **Own the Frontend Application Layer:** Help design and build the frontend from the ground up, establishing scalable patterns for components, routing, state management, performance, accessibility, and maintainability. * **Build Production\-Ready Experiences:** Translate product requirements and UI/UX concepts into responsive, intuitive, high\-quality application features. * **Integrate with APIs:** Build reliable integrations between the frontend and backend services, confidently working with API contracts, data structures, payloads, application state, error handling, and asynchronous workflows. * **Shape Frontend Architecture:** Participate in technical decisions around frameworks, libraries, application structure, reusable components, testing strategies, and development standards. * **Work Across Engineering Boundaries:** Collaborate with backend development, AI/technical specialists, QA, and product leadership to solve problems that span multiple parts of the application. * **Build Efficient Development Workflows:** Work within GitHub, AWS/GIT\-based workflows, and CI/CD pipelines to support reliable development, testing, integration, and deployment. * **Use AI to Increase Engineering Velocity:** Apply AI\-assisted development tools to accelerate documentation, testing, debugging, code scaffolding, and repetitive engineering tasks while independently reviewing, validating, and improving generated output. * **Automate Where It Makes Sense:** Write lightweight scripts or utilities to eliminate repetitive tasks, manipulate data, support development environments, or improve engineering workflows. * **Deliver Iteratively:** Break complex requirements into manageable technical tasks and deliver working software through an Agile/Scrum development process. * **Contribute Beyond Your Code:** Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, sprint planning, estimation, and continuous improvement of the team's engineering practices. **What Success Looks Like** **Within your first six months, you will have:** * Helped establish the technical foundation and architecture of a new frontend application. * Built and delivered production\-ready features that turn product requirements into an intuitive user experience. * Established reliable integrations between the frontend and backend APIs. * Contributed reusable components, patterns, and development standards that make the application easier to extend and maintain. * Demonstrated the ability to independently troubleshoot issues across the frontend, API, data, and development workflow layers. * Integrated AI\-assisted development into your workflow in ways that measurably improve speed and efficiency without compromising engineering quality. * Become a trusted techni t. * Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively in a remote engineering environment. **Nice to Haves** * Experience helping build a new application, product, or significant feature from the ground up. * Experience with React, Next.js, and TypeScript. * Familiarity with GIT/AWS development workflows, CI/CD pipelines, or cloud\-based application delivery. * Experience working across frontend/backend boundaries or collaborating closely with backend engineering teams. * Familiarity with scripting or automation using Node.js, Python, Bash, or similar technologies. * Experience establishing frontend architecture, component libraries, design systems, or engineering standards. * Experience with automated frontend or unit testing. * Exposure to applications incorporating AI/LLM capabilities or other intelligent application services. * Experience working in Agile/Scrum software development environments. **Who Will Thrive in This Role** You’re likely to enjoy this role if you like building more than maintaining. You don’t need someone else to define every implementation detail before you can get started. You’re comfortable taking a requirement, asking the right questions, evaluating different approaches, making a recommendation, and turning that recommendation into working software. You also recognize that modern engineering is changing. You’re interested in using AI and automation to remove repetitive work and increase your output, but you understand that engineering judgment still matters. You can explain your code, defend your technical decisions, identify when generated code is wrong, and improve a solution rather than accepting the first answer a tool provides. Most importantly, you want ownership. This is an opportunity to help establish something new rather than simply inherit what someone else already built. **Additional Information** **What is the Compensation Range for this role?** The salary range for this position is $100,000 \- $125,000 annually for full\-time status. Actual compensation within this range at Veilant is determined by numerous factors including but not limited to the candidate's qualifications, including experience, education, certifications, technical skills, as well as contract\-specific affordability and labor categories, the scope and responsibilities of the role, market and business considerations, and geographic location. **Here are some Perks at System High!** **Benefits That Support Your Life and Career** * Medical, dental, vision, and prescription coverage options. * Paid time off that grows with tenure, plus 11 paid holidays annually. * A 401(k) retirement savings plan and financial planning guidance. * Up to $5,250 annually in tuition assistance for approved coursework. * Support for professional training and certifications. * Company HSA contributions of $600 for individual coverage or $1,200 for family coverage, prorated. * Company paid life insurance, plus short term and long term disability coverage. **Physical Requirements:** * Must be able to remain in a stationary position 50% of the time. The person in this position needs to occasionally move about inside the office * Constantly work with computers and other information technology equipment * The ability to communicate information and ideas in a classroom style format, may stand at a podium for long periods of time *We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace.* *If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a position with Veilant through its online applicant system, please contact Veilant's Talent Management Department at (703\) 544\-2424 or contact us through e\-mail at* *contact\_us@**veilant.com*

jobs.title: Technical Expert Engineer (North America, Remote)
jobs.description: **About the opportunity** VictoriaMetrics is a fast\-growing company revolutionizing open\-source monitoring and observability solutions. We’re trusted by enterprises and the open\-source community alike to provide high\-performance, scalable solutions. We operate in a dynamic, startup environment where innovation and customer satisfaction are at the core of what we do. As our **Support Department** evolves, we are looking for a highly skilled and motivated **VictoriaMetrics Expert** to join our **Expertise Center** team. This role is for an experienced specialist with a strong background in development and/or high\-level systems engineering. We need a specialist with a proven track record of deep technical analysis who will focus on building our internal technical expertise to provide first\-class assistance to our enterprise clients, develop internal monitoring, and create tooling. **Role Overview:** Your responsibilities as a VictoriaMetrics Expert will include: * Taking deep dives into complex customer issues, reproducing them in sandbox environments, including under load. * Work closely with the development team to resolve identified problems. * Creating and developing internal tooling (Go is a significant advantage) to improve observability, automation (e.g., problem detection, AI integrations), and overall operational efficiency. * Developing internal monitoring, creating runbooks, dashboards, and guides. * Handling problem management: performing root cause analysis and driving long\-term solutions, including creating artifacts (docs, runbooks). * Building and maintaining the internal knowledge base to support other teams. * Collaborating with other teams (engineering, customer success, solution engineering) to address complex issues and contribute to product improvement. * Participating in critical incident resolution with a focus on rapid mitigation followed by root cause analysis. * The preferred time zone for this position is GMT \-5 – GMT \-8\. * We operate in a fully remote setup with a flexible schedule. This is a contract position (a service agreement with a US entity; self\-employed or sole proprietor status is possible). **Key Qualifications:** * **Required Experience:** + A minimum of 4\-5\+ years in a senior technical position, such as Software Developer, SRE, Performance Engineer, or Systems Engineer role. * **Technical Skills:** + Advanced troubleshooting skills. + Deep knowledge of programming or scripting languages (experience with Go is a plus). + Practical experience with Kubernetes (K8s). + Knowledge of Linux (advanced knowledge is a plus). + Understanding of IT infrastructure and troubleshooting distributed systems. * **Soft Skills:** + Excellent communication skills, able to clearly explain complex technical concepts in English. + A passion for solving complex technical problems and building expertise. + A sense of responsibility and urgency working with external customers. + A quick learner with a proactive attitude and a passion for problem\-solving. * **Startup Mindset:** + Comfortable with evolving processes and the need for flexibility. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Experience with VictoriaMetrics or other time\-series databases/monitoring tools (Grafana/Prometheus). * Familiarity with VictoriaLogs or other log storage and analysis platforms is a strong plus * Experience with open\-source technologies and community engagement. **About VictoriaMetrics:** We are the company behind the popular open\-source, high\-performance time\-series database and monitoring solution: VictoriaMetrics. We’ve recently introduced our open source logs management product, VictoriaLogs, as well as the brand\-new VictoriaTraces. Fortune 500 companies use our products as their core monitoring \& observability solutions. Our services are used by Spotify, Hubspot, WIX, Grammarly, CERN and thousands of others. Our open source products have been downloaded 1B\+ times to date. We are a profitable company with a fully remote team distributed worldwide. **Interview Process:** * **Introductory Video Call (30 min):** Meet to discuss your experience and fit and clarify role and expectations. * **Technical Interview (1 hr):** A deep dive into your technical skills with our team. * **Call with founders (optional, 30 min):** An extra session, if needed. * **Offer:** Embark on your journey with VictoriaMetrics.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Full Stack

All roles require digital fluency, including the ability to work with emerging technologies such as Generative AI tools (e.g. ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot) to support everyday work. Key Responsibilities: * Collaborate with stakeholders to interpret requirements for project components and incorporate feedback into future designs or solution fixes. * Translate business requirements by verifying assumptions and escalating potential design issues to appropriate stakeholders. * Participate in system design and architecture, refining code plans and contributing to design documentation. * Contribute to project estimation and escalate issues that may cause delays. * Develop, implement, and maintain code for products, services, or components, applying coding patterns, guidelines, and best practices. * Apply debugging tools to verify assumptions and proactively flag issues before they occur. * Participate in code reviews to ensure coding standards are followed and address routine pull requests. * Create test plans and configure testing procedures to identify and resolve defects for multiple features. * Respond to support requests during on\-call rotations, troubleshooting issues and deploying fixes under guidance. * Leverage and build knowledge of software developer tools to create, debug, and maintain code for components. * Remain current in skills by investing time in training resources to improve product availability, reliability, efficiency, observability, and performance. This is a hybrid position. Expectation of days in the office will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager. **Qualifications** Basic Qualifications: * 2 or more years of work experience with a Bachelor’s Degree or an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD, or PhD) Preferred Qualifications: * 3 or more years of work experience with a Bachelor’s Degree or more than 2 years of work experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD). * 3\+ years of relevant work experience and a Bachelor's degree, OR 5\+ years of relevant work experience. * Experience in technologies/software systems or a directly related field (minimum two years). * Experience in developing and/or implementing web\-based applications including front\-end and backend (minimum two years). * Experience in system design and architecture for product components. * Experience in debugging and troubleshooting software issues. * Experience in code review and applying coding standards. * Experience in test planning and execution for software features. * Experience in responding to support requests and deploying fixes. * Experience in using software developer tools for code creation and maintenance. * Experience in Compliance is a plus * Experience building and testing enterprise\-scale web services (minimum one year). * Experience working on client\-facing project or technical teams (minimum one year). * Experience in integrating feedback into design and solution fixes. * Experience in mentoring junior engineers and collaborating with cross\-functional teams. * **Experience with Generative AI (GenAI)** – LLM agents, RAG systems, NLP, AI‑assisted investigations **Information for US Applicants** For roles located in the US, the estimated salary range for this position is $123,000\.00 to $ 190,900\.00 USD per year, which may include potential sales incentive payments (if applicable). Salary may vary depending on job\-related factors which may include knowledge, skills, experience, and location. In addition, this position may be eligible for bonus and equity.Visa has a comprehensive benefits package for which this position may be eligible that includes Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k), FSA/HSA, Life Insurance, Paid Time Off, and Wellness Program.**Work Hours** Varies upon the needs of the department. **Travel Requirements** This position requires travel 5\-10% of the time. **Mental/Physical Requirements** This position will be performed in an office setting. The position will require the incumbent to sit and stand at a desk, communicate in person and by telephone, frequently operate standard office equipment, such as telephones and computers. **Visa is an EEO Employer** Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protect veteran status. jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Summary** =========== Vital Services is seeking a talented and experienced Mid\-Level Software Engineer to join our growing Application Engineering department. This is an extraordinary opportunity to be a part of, and play an integral role in, the expansion of our Information Technology team. The core focus of this role is to write clean, secure, and highly efficient code that successfully implements functional requirements, ensuring rapid features delivery and high system reliability across active product and T\&M client queues. **Roles \& Responsibilities of the Software Engineer** ====================================================== * **Feature Implementation \& Delivery:** Writing well\-structured, testable, and maintainable application code that fulfills documented user stories and technical design specs. * **Defect Resolution \& Support Execution:** Investigating, triaging, and patching software bugs and performance issues efficiently across SaaS platforms and custom client applications. * **API \& Data Flow Execution:** Building and consuming secure web services, endpoints, and third\-party API extractions based on the patterns outlined by the Architect. * **Code Quality \& Testing Discipline:** Participating actively in peer code reviews, adhering to organizational standards, and writing comprehensive unit and integration tests. * **Sprint Hygiene \& Operational Visibility:** Estimating assigned tasks accurately, updating Jira tickets daily, and actively raising dependencies during sprint ceremonies to protect velocity. **Skills \& Experience of the Software Engineer** ================================================= * **Professional Core Experience:** 3\-6 years of verified full\-stack or backend software engineering experience operating within an agile team ecosystem (experience in multi\-client agency or SaaS environments is a plus). * **Technical Stack Proficiency:** Solid proficiency in C\# languages and core object\-oriented programming methodologies in a Microsoft tech stack environment. * **Database Conversance:** Clear comfort writing optimized queries and interacting with relational or non\-relational database engines (e.g., SQL/MySQL). * **Version Control Mastery:** Complete fluency with Git workflow mechanics, branching strategies, and handling merge conflicts cleanly. * **Implementation Mindset:** A strong track record of taking well\-defined, abstract functional requirements and successfully transforming them into live, working software capabilities without needing extensive architectural oversight. **Success Metrics of the Software Engineer** ============================================ * **Individual Sprint Say/Do Ratio:** \>\= 80% predictability on completing committed sprint tasks and feature points. * **Code Review Turnaround Time:** Review and provide actionable feedback on peer pull requests within an average of \< 24 hours to prevent pipeline blockages. * **Post\-Deployment Defect Leaks:** Maintain a threshold of \< 2 critical execution defects or breaking bugs introduced to production environments per quarter. * **Jira \& Time\-Tracking Accuracy:** 100% weekly compliance on task logging, feature estimations, and accurate time log entries. **Compensation \& Culture** =========================== * Salary Range: $95,000 – $115,000 (Mid\-Level) \- *Final offer will be commensurate with experience and technical assessment results.* * Hybrid Flexibility: We value our culture in our offices in Allen, TX and Oak Ridge, TN, but offer a flexible hybrid or remote schedule based on team project needs rather than a rigid clock\-in / in\-office requirement. * Growth Path: This position was created by a team member's promotion. We actively invest in our engineers' career trajectories into senior engineering or architecture roles.

jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description: **Senior AI Engineer – Agentic AI \& LLM Platforms** We are looking for a hands\-on **Senior AI Engineer** with strong software engineering experience building production applications using Generative AI, frontier LLMs, and agentic AI architectures. The role will focus on designing and developing multi\-agent systems, reusable AI tools and platforms, enterprise integrations, and AI solutions using AWS Bedrock. We are also looking for engineers who actively use **AI\-assisted development tools** as part of their day\-to\-day engineering workflow. **Experience** * **5\+ years of overall software engineering experience**, preferably across backend, cloud, or distributed applications. * **2\+ years of hands\-on experience with Generative AI, LLM applications, and agentic AI frameworks.** * Experience taking AI/LLM applications from prototype through production. **Key Responsibilities** * Design, develop, and deploy **agentic and multi\-agent AI systems** for production use cases. * Build agent workflows involving reasoning, planning, routing, delegation, tool execution, memory, state management, checkpointing, parallel execution, and human\-in\-the\-loop patterns. * Work with **frontier LLMs** and make practical decisions around model selection, prompting, structured outputs, context management, latency, token usage, quality, and cost. * Build and integrate **MCP servers, reusable tools, and function/tool\-calling workflows** connecting agents with APIs, databases, enterprise systems, and internal applications. * Develop and orchestrate **production\-grade agent workflows and multi\-agent systems**. * Build AI applications using **AWS Bedrock**, including foundation models, Knowledge Bases/RAG, Guardrails, and related services. * Build **RAG and enterprise retrieval pipelines**, including ingestion, embeddings, vector search, reranking, metadata filtering, and grounding. * Design **multi\-model architectures**, selecting models based on task complexity, quality, latency, and cost. * Implement **LLM observability and evaluation**, including tracing, tool execution, response quality, grounding, hallucination, latency, token consumption, and task completion. * Implement AI security patterns including **guardrails, prompt\-injection defenses, tool permissioning, credential management, and safe agent execution**. * Build reusable **agent platforms and frameworks**, not just standalone chatbot applications. * Use **AI coding assistants and coding agents** effectively for development, debugging, testing, refactoring, and code analysis while maintaining ownership of code quality and architecture. * Work with product and engineering teams to take AI use cases from POC through production. **Required Skills** * Strong **Python** development skills with experience building production APIs and backend services. * Strong hands\-on experience with **Generative AI, LLMs, agentic architectures, and multi\-agent orchestration**. * Experience with frontier models such as **OpenAI GPT, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, Meta Llama**, or equivalent. * Hands\-on experience with **MCP, tool/function calling, structured outputs, and agent\-to\-tool integration**. * Experience with **AWS Bedrock** and building AI/LLM applications on AWS. * Experience with one or more agentic AI frameworks such as **LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, AutoGen, or equivalent**. * Strong understanding of **RAG, embeddings, vector databases, semantic search, and reranking**. * Experience with **LLM observability, tracing, evaluation, and production monitoring using tools like Langsmith or equivalent**. * Working knowledge of AWS services such as **Lambda, ECS/EKS, API Gateway, S3, DynamoDB/RDS, OpenSearch, SQS/SNS, and CloudWatch**. * Comfortable with **AI\-assisted software development**, using tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, or similar coding agents. **What We Are Looking For** This is **not a traditional data science or model\-training role**. We are looking for an engineer who knows how to use modern foundation models to build real software systems. The right candidate should be comfortable moving between an **LLM, agent workflow, MCP tool, Python service, RAG pipeline, and AWS Bedrock**, and understand how these pieces come together in a reliable production system. They should also be **AI\-native in how they develop software**, using AI coding tools extensively while retaining ownership of architecture, code quality, testing, security, and the final implementation. Pay: $80,000\.00 \- $110,000\.00 per year Benefits: * Health insurance * Paid time off Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Growth Engineer
jobs.description: Weave (YC W25\) is building the definitive platform for understanding and improving how engineering teams work. We believe the way engineering output is measured today is fundamentally broken and that modern AI can give teams a far more accurate and actionable view of productivity, impact and collaboration. Trusted by 200\+ customers such as Robinhood, Rho, PostHog and Browserbase, we've delivered consistent double\-digit month\-over\-month revenue growth since May and are looking to accelerate our growth. As Weave's **Founding Growth Engineer**, your job is to make sure every engineer who hears about Weave ends up using it. You'll own the self\-serve funnel end to end, from the first visit to the website to the moment a team is hooked, and you'll build the systems that turn that funnel into pipeline for sales. We've raised a $13\.5 million Series A and are backed by Standard Capital, YCombinator, Moonfire, Burst Capital, IrregEx and the Agent Fund. This is a rare opportunity to join at the ground floor and shape how millions of engineers and leaders understand engineering work. **What We're Building** ----------------------- Weave is rethinking engineering output from first principles. We use AI to: * Understand how engineers actually work (not just what they ship) * Surface meaningful insights about productivity, quality, collaboration and impact * Help teams improve outcomes without vanity metrics or surveillance Our goal is not to optimize for "more output," but for better engineering. **The Team You'll Work With** ----------------------------- You'll work directly with: * **Andrew (CTO)** – previously a founding engineer at Causal, MIT alum. Andrew has been in your shoes and is deeply committed to providing the mentorship, ownership and growth he had as an early engineer. * **Adam (CEO)** – leads sales and customer discovery. Adam is a former sales executive at multiple high\-growth startups and deeply embedded with customers and scaled multiple sales teams from $0\-30M in ARR. This is a small, intense, highly collaborative team. You will have real ownership from day one. **The Role** ------------ This isn't a traditional growth role and we're not looking for a growth operator who can write a little SQL. The closest thing we can describe it as is a mashup of full\-stack engineer, growth PM, data analyst and marketer. Today Weave grows because the product is good and the sales team is relentless. Engineers hear about us, install Weave or the Weave Router, and tell their teams. Your job is to turn that into a machine: a website that converts, a signup that takes minutes, onboarding that gets a team to their first real insight fast, and the data to know which of those teams sales should call today. You'll sit on the GTM team, write production code every week and be measured on one thing: how many engineering teams start using Weave and stick. Not on assisting someone else's strategy, not on optimizing a slice of a funnel, but on the whole funnel, end to end. If you've been waiting for the role where you actually get the keys, this is it. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * **Own the funnel end to end.** Website, signup, onboarding, activation, expansion. You decide what to fix first, you fix it and you report on whether the number moved. * **Build the website like a product.** Landing pages, pricing, programmatic SEO pages, interactive demos, the docs entry points. Ship, measure, iterate. No waiting on an agency. * **Make onboarding take minutes.** Own the signup and first\-run experience for Weave and the Weave Router: connecting a repo, installing the router, getting to the first insight a team actually cares about. Find where people drop off and fix it in the product code. * **Run the experimentation engine.** Build the A/B testing, feature\-flag and event\-tracking infrastructure, then use it. Real hypotheses, clean experiments, honest readouts. Kill what doesn't work, double down on what does. * **Build the growth data stack.** Attribution, product\-qualified lead scoring, CRM sync. Sales should know which self\-serve teams are ready for a conversation before those teams do. * **Automate lifecycle.** Email and in\-product sequences triggered off what a team actually does in Weave, from signup to activation to expansion. * **Partner across the team.** Product engineering on in\-product surfaces, our Founding Marketer on launches and content, our Founding GTM Engineer and AEs on the handoff from self\-serve to sales. * **Be flexible:** some days you're rewriting a signup flow in React, others you're building a programmatic SEO pipeline, debugging attribution or pulling the numbers on last week's experiment. We're inventing the function as we go. **Qualifications** ------------------ ### **Must\-Have** * **You're an engineer first.** You've shipped production code across the stack and you still write it every week. You can build the experiment, not just propose it. * **You've grown something and can show us the receipts.** A funnel you owned, a signup flow you rebuilt, a programmatic SEO play that worked. Not "we grew while I was there." You know which of your changes moved the number and why. * **You think in funnels and cohorts.** You're fluent in SQL and product analytics, you know the difference between a metric that moves and a metric that matters, and you design experiments that can actually fail. * **You have product taste.** Growth at Weave means making the product easier to want, not adding dark patterns. You can tell the difference and you'll push back when we can't. * **You move fast and own outcomes.** You don't wait for a brief. You find the biggest leak in the funnel, fix it and report on what happened. * **You care about developer tools.** Our users are engineers. You know what they read, what they trust and what makes them close the tab. * This role is 5 days in office in SF ### **Nice\-to\-Have** * Prior growth engineering, PLG or self\-serve role at a developer tools, AI/ML or infrastructure company * You've helped take a sales\-led company self\-serve, or a self\-serve company upmarket * Hands\-on with the growth stack: product analytics, feature flags, CRM, lifecycle email and SEO tooling * Our tech stack is React \+ TypeScript on the frontend, Go on the backend, and Python for ML. Experience with any of those is a bonus. * You've run your own side project, newsletter or product that grew on the strength of the work * Experience at an early\-stage startup (Seed to Series B), even if it wasn't a growth role **Why Join** ------------ * Competitive pay \+ early equity * Health/vision/dental insurance covered * Free lunch/dinners/snacks * Yearly team offsite with regular team events * Yearly $500 learning/development stipend * Get to work in SF with one of the fastest moving teams (95%\+ percentile code output) **About the interview** ----------------------- * 15\-minute intro call * 30\-minute interview with our CEO, Adam * 30\-minute technical interview with our CTO, Andrew and a GTM Engineer * 45\-minute interview with our CEO, Adam * 3\-5 day paid work trial Compensation Range: $100K \- $140K

jobs.title: General Manager/Sr Engineer
jobs.description: General Manager / Senior Engineer — Steel Division **Wellborn \+ Wright · Richmond, Virginia · On\-site · Full\-time** Wellborn \+ Wright is seeking a General Manager / Senior Engineer to run our steel division — the people, the process, and the numbers behind custom steel windows and doors built to exacting sightlines and tolerances. This is the top seat in the division. You'll own both how steel gets built here and how the business performs doing it: the operational leader who keeps jobs moving profitably from estimate to installed opening, and the senior technical authority who sets the engineering standard — bringing modern tools, including AI, to bear on both. It's a role for an engineer who wants to run a business, not just a queue of drawings. What you'll do * **Run the steel division.** Own the division's operations and its results — throughput, on\-time delivery, quality, and margin. The shop is our capacity constraint; how you plan, staff, and sequence it is what protects both the schedule and the bottom line. * **Be the senior engineer.** Set and hold the engineering standard end to end — detailing, connection and structural design, tolerances, and QA — and personally resolve the hard fabrication and installation problems that keep both the architecture and the structure right. * **Lead the shop floor and the team.** Run production and engineering as one operation; hire, coach, and develop detailers, engineers, and fabricators; lead meaningful design and production reviews; and grow the bench so the division scales without losing craft. * **Own the commercial handoffs.** Work hand in glove with estimating, project management, and sales so what we quote, what we engineer, and what we build are the same thing — and so lead times and margins hold. * **Manage cost, vendors, and capacity.** Watch job cost and productivity, manage material and vendor relationships, and make the buy/build/schedule calls that keep work flowing and margins intact. * **Put AI and modern tooling to work.** Find where AI genuinely helps — detailing, design iteration, estimating support, production planning, capturing hard\-won shop knowledge — and lead its adoption in a way that raises speed and quality without compromising craft. * **Drive continuous improvement.** Standardize where it helps, invest in the tools and methods that raise throughput and first\-pass quality, and bring discipline to how the division captures and reuses what it knows. What you'll bring * A degree in mechanical, structural, manufacturing, or a related engineering discipline. * 8\+ years in metal fabrication, architectural metals, or custom manufacturing, including running a team, a shop, or a P\&L. * Strong, hands\-on engineering fundamentals: CAD and detailing (SolidWorks, Inventor, AutoCAD, or Tekla), GD\&T, and a working command of steel fabrication, welding, and finishing. * Operational leadership: you can own a schedule and a budget, read a job\-cost report, and turn ambiguity into process that holds. * A track record of building and mentoring teams — people point to you as the reason they got better. * Clear communication with makers, customers, and non\-engineers alike, and the judgment to balance design intent, structural reality, cost, and buildability. * Fluency with AI, and a practical point of view on where it strengthens engineering and manufacturing — and where it doesn't. You actively put new tools to work rather than waiting to be told to. **Preferred:** PE license; direct experience with architectural steel windows and doors, or comparable high\-tolerance custom fenestration; P\&L or profit\-center ownership; familiarity with ERP or production\-planning systems; and exposure to lean or other continuous\-improvement methods. Why Wellborn \+ Wright You'll run a division whose work ends up in some of the most demanding residential and architectural projects in the country, alongside people who care about the material and the making. This is the top seat in the division — real ownership of the operation, the team, and the results — at a company actively investing in better tools, AI included, to do the work right. Competitive salary and benefits; details below. The details * **Location:** Richmond, VA — on\-site at our Carolina Avenue factory and showroom. * **Type:** Full\-time, exempt. * **Reports to:** President. * **Compensation:** 90,000 \- 140,000 per year, commensurate with experience, plus benefits. How to apply Send a resume and a short note about a division, shop, or team you've run, or a project you engineered, to \[application email / link]. Wellborn \+ Wright is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. using Teradata Utilities, Load/Unload processes, and BigQuery * 2\+ years of database experience with Oracle, Teradata, SQL Server, and relational database design * 2\+ years of SQL development and perform  WebSphere * Strong understanding of MVC architecture, J2EE design patterns, and enterprise application design * Experience with Apache Spark, ETL technologies (Ab Initio, Informatica,
